description.zh: 边对话边听歌的悬浮播放器，可隐藏或重新打开；默认收缩为吸附在边缘的小唱片圈，支持双击下一首、三击上一首。接入 QQ 音乐，支持扫码登录、断点续播、音质切换、重启续播、歌单导入和搜索。
description.en: A floating player for listening while you chat. It can be hidden and reopened, and collapses to a small edge-docked record. Supports double-click for next track, triple-click for previous track, QQ Music with QR sign-in, resume playback, quality switching, playlist import, and search.

description.zh: 落雪音乐（LX Music）内嵌歌词与播放控制插件：歌词显示在 DSH 右侧壁纸带，胶囊控件提供上一首、播放/暂停和下一首。播放器未启动时点击播放会自动在托盘启动，不弹出窗口；不接管播放。
description.en: A Luoxue Music (LX Music) lyrics and playback-control plugin. Lyrics appear in the DSH right-side wallpaper strip, while a capsule provides previous, play/pause, and next controls. If the player is not running, Play starts it from the tray without opening a window. It does not take over playback.

afawfawffaf.dsh-plugin-lx-music.nameSource: registry description (explicit 落雪音乐); English localized as Luoxue Music

description.zh: Dock Media 音视频插件：音频和视频都支持一键全屏，并通过 HTTP Range 流式读取文件。
description.en: Dock Media plays audio and video, supports one-click fullscreen for both, and streams files through HTTP Range.

description.zh: 侧栏短视频插件：提供原生播放器、系列导航、直链解析和精确回放历史记录。
description.en: A sidebar short-video plugin with a native player, series navigation, direct-link parsing, and precise playback-history replay.

description.zh: 在 Web GUI 侧栏以抖音式竖屏浏览视频，窗口随视频宽高比自适应，支持 Range 流式播放和 SMB NAS。
description.en: A Douyin-style vertical video player in the Web GUI sidebar, with aspect-ratio-based window sizing, Range streaming, and SMB NAS support.

anitman.dsh-plugin-video-player.nameSource: registry description (explicit DSH Video Player / DSH 刷视频)

description.zh: 兼容 MusicFree 协议的音乐伴侣，提供侧栏音乐入口和搜索/播放能力，支持多个公开音乐与电台来源；生成的源插件需经过审核并显式安装。
description.en: A MusicFree-compatible music companion with a sidebar entry, search, and playback across multiple public music and radio sources. Generated source plugins require review and explicit installation.

name.zh: 网易云音乐 · 右侧栏

description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏使用网易云音乐。
description.en: Use NetEase Cloud Music from the DSH right sidebar.

description.zh: 全页面网易云音乐播放器插件，为 DSH 提供以音乐为中心的播放界面。
description.en: A full-page NetEase Cloud Music player plugin with a music-focused interface for DSH.

description.zh: 四档“图片 + 配色 + 人设”一体化推理滑块皮肤：off 为灰色，low 为蓝色（原版观感），high 为亮青色，max 为粉色。
description.en: A four-level reasoning-slider skin combining image, color scheme, and persona: gray for off, blue for low (original-style appearance), bright cyan for high, and pink for max.

carlown.majia7-skin.nameSource: registry name, corroborated by registry description

description.zh: 基于 dsh-music-player 的修改版：移除 QQ、酷狗、讲书和歌词功能，加入播客与网络电台，支持 CC0 电台库、分类浏览和自定义电台源。
description.en: A dsh-music-player fork that removes QQ Music, Kugou, audiobook, and lyrics features and adds podcasts plus internet radio, with a CC0 station library, genre browsing, and custom station sources.

description.zh: 落雪音乐增强控制插件，提供侧边栏播放卡片、播放与音源管理界面，以及 LLM 点歌能力。不需要外部服务。
description.en: Enhanced control for Luoxue Music, with a sidebar playback card, playback and audio-source management, and LLM song requests. No external service is required.

cyberryre.dsh-lx-music.nameSource: registry description (explicit LX Music enhancement) + Luoxue Music localization rule

description.zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋背景，支持在左下角调节波浪、日光和玻璃不透明度，并启用自动昼夜循环。
description.en: A real-time WebGPU ocean background with controls for waves, sunlight, and glass opacity in the lower-left corner, plus an automatic day-night cycle.

d-dev0101.open-sea-skin.nameSource: registry name + ocean-skin description + install.npm metadata

description.zh: 网易云音乐（music.163.com）播放器与 AI DJ 组合插件，提供侧栏页面、应用内播放、二维码登录，以及由 agent 工具管理播放队列。
description.en: A NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ bundle with a sidebar page, in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools for curating the queue.

description.zh: 鎏金主题：oklch 金粉双色层、24px 点阵画布和浮动卡片侧栏，接管会话栏、会话流、输入坞与工具卡。使用 theme.overrideTokens 常驻 {light,dark} 双色，priority:-1；停用后完整还原，采用零构建纯 loader 格式。
description.en: The Aurum theme uses oklch gold-and-pink layers, a 24px dotted canvas, and a floating card sidebar covering the session bar, stream, input dock, and tool cards. It keeps {light,dark} variants in theme.overrideTokens with priority:-1; disabling it fully restores the original interface. Zero-build loader format.

description.zh: 经典麦金塔 Macintosh 主题，采用 System 7 像素复古风格，包含像素字体、桌面噪点画布、Finder 式会话侧栏、黑白方角控件和 HappyMac 空态。零构建纯 loader 格式，附 Kit 组件检视页。
description.en: A Classic Macintosh theme in a System 7 pixel-retro style, with pixel fonts, a noisy desktop canvas, Finder-style session sidebar, black-and-white square controls, and a HappyMac empty state. Zero-build loader format with a Kit component inspection page.

description.zh: 藏在聊天输入框里的摸鱼播放器：支持 B 站、YouTube、Vimeo 和 mp4 直链；鼠标移出输入框时播放，移回时自动暂停并从原位置继续。
description.en: A low-profile video player hidden in the chat composer. It supports Bilibili, YouTube, Vimeo, and direct MP4 links, playing when the pointer leaves the composer and pausing to resume at the same position when it returns.

description.zh: dsh-moyu 的抖音摸鱼模块：悬停即可显示推荐流播放器，滚轮切换视频，移开后自动暂停；宿主侧完成请求签名和媒体反代，不需要抖音账号登录。首次使用需要匿名 ttwid，可由插件自动获取。
description.en: The Douyin module of dsh-moyu: hover to open a recommendation-feed player, use the wheel to switch videos, and move away to pause. The host handles request signing and media proxying; no Douyin account is required, but the first use needs an anonymous ttwid that the plugin can obtain.

description.zh: 本地音乐播放器插件，在会话视图的“音乐”标签页中播放 flac、mp3 等常见格式，支持单曲/列表循环，并采用 macOS Music 风格界面。
description.en: A local music player in the session view’s Music tab. It supports common formats such as flac and mp3, single-track or list looping, and a macOS Music-style interface.

description.zh: 本地音乐播放器插件：通过 /music 打开全屏场景，扫描本地目录并使用 ffplay/afplay 播放；退出场景后音乐不中断。
description.en: A local music player with a fullscreen /music scene. It scans local directories, plays through ffplay/afplay, and keeps the music playing after you exit the scene.

description.zh: 音乐播放器插件：搜索并播放 Audius 免费曲库，支持收藏、迷你播放条和 agent 对话遥控。
description.en: A music player plugin for searching and streaming Audius’s free catalog, with favorites, a mini player, and agent chat control.

hey.ruomei.dsh.music.player.nameSource: curated from registry description (Audius) + category; no explicit product title

description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的音频预览：支持缩放波形、实时频谱和全曲频谱图，并提供支持 HTTP Range 的流式媒体路由。
description.en: Audio preview for dsh-better-sidebar with a zoomable waveform, live spectrum, whole-file spectrogram, and an HTTP Range-capable streaming media route.

description.zh: 可淡化的 JPG/PNG/WebP 自定义图片背景与 FLAC/MP3/WAV/M4A 背景音乐播放器，支持 0–200% 音量、播放列表、循环、随机播放和 10 段均衡器；右下角悬浮条可展开控制面板。
description.en: Fadable custom JPG/PNG/WebP image backgrounds and a FLAC/MP3/WAV/M4A music player with 0–200% volume, playlists, loop, shuffle, and a 10-band equalizer; expand the control panel from the floating bar at bottom right.

description.zh: 可浮动、拖动和调整大小的视频播放器。
description.en: A floating, draggable, resizable video player.

name.zh: 网易云 AI 控制台

description.zh: 网页版网易云音乐播放器：顶部条迷你播放器可展开为控制面板，支持扫码登录和 AI 对话控制。
description.en: A web NetEase Cloud Music player with a mini player in the top bar and an expandable control panel, plus QR-code login and AI conversation control.

description.zh: 在对话中渲染可交互的音乐播放器，支持网易云音乐和 QQ 音乐双后端、玻璃拟态悬浮歌词、节拍气泡特效和多种主题。
description.en: Renders an interactive music player in conversations with NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music backends, glass-style floating lyrics, beat bubble effects, and multiple themes.

description.zh: 语音与主题音乐插件：在 agent 会话生命周期事件上播放随机语音提示，并按主题播放网易云音乐背景乐。
description.en: A voice and theme-music plugin that plays random voice prompts on agent session lifecycle events and NetEase Cloud Music background tracks by theme.

description.zh: 直播电台播放器，提供主题化播放器、情绪频道和本地收听历史。
description.en: Live radio with themed players, mood channels, and local listening history.

description.zh: 本地音乐、AI 讲书、新闻播报和网络电台播放器，并提供 music_play 工具，让 agent 可以按对话指令播放音乐或启动朗读。
description.en: A player for local music, AI-narrated novels, news broadcasts, and internet radio. Its music_play tool lets an agent start playback or narration from a conversation.

description.zh: DBS (DSH BGM service) 是独立于 DET 的 DSH BGM 播放器插件，提供本地音乐库、浮动播放器和由 AI 按任务控制播放。
description.en: DBS (DSH BGM service) is a standalone DSH BGM player plugin, with a local music library, floating player, and AI-driven playback by task.

description.zh: 管理、浏览和播放本地媒体库，适配 PC 与移动端，支持滑动刷视频、即时拖拽播放和实时转码。
description.en: Manage, browse, and play a local media library on PC and mobile, with swipe-through video, instant drag-to-play, and real-time transcoding.

description.zh: 轻量级 Web UI 外观皮肤：支持壁纸、玻璃质感透明效果和重点色；设置由服务端保存并在多设备间同步，不接管原生明暗模式。
description.en: A lightweight Web UI appearance skin with wallpaper, glass-like transparency, and accent colour. Settings are server-side and work across devices without taking over the native light/dark mode.

description.zh: 打开新对话或钉住的会话时，以铺满窗口的视频播放片头开机动画。可替换为自己的视频，并设置每个会话只播放一次或每次打开都播放。
description.en: Plays a full-window video intro when opening a new conversation or a pinned conversation. Replace it with your own video and choose whether each conversation plays it once or every time it opens.

description.zh: AI 原生插件化音乐播放器，聚合网易云音乐和 QQ 音乐，支持逐字卡拉 OK 歌词、花再（HALO PIXELBAR）音箱歌词同步，以及通过对话控制点歌、进度、音量、队列、收藏、音箱场景和闹钟提醒。
description.en: An AI-native, plugin-based music player that aggregates NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music, with word-by-word karaoke lyrics, lyrics sync for 花再（HALO PIXELBAR）speakers, and conversation control for song selection, progress, volume, queue, favourites, speaker scenes, and alarm reminders.

description.zh: 在对话中直接播放视频和音频，播放器显示在回复下方，支持紧凑卡片、Range 流式传输和自动播放。
description.en: Inline video and audio for conversations: the player appears under the reply with compact cards, Range streaming, and auto-play.

description.zh: Bilibili 悬浮小窗播放器，支持推荐、热门、排行、搜索、关注 UP 主、自动连播、迷你模式和历史记录持久化。
description.en: A floating Bilibili mini player with recommendations, popular and ranked videos, search, followed UP creators, autoplay, mini mode, and persistent history.

description.zh: Canvas 光场启动动画，包含中文清晰度优化、黑幕标识、过曝洗白、档案底板和可交互的访问授权；播放结束后回到原来的界面。它不是界面皮肤。
description.en: A Canvas light-field startup animation with Chinese clarity optimization, blackout mark, overexposure washout, archive panel, and interactive access authorization; it returns to the original interface after playback. It is not an interface skin.

description.zh: 在右下角小窗播放 Bilibili 视频，支持原生播放器、弹幕、评论和搜索；agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完成后从原位置精确续播。
description.en: Plays Bilibili videos in a bottom-right mini window with the native player, danmaku, comments, and search. It pauses and alerts you when the agent needs you, then resumes precisely from the previous position.

description.zh: AMP 电台播放器，支持实时可视化、台站搜索和收藏。
description.en: AMP radio player with a live visualizer, station search, and favourites.

description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的音频/视频预览播放器，支持原生播放和带 Range 定位的流式媒体路由。
description.en: Audio/video preview viewer for dsh-better-sidebar with native playback and a Range-seeking streaming route.

description.zh: 芙宁娜主题皮肤，采用水蓝、藏青、冰白与神之眼金色配色，配有微信/QQ 式聊天气泡、双形态焦点模式、自适应壁纸亮度和液态流动动效。
description.en: A Furina-themed skin with aqua blue, navy, ice white, and Vision gold accents, WeChat/QQ-style chat bubbles, dual focus modes, adaptive wallpaper brightness, and liquid-flow motion effects.

description.zh: 按音频目录组织场景的白噪音播放器，支持 AI 后台下载氛围音、顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇四种播放模式，以及按时长或指定时刻的睡眠定时器。
description.en: A directory-driven white-noise player with AI background downloads for ambient sounds, sequential, shuffle, single-track loop, and interval modes, plus sleep timers by duration or specified time.

description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏中预览音频和视频，通过经过认证的 HTTP Range 路由传输，远程浏览器可播放并拖动定位大文件，无需打开 Host 上的原生应用。
description.en: Preview audio and video in the DSH right sidebar through an authenticated HTTP Range route, allowing remote browsers to play and seek large files without opening a native app on the host.

description.zh: 本地音乐播放器，按文件夹组织树形歌单并直接流式播放，零 token 消耗。
description.en: A local music player with folder-based tree playlists, direct streaming playback, and zero token consumption.

description.zh: 在聊天记录中自动将本地或在线的音频、视频和图片路径渲染为内联媒体预览组件。
description.en: Automatically renders local or online audio, video, and image paths as inline media previews in the conversation.

description.zh: 支持本地与网易云音乐播放，可通过 Cookie 解锁 VIP 歌曲；提供 Agent 控制播放、自定义播放器 CSS，以及队列结束后通知 AI 挑选新歌。
description.en: Plays local music and NetEase Cloud Music, with VIP-song access via Cookie; includes Agent playback control, custom player CSS, and AI notification to choose new songs when the queue ends.

description.zh: 边对话边听歌的音乐播放器，提供可自由拖动的折叠/展开悬浮窗口，通过 Meting API 等解析源接入网易云音乐，并支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索导入单曲。
description.en: A music player for listening while chatting, with collapsible or expanded draggable floating windows, NetEase Cloud Music access through sources such as Meting API, playlist import, and single-track import by title or artist.

description.zh: 网易云音乐播放器，在侧栏中播放已登录用户的喜欢歌曲，并支持搜索和在线播放。
description.en: A NetEase Cloud Music player in the sidebar for playing the logged-in user's liked songs, with search and online playback.

description.zh: 在半透明侧栏弹窗中浏览、预览、下载和删除生成的图片与视频。
description.en: Browse, preview, download, and delete generated images and videos in a semi-transparent sidebar popup.

description.zh: 在对话正文中将本地图片和视频绝对路径自动内联为图片或可播放视频，并附带可点击的本地地址行。
description.en: Automatically inlines local image and video absolute paths in chat as images or playable videos, with a clickable local address line below each item.

description.zh: 为 dsh-better-sidebar 提供视频文件预览，在侧栏中以内嵌 <video> 播放器打开 .mp4、.webm、.mov、.mkv 和 .avi 文件，并支持拖动进度条。
description.en: A video-file preview for dsh-better-sidebar that opens .mp4, .webm, .mov, .mkv, and .avi files in an inline <video> player with a draggable progress bar.

description.zh: 仅限 Windows，需安装本机网易云音乐客户端；提供迷你播放条、液态玻璃卡片和黑胶视图，使用本机客户端自动登录，支持 VIP 曲目播放及客户端播放同步。
description.en: Windows-only NetEase Cloud Music player requiring the local client; provides a mini bar, liquid glass card, vinyl view, automatic login through the local client, VIP playback, and client playback sync.

description.zh: 滑动变阻器风格皮肤。
description.en: A sliding-variable-resistor-style skin.

description.zh: 将 DSH 的 0–30 推理强度映射为五个马斯克主题阶段，并把推理等级改成紧凑滑块；界面会同步人物、背景和配色，设置中可切回原生外观。
description.en: Maps DSH's 0–30 reasoning-intensity range to five Musk-themed stages and replaces the control with a compact slider. The character, background, and colors follow the selected stage, with a setting to return to the native appearance.

description.zh: 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列中的深海女仆工坊主题。
description.en: The Abyssal Maid Atelier theme in the Whale Girl skin series.

description.zh: 虎鲸链路皮肤，采用珍珠白机械舱、黑曜虎鲸操作员与电蓝链路信号，包含亮暗双场景、直角 UI、状态角色和动态定价信号。
description.en: An ORCA LINK skin with a pearl-white mechanical cabin, obsidian orca operator, and electric-blue link signals, including light and dark scenes, angular UI, status characters, and dynamic pricing signals.

description.zh: 舒缓的 Catppuccin 粉彩主题，提供 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato 和 Mocha 四套皮肤。
description.en: A soothing Catppuccin pastel theme with four skins: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha.

description.zh: Catppuccin 主题插件，支持 DSH Web、DSH Desktop 和 dsh-TUI，并可在 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四种官方配色间切换；另有可选玻璃质感。
description.en: A Catppuccin theme plugin for DSH Web, DSH Desktop, and dsh-TUI, with one-click switching among the four official palettes—Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha—plus optional Glassmorphism.

description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色和深色模式跟随系统外观。
description.en: A skin recreating the Blue Whale color scheme from DeepSeek Chat, with light and dark modes following the system appearance.

name.zh: 内置皮肤与自定义背景

description.zh: 换肤插件，提供 4 套内置皮肤，以及可自定义的图片和视频皮肤。
description.en: A skin plugin with four built-in skins plus customizable image and video skins.

description.zh: 主题、全局字体、@ 文件引用、项目文件树与 Markdown 预览工作台。
description.en: A workspace for themes, global typography, @file mentions, a project file tree, and Markdown preview.

description.zh: 轻拟物与磨砂玻璃主题，提供暖色浅色/深色配色、环境光、颗粒纹理和细腻微交互。
description.en: A neumorphism and glassmorphism theme with warm light/dark palettes, ambient lighting, grain texture, and subtle micro-interactions.

description.zh: Solarized 与 Selenized 主题：将四套忠实色板注册到主题运行时，并提供设置选择项和规范的代码块语法配色。
description.en: Solarized and Selenized themes with four faithful palettes registered in the theme runtime, a Settings picker row, and canonical code-block syntax colors.

description.zh: 轻量主题切换器，可自动检测已安装皮肤并互斥切换；全部停用时回退官方外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。
description.en: A lightweight theme switcher that detects installed skins and switches between them exclusively, falls back to the official appearance when none is active, and persists across restarts.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 灵感复古即时通信皮肤。
description.en: A QQ 2007-inspired retro messenger skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

description.zh: 首页同款背景，包含深海流体、点线网格和数字鲸鱼，并提供深浅双主题。
description.en: The homepage-style background features deep-sea fluid effects, a point-and-line grid, and a digital whale in light and dark themes.

description.zh: 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。
description.en: An Arknights fan skin featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla, with day-and-night starry garden backgrounds and a two-character layout.

description.zh: 皮肤切换器与自定义壁纸层，支持 --dsw-alias-* 调色板、透明度/模糊控制，并按浏览器持久保存设置。
description.en: A skin switcher and custom wallpaper layer with --dsw-alias-* palettes, opacity and blur controls, and per-browser persistence.

description.zh: Cyberpunk 2077 / 夜之城主题，包含 CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 锁定、打字机音效、Relic 故障效果和彩蛋。
description.en: A Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme with CRT scanlines, Kiroshi lock-on, typewriter SFX, Relic glitches, and easter eggs.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供壁纸与可选的 Liquid Glass 液态玻璃叠加层。
description.en: Wallpaper with an optional Liquid Glass overlay for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

description.zh: 鲸鱼女仆纸面主题，提供亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框、装饰素材与常驻桌宠。
description.en: A whale-maid paper-style theme with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn borders, decorative assets, and a persistent desktop pet.

description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤，采用暖黑画布、Anthropic 陶橙点缀和衬线 UI。
description.en: A Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, Anthropic clay-orange accents, and serif UI.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加动态粒子网络背景。
description.en: A dynamic particle-network background plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

description.zh: 主题工作室，提供 5 套预设、70+ 个派生令牌，并通过官方插件 API 即时应用。
description.en: A theme studio with 5 presets, 70+ derived tokens, and live application through the official plugin API.

description.zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面主题，包含多窗口桌面、XP 风格界面、任务栏和 Bliss 壁纸。
description.en: A Windows XP Luna desktop theme with a multi-window desktop, XP chrome, taskbar, and Bliss wallpaper.

description.zh: 在“Deep diving...”状态提示前放置 GrokBot 风格动态头像，状态文字同步以打字机效果变化。
description.en: Places a GrokBot-style animated avatar before the “Deep diving...” indicator, with a synchronized typewriter effect for the status text.

description.zh: 外观与主题插件，支持内置调色板、明色/暗色/跟随系统模式、Open VSX 搜索导入和 VS Code 主题导入，并持久保存主题库。
description.en: An appearance and theme plugin with built-in palettes, light/dark/system modes, Open VSX search and import, VS Code theme import, and a persistent theme library.

description.zh: 上传图片作为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的整窗磨砂玻璃主题。
description.en: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web.

description.zh: IKUN 应援主题，包含全屏壁纸轮播、基尼太美音乐盒，以及发送时自动播放“你干嘛~哎哟”。
description.en: An IKUN theme with a full-screen wallpaper carousel, the 基尼太美 music box, and automatic playback of “你干嘛~哎哟” when sending.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中使用为 Visual Studio Code 设计的 .vsix 主题文件。
description.en: Use .vsix theme files designed for Visual Studio Code in the DSH Web UI.

description.zh: 外观自定义插件：主题调色、背景图片、透明度与模糊，以及毛玻璃效果。
description.en: Appearance customization plugin with theme colors, background images, opacity and blur, and a glass effect.

description.zh: 高自由度的磨砂玻璃主题，可调节玻璃模糊度、磨砂度和流体或自定义壁纸背景；关闭后即可恢复原生界面。
description.en: A highly configurable frosted-glass theme with adjustable blur, frosting, and fluid or custom wallpaper backgrounds; disable it to return to the native interface.

description.zh: 卡通像素皮肤插件，保持原始界面不变，并加入会散步、眨眼和跳跃的像素宠物。
description.en: Cartoon pixel skin plugin that leaves the original interface unchanged and adds pixel pets that stroll, blink, and hop.

description.zh: 以灵梦与博丽神社为主题的皮肤，包含昼夜神社背景、灵梦立绘、画框侧边栏与输入框，以及纸白透明界面。
description.en: A Reimu and Hakurei Shrine skin with day-and-night shrine backgrounds, Reimu artwork, framed sidebar and input box, and a paper-white translucent interface.

description.zh: QQ2006 皮肤插件，提供 qq2006 主题、body[data-ds-skin] 镜像、全局皮肤表和完整素材。
description.en: QQ2006 skin plugin with the qq2006 theme, a body[data-ds-skin] mirror, a global skin table, and complete assets.

description.zh: FreeStyle 主题工作室，支持四轴主题建模、真实组件预览、12 套预设、图片取色与一键生成、分享码、119 个主题令牌，以及跨重启持久化。
description.en: FreeStyle theme studio with four-axis theme modeling, live previews using real components, 12 presets, image/color extraction and one-line generation, share codes, 119 theme tokens, and persistent themes.

description.zh: 第三方 WebUI 增强插件，支持自定义背景、主题颜色、提示词预设、token/上下文显示和手动紧凑模式。
description.en: Third-party WebUI enhancement plugin with custom backgrounds, theme colors, prompt presets, token/context visibility, and manual compact mode.

description.zh: 蓝色大肥鱼主题插件，包含海洋配色、鱼群、气泡、吉祥物和品牌替换。
description.en: A blue big-fish theme plugin with ocean colors, fish schools, bubbles, a mascot, and branding replacements.

description.zh: 永雏塔菲（AceTaffy）主题，提供亮暗双主题、场景背景和可选的浮动粒子效果。
description.en: An AceTaffy theme with light and dark palettes, scene backgrounds, and optional floating particles.

description.zh: 以 Nachoneko（甘城猫猫）为主题的 Web GUI 皮肤。
description.en: A Nachoneko-themed skin for the Web GUI.

description.zh: 《赛博朋克 2077》夜之城风格的深度定制主题：霓虹配色、CRT 氛围、流动彩带、故障闪烁、全局切角界面、输入框下方实时状态条，并提供独立设置页和主题总开关。
description.en: A deeply customized Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme with neon palettes, CRT atmosphere, flowing ribbons, glitch flashes, globally squared UI, a live status bar below the composer, and a dedicated settings page with a master toggle.

description.zh: 置顶的 DSH 桌面宠物窗口，默认是鲸鱼，提供四套皮肤和四种静默状态；网页中只显示同步镜像，不是页面内挂件。使用系统 Python，无额外依赖。
description.en: An always-on-top DSH desk-pet window with a default whale, four skins, and four silent states; the Web UI shows a synchronized mirror rather than an in-page widget. Uses system Python with no extra dependencies.

description.zh: 徒步山野风格的 DSH 皮肤，内置“山野向导”亮暗配色、右侧路标工作进度面板和可恢复默认的设置入口；纯 CSS 换皮，不改界面逻辑。
description.en: A hiking and mountain-wilderness reskin with the “Trail Guide” light/dark palette, a right-side Waypoints progress panel, and a reversible settings entry. It changes the CSS layer without altering interface logic.

description.zh: Claude Code 风格的终端皮肤：暖黑终端界面、陶土橙强调色、等宽字体和终端窗口式标题栏，支持明暗双模式。
description.en: A Claude Code-inspired terminal skin with charcoal surfaces, an amber accent, monospace type, and a terminal-window title bar; it supports light and dark modes.

description.zh: 全局磨砂玻璃主题插件：在任意主题上叠加半透明表面 token 覆盖与全局 backdrop-filter 模糊，同时保留现有浅色或深色偏好。
description.en: Global frosted-glass theme plugin that overlays translucent surface tokens and global backdrop-filter blur on any theme while preserving the existing light or dark preference.

name.en: Blue Whale Leaping from the Sea

description.zh: DeepSeek 蓝鲸主题，采用官方渐变和跃出海面的鲸鱼艺术。
description.en: DeepSeek blue-whale theme with the official gradient and leaping-whale art.

description.zh: 提供暖色浅色、暖色暗色和跟随系统的护眼主题。
description.en: Warm light, warm dark, and system-aware eye-care themes.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安洁莉娜亮色与暗色磨砂玻璃主题，并支持视差效果。
description.en: Angelina light and dark glass themes with parallax for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 受 Warp 启发的图片转主题插件：上传背景、提取配色并应用磨砂玻璃界面。
description.en: Warp-inspired image-to-theme plugin: upload a background, extract a palette, and apply a glass UI.

description.zh: Claude 风格界面主题，提供象牙白背景、赤陶色主色和暖灰文字的浅暗配色，并可选、可逆地将 DeepSeek 的 logo、词标、标题、favicon 和品牌文本替换为 Claude。
description.en: A Claude-style interface theme with ivory surfaces, terracotta accents, and warm-gray text in light and dark palettes. An optional reversible disguise replaces DeepSeek branding—logo, wordmark, title, favicon, and brand text—with Claude.

description.zh: 可配置的界面扩展，支持壁纸与毛玻璃外观、强调色、快捷键、用量面板、历史条、Markdown 渲染和入场动效；功能可按模块选择，默认不改变原生界面。
description.en: A configurable UI extension with wallpaper and frosted-glass styling, accent colors, shortcuts, a usage panel, a history strip, Markdown rendering, and entrance motion; features can be selected by module and are off by default.

description.zh: 学院蓝风格界面，配有可拖动、可抚摸、可同步助手回复的白子桌宠；主机端可读取已配置的凭据查询 DeepSeek 余额，密钥不会进入浏览器。
description.en: An academy-blue interface with a draggable, pettable Shiroko companion that can sync assistant replies; the host can use the configured credential to query the DeepSeek balance without sending it to the browser.

description.zh: 以 VirtuaReal 虚拟主播轴伊Joi 为主题的双衣装界面：Joi·Flowers 与 Joi·Library 各自提供浅/深配色、角色与鲸鱼娘装饰；可在换装卡中切换，也可回到原生外观。
description.en: A two-outfit interface theme based on VirtuaReal VTuber Joi: Joi·Flowers and Joi·Library each have their own light/dark palette, character art, and whale-girl decorations; switch outfits from the wardrobe or return to the native look.

description.zh: 鸣潮达妮娅主题界面，提供亮/暗双形态、玻璃卡片、虹彩泡泡粒子、深紫锁链边框、侧栏立绘与动态 Q 版吉祥物，并支持调色板设置。
description.en: A Wuthering Waves Denia interface with light and dark forms, glass panels, iridescent bubble particles, deep-purple chain borders, sidebar character art, and an animated chibi mascot, plus a palette panel.

name.zh: 爱弥斯主题与像素桌宠

description.zh: 爱弥斯主题界面配 4K 壁纸、冰蓝/粉紫/深空蓝配色和 15 帧像素桌宠；桌宠会随对话状态切换动画，可拖动、点击互动并持久化位置。
description.en: An Aemeath-themed interface with a 4K wallpaper, ice-blue/pink-violet/deep-space-blue colors, and a 15-frame pixel pet; the pet changes animation with conversation state and supports dragging, interactive clicks, and saved positioning.

description.zh: 在会话标签栏加入 GAL视窗，将会话区转换为 16:9 Galgame 舞台，提供占位立绘、大对话框、打字机台词、玩家输入和可视化编辑模式；场景编辑会实时同步到游戏模式。
description.en: Adds a GAL View tab to the session tabs and turns the conversation area into a 16:9 galgame stage with placeholder portraits, a large dialogue box, typewriter lines, player input, and a visual editor whose changes sync to game mode in real time.

description.zh: 为界面提供 38 款 OpenCode 配色主题，按色系分组并支持搜索、即时切换与重启后保留；另提供可独立调整的字体设置。
description.en: Provides 38 OpenCode color themes grouped by color family, with search, instant switching, and persistence across restarts; font settings can be adjusted independently.

description.zh: 以 2005 年门户网站为视觉主题，在侧栏、对话和推理过程中插入可关闭的虚构广告、假游戏与弹窗；提供中文与英文两套素材和设置开关。
description.en: A 2005 web-portal visual theme that inserts dismissible fictional ads, fake games, and pop-ups into the sidebar, conversation, and reasoning flow, with separate Chinese and English content and settings toggles.

description.zh: 双端工作台插件，使用官方主题令牌、会话 projection 和公开插件服务构建终末地工业风外观；配套右侧文件、编辑器、浏览器、终端、Git、任务与子代理面板，并读取原生 Goal。
description.en: A dual-platform workbench plugin that uses official theme tokens, session projections, and public plugin services for an Endfield industrial look, with right-side file, editor, browser, terminal, Git, task, and subagent panels, plus the native Goal.

description.zh: 将界面改为《你的名字。》电影风格，提供静态或无声循环动态电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、Logo 替换、输入卡与滚动条重绘，并可在两种壁纸形态间切换。
description.en: A Kimi no Na wa film-inspired interface with a static or silent looping movie wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, logo replacement, redesigned composer card and scrollbars, and a switch between the two wallpaper forms.

description.zh: 提供流萤主题的立绘、静态与动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、氛围粒子、背景音乐播放器和打字音效；壁纸与音乐可从界面管理。
description.en: A Firefly-themed interface with character art, static and live wallpapers, firefly-green neon colors, a transformation intro animation, ambience particles, a background-music player, and typing sounds; wallpapers and music can be managed in the UI.

description.zh: 参考《明日方舟：终末地》官网风格，采用奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄/武陵青强调色和直角工业编辑风；设置支持背景、动效、音频通知与额度胶囊等开关。
description.en: Inspired by the Arknights: Endfield website, this theme uses a cream-paper base, ink-black text, signal-yellow and Wuling-cyan accents, and a sharp-corner editorial style; settings cover the background, motion, audio notices, and balance capsule.

description.zh: 实时读取会话 reasoning 块中的 we / let's / let me 指纹，显示思考强度、三波段状态和心电图式曲线；可选在轨迹偏离时进行分级干预，其他模型建议保持只监控。
description.en: Reads the we / let's / let me fingerprints in session reasoning blocks and shows thinking intensity, three-band state, and an ECG-style curve. Optional tiered interventions can respond to trajectory drift; the README recommends monitor-only mode for other models.

description.zh: 海洋幻想蓝玻璃主题包，提供海洋背景、玻璃气泡、海洋侧栏、鲸鱼设置按钮、渐变模型文字和会话页明/暗主题切换；作为 profile bundle 自动加载并在重启后保留。
description.en: An ocean-fantasy blue-glass theme package with an ocean background, glass bubbles, an ocean-styled sidebar, a whale settings button, gradient model text, and a light/dark conversation toggle; it loads as a profile bundle and persists across restarts.

description.zh: 提供浅/深两套背景与配色、可调蒙版、自定义背景、玻璃消息面板和当前会话标题特效，并同时支持 Web 与官方桌面端。
description.en: Provides light and dark backgrounds and palettes, an adjustable mask, custom backgrounds, glass message panels, and an active-conversation title effect for both the Web and official desktop client.

description.zh: 提供 15 套莫兰迪/OKLCH 配色（主菜单精选 12 套）、明暗自适应、磨砂玻璃面板和低强度动效；作者声明明暗主色均达到 WCAG AA，零运行时依赖。
description.en: Offers 15 Morandi/OKLCH palettes, with 12 featured in the main menu, adaptive light and dark variants, frosted-glass panels, and restrained motion; the author states that the main colors meet WCAG AA and runtime dependencies are zero.

description.zh: 昼夜角色界面主题：白昼水晶工坊与黑夜月潮观测室同步切换场景、色板、角色、侧栏伙伴与控件；仅修改展示层，不读取会话、模型请求、凭据或工作区数据。
description.en: A day/night character interface that switches the crystal workshop and moon-tide observatory scenes together with palettes, characters, sidebar companion, and controls; it only changes the presentation layer and does not read sessions, model requests, credentials, or workspace data.

description.zh: 背景设置插件：扫描本地图库并提供缩略图选择、随机背景、缩放/裁切/定位、透明度与高斯模糊调节，以及 cover/contain/fill 显示模式和多图交叉淡化轮播。
description.en: A background-settings plugin that scans a local image folder and provides thumbnail selection, random backgrounds, scale/crop/position controls, opacity and Gaussian blur, cover/contain/fill modes, and cross-fade rotation.

description.zh: 以 WebGL 实现液态透镜折射、水波交互、分层毛玻璃和图片/视频壁纸；支持 Web 与官方桌面版，并提供可调的玻璃、透镜和流体参数。
description.en: Uses WebGL for liquid-lens refraction, interactive ripples, layered glassmorphism, and image/video wallpapers; supports the Web and official desktop client with adjustable glass, lens, and fluid parameters.

description.zh: 夕小瑶皮肤合集中的黑鲸实验室子包，以黑鲸轮廓、石墨黑工作台和樱粉点缀构成研究风格界面；通过真实 bundle 接入 Web profile，仅修改表现层，不读取会话或发起网络请求。
description.en: A skin subpackage from the Xiaoyao collection, with a black-whale silhouette, graphite workspace, and cherry-pink accents; it connects to the Web profile through a real bundle and changes only the presentation layer, without reading sessions or making network requests.

description.zh: 右下角常驻桌宠，可拖拽、投喂、玩耍，并随任务和会话状态切换动画；可选的会话记忆只写入本机文件，不进入模型上下文或上传网络。
description.en: A persistent bottom-right desktop pet that can be dragged, fed, and played with, changing animations with task and session states; optional session memory is written only to a local file and never enters model context or gets uploaded.

name.zh: 550C 开机动画与 UEG 授权界面

description.zh: 提供约 4 秒或 17 秒的 550C 开机片头和可交互 UEG 访问授权界面，支持两套主题、点击/Enter 推进、Esc 跳过，以及本地导入片头音乐和二维码；片头与 UEG 界面互斥。
description.en: Provides a roughly 4-second or 17-second 550C intro and an interactive UEG access screen with two themes, click/Enter progression, Esc to skip, and local intro-music and QR-code imports; the intro and UEG screen are mutually exclusive.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的交互式桌宠，按任务、工具调用、上下文占用和活跃会话切换状态表情；支持状态气泡、会话提示、审批/提问交互，以及拖动、折叠和缩放。
description.en: An interactive pet for DeepSeek Harness Web that changes expressions for tasks, tool calls, context usage, and active sessions; it adds status bubbles, session indicators, approval/question interactions, and drag, collapse, and resize controls.

description.zh: 把请求、工具调用、上下文压缩和提示词增强等 DSH 事件转成桌宠状态，并在浮窗显示上下文占用、Token 分类、跨会话累计与趋势；支持主题、皮肤导入和可选完成提示音。
description.en: A floating pet that turns DSH events such as requests, tool calls, context compaction, and prompt enhancement into status animations, while showing context usage, token categories, cross-session lifetime totals, and trends; it also supports themes, skin imports, and optional completion sounds.

description.zh: DSH Web 与桌面端的常驻小鲸鱼挂件，显示余额、今日用量、每轮消耗和峰谷状态徽标；附带可编辑泡泡、多套动画素材、提示音与火山 coding plan 额度查询。
description.en: A persistent whale widget for DSH Web and the desktop client that shows balance, today's usage, per-turn cost, and peak/off-peak status; it also offers editable speech bubbles, multiple animation packs, sounds, and Volcengine coding-plan quota lookup.

description.zh: 住在 DeepSeek Harness Web 右下角的蓝发鲸鱼女仆桌宠，按开工、工作轮播和收工庆祝展示动画；可显示任务用时、Token 消耗和费用，并提供会话/单轮费用、北京时区趋势、余额、天气、喂食和设置面板。
description.en: A blue-haired whale-girl pet that lives in the lower-right of DeepSeek Harness Web and animates startup, work cycles, and completion celebrations; it shows task duration, token usage, and cost, with session/turn cost pills, Beijing-time trends, balance, weather, feeding, and settings panels.

description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 或独立桌面中的养成小猪，会成长、上学、打工、旅行，也会生病并需要照料；支持鼠标完成玩法，忙碌时可用背包物品自理，且不注册模型工具或向对话注入宠物状态。
description.en: A raising-style pig that lives in DeepSeek Harness or on the standalone desktop: it grows, studies, works, travels, gets sick, and needs care. It is mouse-driven, can care for itself with backpack items while you are busy, and does not register model tools or inject pet state into chats.

description.zh: 长城三境中的深色 DSH Web 主题，以炭黑、中国红和古金构成视觉配色；通过合集安装器切换，定位为表现层皮肤，不替换会话、模型、工具或沙箱。
description.en: A dark DSH Web theme in the Great Wall trio, using charcoal, Chinese red, and antique gold; it is switched through the collection installer and stays in the presentation layer without replacing sessions, models, tools, or the sandbox.

description.zh: 长城三境中的清冷浅色 DSH Web 主题，以雪白、墨灰和正红披风构成配色；通过合集安装器切换，定位为表现层皮肤，不替换会话、模型、工具或沙箱。
description.en: A cool, light DSH Web theme in the Great Wall trio, using snow white, ink gray, and a red cape; it is switched through the collection installer and stays in the presentation layer without replacing sessions, models, tools, or the sandbox.

description.zh: 长城三境中的暖色浅色 DSH Web 主题，以米白宣纸、朱红和朝霞金构成配色；通过合集安装器切换，定位为表现层皮肤，不替换会话、模型、工具或沙箱。
description.en: A warm, light DSH Web theme in the Great Wall trio, using rice-paper white, vermilion, and sunrise gold; it is switched through the collection installer and stays in the presentation layer without replacing sessions, models, tools, or the sandbox.

description.zh: 深海蓝、夕小瑶粉发猫娘和鲸鱼光效组成的沉浸式 DSH Web 皮肤；素材在构建阶段内嵌，样式隔离，停用时恢复背景、标题、favicon 和注入组件，不修改会话、模型、工具或沙箱。
description.en: An immersive DSH Web skin built from deep-sea blue, Xiaoyao's pink-haired catgirl, and whale light effects. Assets are embedded at build time; styles are isolated, teardown restores the background, title, favicon, and injected components, and it does not alter sessions, models, tools, or the sandbox.

description.zh: 蓝鲸女仆与夕小瑶并肩工作的明亮云端研究所主题，以珍珠玻璃、蓝粉晶体和晴空白昼构成轻盈工作台；样式隔离，停用后清理运行期状态，不替换 DSH 后端或功能服务。
description.en: A bright cloud-lab theme where a blue-whale maid and Xiaoyao work side by side, using pearl glass, blue-pink crystals, and a clear-sky palette; styles are isolated, runtime state is cleaned up on disposal, and it does not replace DSH back-end or feature services.

description.zh: 蓝发鲸鱼女仆桌宠，支持待机、工作、完成、出错和撒娇等状态动画，以及戳一戳、摸头、静音、拖动和音量控制；Web/桌面形态可附带会话余额徽章。
description.en: A blue-haired whale-girl pet with idle, work, completion, error, and coquetry animations, plus poke, head-pat, mute, drag, and volume controls; the Web and desktop forms can also include a session balance badge.

description.zh: 让鲸鱼娘常驻 DSH Web 界面，提供 95 个分类动画，并按思考、编码、工具调用、等待和错误等会话状态切换动作；支持点击、拖拽、屏幕漫游、自定义动画与触发规则。
description.en: A floating whale-girl pet for the DSH Web UI with 95 categorized animations that react to thinking, coding, tool calls, waiting and errors; supports click reactions, dragging, screen roaming, custom animations and trigger rules.

description.zh: DSH Web 桌宠插件，提供 106 个手绘透明动画、桌面漫步和点击回应；可通过本地 Ollama 或 DSH 会话模型聊天，也可选择开启屏幕观察与一句话吐槽。
description.en: A DSH Web pet with 106 hand-drawn transparent animations, desktop wandering and click reactions. Chat through a local Ollama model or the DSH session model, with optional screen watching and one-line quips.

name.zh: 时装工坊 · 界面设定

description.zh: DSH Web 主题定制插件，提供 Nous 蓝明暗配色、四套预设、13 色自定义、可调氛围光，以及图片或静音视频背景；支持配色导入导出和跨刷新、重启保存。
description.en: A DSH Web theme customizer with light/dark Nous Blue palettes, four presets, 13 custom colors, adjustable ambient glow, and image or muted-video backgrounds; supports palette import/export and persistence across refreshes and restarts.

description.zh: 把 DSH 会话界面重排为电子表格工作簿：功能区管理文件、会话和运行选项，消息、工具、轨迹和输入区映射到单元格，工作簿标签用于切换多会话。
description.en: Reorganizes the DSH session UI as a spreadsheet workbook: a ribbon manages files, sessions, and run options; messages, tools, trajectories, and input map to cells; workbook tabs switch between sessions.

description.zh: 互动深海鲸鱼女仆桌宠，按大模型调用切换 8 种心情动画，并用 30,000 Token 饱腹池、长驻气泡和任务手账组织陪伴；支持移动端储物橱柜、拖拽与休眠开关。
description.en: An interactive deep-sea whale-maid pet whose eight mood animations follow LLM calls, with a 30,000-token satiety pool, persistent speech bubbles and a task ledger; includes a mobile-responsive cupboard, dragging and a sleep toggle.

description.zh: 《鸣潮》爱弥斯非官方同人像素桌宠，随 Agent 空闲、运行、等待输入、出错和任务完成切换动作；支持随机表演、点击回应、拖拽、停靠或自由摆放，并持久化位置。
description.en: An unofficial Wuthering Waves Aemeath fan pet that changes actions for idle, running, input waits, errors and task completion; supports random performances, click reactions, dragging, docked or free placement, and saved positioning.

description.zh: 鲸鱼娘伴侣结合任务进展、峰谷调度、费用与余额面板及互动养成；提供 130 段动画、可选 Electron 桌面模式（预览）、位置与大小设置，以及多语言界面。
description.en: A whale-girl companion combining task progress, peak/off-peak scheduling, cost and balance panels, and pet interactions. Includes 130 animation clips, an optional Electron desktop preview, position and size controls, and multiple languages.

description.zh: 定时轮换应用背景壁纸，使用交叉淡化过渡；可从本地文件夹读取图片或使用 4 张内置 SVG 渐变，并在设置页调节顺序/随机、透明度、压暗、毛玻璃和文字阴影。
description.en: Rotate application background wallpapers on a timer with cross-fade transitions. Use images from a local folder or four bundled SVG gradients, and adjust sequential or random order, opacity, dimming, blur and text shadow in Settings.

description.zh: 按 Agent 工作、思考、等待审批、出错和完成切换精灵动画，支持多宠物注册、拖拽互动及独立桌面窗口；配套从图片或视频导入或生成宠物，并可浏览、下载和安装社区宠物。
description.en: Switches sprite animations for agent work, thinking, approval waits, errors and completion, with multi-pet registration, dragging and an independent desktop window. Companion tools can create or import pets from images or video, and browse, download and install community pets.

description.zh: 鲸鱼娘会随 DSH 工作状态陪伴：工作时捧碗进食，回合结束收碗，出错时露出屑表情，点击可挥手或比心；待机包含呼吸、飘发和眨眼动画。
description.en: A whale-girl work companion for DSH: she eats from a bowl while work runs, puts it away when the turn ends, gives a smug reaction on errors, and waves or makes a heart when clicked; idle includes breathing, flowing hair and blinking.

description.zh: 由实时会话状态驱动的浮层桌宠，提供 14 个内置形象、自定义图片和 Codex/通用精灵图导入；可在独立宠物页面管理外观与成长，并记录亲密度、等级、经验、成就和任务统计。
description.en: A session-driven floating pet with 14 built-in looks, custom images, and Codex or generic spritesheet imports. Manage appearance and growth in a standalone Pet page, with intimacy, levels, EXP, achievements and task statistics.

description.zh: 在空白对话区展示可调的 ASCII、汉字和 Kanji 鲸鱼、鱼群与尾迹，配套中性磨砂玻璃输入框；支持座头鲸/虎鲸切换、明暗主题、颜色、字体、数量和速度等设置，已有对话后装饰自动退场。
description.en: An adjustable ASCII, Hanzi and Kanji whale scene with schools of fish and wakes in empty chats, paired with a neutral frosted-glass composer. Switch humpback or orca and tune themes, colors, fonts, count and speed; the scene leaves once a conversation exists.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 角落显示套餐用量、账户余额或今日 token；支持 OpenCode Go、Command Code 和 DeepSeek 官方 API，角色可拖动、缩放，并在用量跨过阈值时提醒。
description.en: A DSH Web corner pet that shows plan usage, account balance, or today's tokens. It supports OpenCode Go, Command Code, and the official DeepSeek API, with dragging, zooming, and threshold reminders.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供暖纸、豆绿和暖灰三套背景配色，保留原生布局与组件；支持跟随浅色、深色或系统外观，并在同一来源的多个窗口间同步选择。
description.en: Three background palettes—Warm Paper, Sage Green, and Warm Grey—keep DSH's native layout and components intact. The selection follows light, dark, or system appearance and syncs across windows on the same origin.

description.zh: 陪伴 DSH Web 会话的动态宠物，按接收、思考、检索、编码、回复、审批和错误等状态切换 Emotion Ball 的 32 种表情；支持拖动、点击、投喂、玩耍，并可缩小到会话状态行旁。
description.en: A dynamic companion for DSH Web sessions that switches among 32 Emotion Ball expressions for receiving, thinking, retrieval, coding, replies, approvals, and errors. Drag, pet, feed, or play with it, or shrink it beside the conversation status row.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端和 Web 端分别设置中英文字体、代码字体、字号与强调色；内置 One Dark Pro、Dracula、Nord、GitHub 和 Catppuccin 五套明暗配色，并覆盖代码块与语法高亮。
description.en: Set separate Latin and Chinese UI/body fonts, a code font, text size, and accent colors on DSH desktop or Web. Includes light/dark palettes for One Dark Pro, Dracula, Nord, GitHub, and Catppuccin, plus code-block and syntax-highlighting coverage.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 的顶栏、侧栏、输入框、停靠条和会话垫层变为可调磨砂玻璃，支持 Mica/兼容模式、流体或图片/视频壁纸、折射参数和悬停弹性。
description.en: A switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH Web UI, covering the header, sidebar, composer, docks, and conversation pads with adjustable frosted panes. It offers Mica or compatibility mode, fluid/image/video backdrops, refraction controls, and hover elasticity.

description.zh: 把 Taffy 表情挂在 DSH Web 右下角，随输入、思考、工具执行、审批、错误、完成和休眠等状态自动切换；支持拖动、互动菜单、大小/透明度及鼠标穿透设置。
description.en: Pins a Taffy mood mascot in the bottom-right of DSH Web and switches expressions for typing, thinking, tool runs, approvals, errors, completion, and sleep. Includes dragging, an interaction menu, size/opacity controls, and click-through.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 与桌面端提供 Everforest 森林色主题，包含深浅两套基调、Soft/Medium/Hard 三档强度；聊天标题、代码、链接、表格和会话状态行按配色重绘，设置可即时生效并跨重启保存。
description.en: An Everforest forest-toned theme for DSH Web and desktop, with dark and light bases in Soft, Medium, and Hard strengths. It recolors headings, code, links, tables, and session-status rows, with instant application and persisted settings.

name.zh: Bloom Glass 国色玻璃主题

description.zh: 提供十套中国传统色配色，每套含明暗两态；可叠加本地图片或动图壁纸与磨砂玻璃，并覆盖侧栏、会话区、设置弹窗及 DS Bot 面板，支持调节玻璃浓度、模糊、饱和度和压暗。
description.en: Ten Chinese traditional-color palettes, each with light and dark variants, can be combined with local image/GIF wallpapers under frosted glass. The effect covers the sidebar, conversations, settings dialogs, and DS Bot panels, with glass strength, blur, saturation, and dimming controls.

description.zh: 提供 Solid、Glass、Volume、Neon 四套明暗配色；Neon 深色仅在模型运行时显示青色扫描线，并配有 HUD 侧栏，选择保存在 profile 中，可跨重启和 profile 切换保留。
description.en: Provides light and dark variants of four palettes—Solid, Glass, Volume, and Neon. The Neon dark half adds a cyan scanline only while the model is working, plus a HUD sidebar; the choice persists across restarts and profile switches.

name.zh: 自定义 CSS 编辑器

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中编辑并即时应用保存于宿主磁盘的 CSS 文件，提供语法高亮、补全、规则面板、元素拾取、查找替换、撤销重做和多文件管理；另提供无需编写 CSS 的壁纸面板。
description.en: Edit CSS files stored on the host disk from DSH Web settings and apply changes immediately, with syntax highlighting, completion, rule panels, element picking, search/replace, undo/redo, and multi-file management; a wallpaper panel works without writing CSS.

description.zh: 内置十款明暗配色，可在设置页内新建、编辑、改名和删除主题，支持玻璃质感与逐项主题令牌覆盖。
description.en: Choose from ten light and dark palettes, or create, edit, rename and delete themes in an inline settings editor, with optional glass effects and per-token overrides.

description.zh: 切换内嵌的 DeepSeek 官网聊天与原生项目工作，配有支持任务状态提醒的动画桌面伙伴，并支持导入 Codex v1/v2 宠物包。
description.en: Switch between embedded DeepSeek website chat and native project work, with an animated desktop companion for task-status notifications and support for importing Codex v1/v2 pet packs.

description.zh: 为侧栏、输入框和对话卡片统一添加毛玻璃材质，可选本地图片或循环视频壁纸，并按区域调节效果。
description.en: Apply a consistent frosted-glass material to the sidebar, composer and conversation cards, with optional local image or looping video wallpapers and per-region controls.

description.zh: 融合 Material Design 3 与 Fluent 2，支持动态取色、壁纸磨砂、声纹可视化及明暗切换。
description.en: Combines Material Design 3 and Fluent 2 with dynamic colors, frosted wallpaper effects, audio visualization and light/dark switching.

description.zh: 以白灰蓝雾色背景、整窗磨砂、悬浮玻璃侧栏与回复气泡呈现 iOS 风格，支持明暗两套配色。
description.en: An iOS-style look with a shared white-grey-blue fog background, whole-window frosting, a floating glass sidebar and reply bubbles, in light and dark palettes.

description.zh: 在一个设置分区中管理两套配色、壁纸、玻璃材质、动效及会话排版；关闭后恢复原生外观。
description.en: Manage two color palettes, wallpapers, glass effects, animations and conversation typography in one settings section; disable it to restore the native appearance.

description.zh: 明日香红黑暗色与绫波丽白蓝亮色两套主题，配有驾驶员选择开场、角色语音和时钟；系统音乐播放器目前仅支持 macOS。
description.en: Asuka's red-and-black dark theme and Rei Ayanami's white-and-blue light theme, with a pilot-selection intro, character voices and a clock; the system music player currently supports macOS only.

description.zh: 在界面下铺设海洋场景，包含鱼群、鲸鱼、鲨鱼、水母、海带和沉船；鼠标移动会激起水波，配色随明暗主题切换。
description.en: An ocean scene beneath the interface, with schools of fish, whales, sharks, jellyfish, kelp and a sunken ship. Pointer movement creates ripples, and the palette follows the light or dark theme.

description.zh: 珍珠白粉色亮色与深紫暗色配色，搭配昔涟 Live2D 桌宠、粉紫粒子和渐变背景；桌宠动作随会话状态变化。
description.en: Pearl-white and pink light colors and a deep-purple dark palette, with a Cyrene Live2D companion, pink-purple particles and gradient backgrounds. Companion animations follow session activity.

description.zh: 为桌面版提供银河、层峦、黑洞等十种动态场景，支持导入图片和视频壁纸，并分别调节侧栏、对话区及输入区等区域的不透明度。
description.en: Ten animated desktop background scenes, including a galaxy, layered mountains and a black hole, plus imported image or video wallpapers and separate opacity controls for interface regions.

description.zh: 在宽度不超过 1023px 时启用覆盖式侧栏抽屉、滑动手势与安全区适配，提供对话轮次导航和 PWA 主屏幕安装支持。
description.en: Adds overlay navigation drawers, swipe gestures and safe-area handling at widths up to 1023px, with conversation-turn navigation and PWA home-screen installation.

description.zh: 可切换四套启动画面与背景皮肤：NEON GRID、ABYSS PROTOCOL、VERMILION DAWN 和 VELVET MUSE；支持视频/静态图背景、右下角切换器和重播启动画面。
description.en: Switch among four boot-and-background skins—NEON GRID, ABYSS PROTOCOL, VERMILION DAWN and VELVET MUSE—with video/still backgrounds, a corner switcher and replayable boot sequences.

description.zh: 六幕启动动画依次经过 DeepSeek 标识、过曝转场、暖白「技术档案」底板、交互式访问授权和故障揭幕；支持暖白/暗色主题、确认步骤与跳过。
description.en: A six-stage startup animation moves through the DeepSeek mark, an overexposure transition, a warm-white “technical file” panel, interactive access authorization and a glitch reveal, with light/dark themes, confirmations and skip controls.

description.zh: 提供五套浅色与五套深色主题，按系统或时间表切换；可调强调色、背景、字体、字号、内容宽度和对比度，并重配语法高亮与 diff 色彩，支持纸张颗粒和 JSON 导入导出。
description.en: Provides five light and five dark themes with system or scheduled switching; adjusts accent/background colors, fonts, type sizes, content width and contrast, retunes syntax and diff colors, and supports paper grain plus JSON import/export.

name.zh: 灰姑娘女孩多角色主题

description.zh: 以《偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩》角色为核心的多角色主题与 Windows 桌宠，默认佐城雪美；可搜索并收藏角色，按角色印象色适配界面，并提供卡面/背景素材与沉浸阅读模式。
description.en: A multi-character THE IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls theme and Windows companion, defaulting to Yukimi Sajo; search and favorite idols, adapt the UI to each idol’s image color, and use card/background assets with immersive reading.

description.zh: 把 DSH 高对比工程界面换成暖白纸面、燕麦暖灰侧栏、炭黑文字与陶土色焦点，配合中西文阅读字体栈和纯白输入卡片；只注入主题变量，不轮询后台或增加动效。
description.en: Replaces DSH’s high-contrast engineering UI with warm paper, oat-gray sidebars, charcoal text and terracotta accents, plus bilingual reading fonts and a white input card; it only injects theme tokens, with no background polling or added motion.

description.zh: 把 Live2D 鲸鱼娘挂在 DSH Web 界面角落，按 agent 的真实状态切换表情与动作：思考低头、工具调用换装、流式输出动嘴、报错变脸、完成时庆祝；支持 44 个表情、8 个动作。
description.en: A Live2D Whale Girl companion for the DSH Web UI reacts to the agent’s real state: head-down thinking, tool-specific actions, mouth movement during streaming, an error reaction and a celebration on completion, with 44 expressions and 8 motions.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成《绝区零》Fairy 的 H.D.D 终端，包含带音效的开机动画、按时段问候、可拖动且随 agent 状态变化的眼徽、Fairy 模式预设，以及可选的本地 GPT-SoVITS 朗读。
description.en: A Zenless Zone Zero Fairy H.D.D skin for the DSH Web UI with a sound-enabled boot animation, time-of-day greeting, draggable status eye, Fairy mode preset and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供可分别配置的任务与 Artifact 卡片、输入栏和侧栏材质，另有全图/粒子背景、日夜主题、开屏与对话动效；支持导入导出本机配置与素材。
description.en: Adds separately configurable materials for task and Artifact cards, the composer and the sidebar, plus full-page/particle backgrounds, light/dark themes, intro and conversation motion; supports importing and exporting local settings and assets.

name.zh: VS Code 滚动条与缩略图

description.zh: 将 DSH 会话区滚动条改为 14px 常显、扁平半透明的 VS Code 风格，并在右侧加入可拖动视口滑块的整段会话缩略图；菜单、代码块、侧栏和输入框滚动条保持原样。
description.en: Restyles the DSH conversation scrollbar as a 14px always-visible, flat translucent VS Code bar and adds a full-conversation minimap with a draggable viewport slider; menus, code blocks, sidebars and the composer keep their stock scrollbars.

name.zh: 哥伦比娅 · 月隐银蓝

description.zh: 将 DSH Web GUI 换成哥伦比娅的月隐银蓝渐变毛玻璃主题，附可编辑人格、12 张高清表情包和星眸欢迎页；背景可从用户自备图片中选择、轮换和调淡，不改 DSH 本体。
description.en: A Columbina moonlit silver-blue glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web GUI with editable persona settings, 12 high-resolution stickers and a starry-eye welcome page; it can select, rotate and fade user-supplied backgrounds without modifying DSH.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web UI 重塑为 Mineradio「私人视觉电台」风格：近黑演播室上的香槟金玻璃面板，支持流体或图片/视频壁纸、云母与兼容双模式、粒子装饰和鼠标辉光。
description.en: A cinematic Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web UI: champagne-glass panels over a near-black studio, with fluid or image/video wallpapers, Mica and Compatibility modes, particle decor and pointer glow.

description.zh: 在深潜状态行下方用 ikun 桌宠显示估算进度，每 20% 切换动作和文案，回答完成时播放系统级语音提示。
description.en: An ikun pet shows estimated progress below the deep-diving status line, changing animation and text every 20% and playing a system-level voice cue when the reply finishes.

name.zh: 角色插画与纯色主题集

description.zh: 角色壁纸、场景横幅和侧栏伙伴组成的主题集，也可只保留配色；支持浅色、深色、跟随系统、收藏和定时轮换。
description.en: A collection of character wallpapers, scene banners and sidebar companions, with color-only variants, light/dark/system modes, favorites and timed theme rotation.

description.zh: 刀剑神域风格界面，提供两种 Link Start 启动动画、桐人／亚丝娜语音、液态与磨砂玻璃、自定义壁纸和模型强度滑条。
description.en: A Sword Art Online–styled interface with two Link Start intros, Kirito/Asuna voice lines, liquid or frosted glass, custom wallpapers and a slider for model intensity.

description.zh: 原生 WebGPU 实时渲染的紫蓝星云皮肤：银河尘带斜贯视野，远近星点带视差与轻微闪烁，并有随机流星；深空配色适配 light/dark/system，无运行时 CDN、图片或额外依赖。
description.en: A purple-blue nebula skin rendered live with native WebGPU: a Milky Way dust band crosses the view, near and far stars have parallax and a slight twinkle, and meteors appear at random. Its deep-space colors adapt to light, dark, and system mode, with no runtime CDN, images, or extra dependencies.

description.zh: ZCode 风格的侧栏与工作区会话树，支持置顶、分组、拖动排序、全局搜索和对话轮次跳转，明暗配色跟随宿主。
description.en: A ZCode-style sidebar and workspace session tree with pinning, grouping, drag-to-reorder, global search and turn navigation, in light and dark palettes that follow the host.

description.zh: 以 DeepSeek 官网为灵感，深色搭配流体极光、粒子鲸鱼和星座网格，浅色采用蓝色渐变与玻璃面板，随宿主外观切换。
description.en: Inspired by the DeepSeek website, with fluid aurora, a particle whale and a constellation grid in dark mode, blue gradients and glass panels in light mode, and switching tied to the host’s appearance setting.

description.zh: 非官方《崩坏：星穹铁道》大黑塔同人主题，提供紫黑与晨光双配色、统一玻璃材质、藏镜图库和独立动态待机。
description.en: An unofficial Honkai: Star Rail theme featuring The Herta, with purple-black and morning-light palettes, glass surfaces, an image gallery and a separate animated idle mode.

description.zh: Web 端的星尘与极光视差开场，衔接同图的浅色主界面壁纸；可更换头像和背景，预览节日效果，并自定义打字机问候语。
description.en: An animated Web welcome screen with stardust, aurora and layered parallax, plus matching light-mode wallpaper, custom portrait and background images, live previews, seasonal effects and a typewriter greeting.

name.zh: 桑多涅 · 衬线排版补丁

description.zh: 以随包的 Source Serif 4 Variable 为正文主字体，让代码与横幅字号随设置等比缩放，并覆盖皮肤的代码字族；另含表格调整与长会话屏外渲染优化。
description.en: Uses bundled Source Serif 4 Variable for body text, scales code and banner text with the user’s font-size setting, and overrides skin code-font rules; also adjusts tables and defers offscreen message rendering.

description.zh: 低照度深海配色，以青蓝高光和细描边区分层次；纯 CSS 调整底色、文本、菜单和输入框，不改变原有布局。
description.en: A low-light deep-sea palette with cyan-blue accents and fine borders, restyling backgrounds, text, menus and inputs through CSS without changing the layout.

description.zh: 用悬浮水豚气泡显示工作区、会话和回复里程碑，区分完成、失败与取消等结果；可选 Electron 跨窗口置顶、自定义图片和离开页面通知。
description.en: A floating capybara reports workspace/session labels, assistant milestones and distinct completion, failure or cancellation outcomes, with an optional always-on-top Electron companion, custom artwork and away notifications.

name.zh: 交叉淡入开场与闲置屏保

description.zh: 以全屏短片替换启动页，片尾交叉溶解进入界面；另可开启闲置屏保，支持视频、图片和动图轮换，以及粒子、下坠或 Glitch 退出效果。
description.en: Replaces the startup page with a full-screen clip that crossfades into the interface. An optional idle screensaver can rotate videos, stills or animated images and exit with particle, gravity-drop or Glitch effects.

description.zh: 用滚筒洗衣机的动作显示模型输出、工具运行、等待确认与任务完成。提供四套造型和多会话状态，macOS 与 Windows 可使用置顶悬浮窗，并可开启通知与提示音。
description.en: A washing machine animates model output, tool activity, approval waits, and task completion. Includes four designs and multi-session status, with an always-on-top window on macOS and Windows and optional notifications and sounds.

description.zh: 提供 Catppuccin、Gruvbox、Everforest、Nord、Dracula 等 16 套配色，在设置页点选切换，部分配色含亮暗版本。当前主题选择不会保留，刷新后需重新选择。
description.en: Choose from 16 palettes, including Catppuccin, Gruvbox, Everforest, Nord, and Dracula, in Settings. Some palettes include light and dark variants. The selection is not persisted and must be reapplied after a page refresh.

description.zh: 自定义运行状态行的图标、文字、颜色与扫光，可上传图片并调整图标旋转。默认显示旋转太极和红色「少女祈祷中」，原有用时计数保持不变。
description.en: Customize the running-status icon, text, color, and highlight sweep, including uploaded images and rotation controls. Defaults to a spinning taiji symbol and red “Maiden at Prayer” text, while keeping the elapsed-time counter.

description.zh: 提供 Nord、Dracula、Catppuccin、Coffee 等 19 款主题，每款都含亮色与暗色配色。可在设置页切换并保存选择，亮暗模式切换时保留所选主题。
description.en: Includes 19 themes such as Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, and Coffee, each with light and dark palettes. Switch and save the theme in Settings; changing appearance mode keeps the selected theme.

description.zh: 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的外观与交互，提供 Claude 和 DeepSeek 两套主题，亮暗外观跟随系统。附带随任务状态变化的 Deepy 小鲸鱼，也可换成像素螃蟹或像素鲸娘。
description.en: Recreates the look and interactions of Claude Code Desktop with Claude and DeepSeek themes that follow system appearance. Includes a task-reactive Deepy whale, with pixel crab and pixel whale-girl alternatives.

description.zh: 桌宠随任务状态切换动作，配套面板显示 Token、费用与缓存命中等统计。还支持历史对话搜索、推理等级切换，以及预算和低余额提醒。
description.en: A task-reactive pet comes with a panel for token usage, costs, and cache statistics. Also supports conversation-history search, reasoning-level controls, and budget and low-balance alerts.

description.zh: 一只坐在铁盆里的悬浮小鲸鱼，Agent 工作时摇摆，出错时会被掉落的钢管砸中。可以敲盆、触发找饭互动，也能自备宠物图片、歌曲和音效；未提供音频时保持无声。
description.en: A floating whale in a metal basin sways while the agent works and gets bonked by a falling pipe on errors. Tap the basin to trigger food-seeking interactions, and supply custom images, songs, or effects; without audio files it stays silent.

description.zh: 以莱茵生命为灵感，提供开屏动画、暖白与暖炭黑配色、切角边框和可选品牌标志，各模块可独立开关。另带任务通知、待办中心、推理强度控制与费用余额面板。
description.en: A Rhine Lab-inspired theme with a startup animation, warm light and dark palettes, chamfered borders, and optional brand marks. Modules can be toggled separately, alongside task notifications, a task center, reasoning controls, and cost and balance panels.

description.zh: 将短片设为静音循环背景，并用另一段视频播放可跳过的有声开场。支持更换素材、分别开关两种效果，以及实时调整界面透明度；浏览器限制自动播放时，开场会退回静音。
description.en: Use a silent looping video as the background and a separate video as a skippable intro with sound. Replace media, toggle each effect, and adjust interface opacity live; the intro falls back to mute when browser autoplay rules require it.

description.zh: 将技术档案式版面延伸到主界面，采用暖白或暗色底板、细线机框、等宽读数和准星罗盘。可与配套开机动画衔接装配，也能单独使用，并支持橙、红、蓝强调色。
description.en: A technical-dossier interface with warm light or dark panels, fine-line framing, monospaced readouts, and crosshair compasses. It can assemble seamlessly from the companion startup animation or run on its own, with orange, red, or blue accents.

description.zh: 面向 DSH 0.2.2-alpha.3 Web 的蓝色主题基础包，提供新会话浅/深色样式、设置导航图标和统一开关外观，并可与 dafy-whale-theme 协同显示；停用后恢复原始界面。
description.en: A blue-theme foundation for the DSH 0.2.2-alpha.3 Web client. It styles the new-session view in light and dark modes, adds settings-navigation icons and themed switches, and can coordinate with dafy-whale-theme; disabling it restores the original interface.

description.zh: 提供可跳过的全屏开机动画，内置视频、壁纸、语音与两只可拖动桌宠，也支持上传自己的素材。视频音轨和独立开机音频可分别开关，应用就绪后动画会淡出。
description.en: A skippable full-screen startup animation with bundled videos, wallpapers, voice clips, and two draggable pets, plus custom uploads. Video sound and separate startup audio have independent switches, and the animation fades out when the application is ready.

description.zh: 管理壁纸与半透明面板主题，可从本机、文件夹或 ZIP 导入 Codex-Skins，并用文字、图片或视频辅助生成主题。支持静态与动态背景、可见度调节、重命名和导出。
description.en: Manage wallpaper and translucent-panel themes, import Codex-Skins from local installations, folders, or ZIP files, and generate themes using text with optional images or video. Supports static and animated backgrounds, visibility controls, renaming, and export.

description.zh: Windows 桌宠可搭配六款人物与五种信息卡，显示 DeepSeek 余额、Codex 额度和本机用量统计。内置订阅账号管理，账号轮换与预热需单独授权，默认不开启。
description.en: A Windows pet with six character designs and five card styles displays DeepSeek balances, Codex quotas, and local usage statistics. Includes subscription-account management; account rotation and warm-up require separate opt-in authorization and are off by default.

name.zh: 多宠物与 Live2D 伴侣

description.zh: 支持精灵图与 Live2D 的多宠物伴侣，随思考、工具调用、完成和失败切换动画。可为宠物命名、拖动、摸头与喂食，并记录亲密度；还可安装自定义宠物和台词包。
description.en: A multi-pet companion supporting sprites and Live2D, with animations for thinking, tool activity, completion, and failure. Name, drag, pet, and feed companions, build affinity, and install custom pets and dialogue packs.

description.zh: 将本机 Wallpaper Engine 的场景、网页与视频壁纸放到对话背景中，并提供液态玻璃、字体和外观预设。场景与网页支持实时渲染，部分效果可能降级；应用型壁纸不支持。
description.en: Bring local Wallpaper Engine scene, web, and video wallpapers into the chat background, with liquid glass, typography controls, and appearance presets. Scene and web wallpapers render live with possible fallbacks; application wallpapers are not supported.

description.zh: 让标签页图标、侧栏标志与首页形象随会话状态播放 bloub 动画，可自定义表情、形状、颜色和文字。另带 macOS 与 Windows 桌面入口，复用当前网页后端。
description.en: Animate tab icons, sidebar branding, and the home-page avatar with bloub reactions to session activity. Customize expressions, shapes, colors, and text, and create macOS or Windows desktop entries that share the existing web backend.

description.zh: 扫描本机 Wallpaper Engine 已下载的工坊与项目壁纸，在设置页搜索并设为背景。支持图片、静音循环视频和暗化调节；场景与网页壁纸只显示预览图，不进行实时渲染。
description.en: Browse and search locally downloaded Wallpaper Engine workshop and project wallpapers, then use them as backgrounds. Supports images, silent looping videos, and dimming controls; scene and web wallpapers use preview images rather than live rendering.

description.zh: 在设置中选择无背景、纯色或本地图片，并调整背景不透明度。图片会自动压缩，配置保存在浏览器中，刷新后恢复并在多个标签页间同步。
description.en: Choose no background, a solid color, or a local image, and adjust background opacity. Images are compressed automatically; preferences are stored in the browser, restored after refresh, and synchronized across tabs.

description.zh: 塔菲同人主题，提供星夜背景、侧栏水印和 Q 版形象，并搭配粉金亚克力装饰。可分别调整自己的消息气泡、输入框和侧栏边框，不接管原生按钮交互。
description.en: An unofficial Taffy fan theme with night-sky backdrops, sidebar watermarks, chibi artwork, and pink-and-gold acrylic decoration. Customize your message bubbles, composer, and sidebar frames separately without replacing native button interactions.

description.zh: 把工作空间呈现为可游玩的 Minecraft 风格体素世界，可移动、挖掘和放置方块。运行中的会话化作带状态牌的小狗，模型和推理强度对应装备与附魔，同时保留原生对话和审批功能。
description.en: Explore a playable Minecraft-inspired voxel workspace with movement, mining, and block placement. Running sessions appear as dogs with progress signs, while models and reasoning levels become equipment and enchantments. Native chat and approval controls remain available.

description.zh: 可视化调整七个界面区域的背景、透明度、文字与框线，另有可拖动的快捷设置浮窗。配置自动保存在浏览器中，预设可连同图片导出为 .tczp 文件并在其他电脑导入。
description.en: Visually customize backgrounds, transparency, text, and borders across seven interface regions, with a draggable quick-settings panel. Preferences save automatically in the browser, and presets can include images in .tczp files for import on another computer.

description.zh: 以 DreamSkin 配色和鲸鱼娘插画构成亮色主题，壁纸衬在轻纸面之后。可实时调节玻璃、壁纸和对话纸面透明度；仅提供亮色外观，插画采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可。
description.en: A light-only theme pairing the DreamSkin palette with whale-girl artwork behind a translucent paper layer. Adjust glass, wallpaper, and conversation-paper transparency live. The artwork is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

description.zh: 一只会随 DSH 工作状态陪伴的桌宠：待机时安静互动，工具运行时抱起笔记本并保持安静；支持拖拽、养成、成就、小游戏与跨端存档，默认无遥测且不发起外部请求。
description.en: A desktop pet that follows DSH work states: it interacts quietly while idle, picks up a laptop and stays quiet when tools run, and supports dragging, progression, achievements, mini-games, and cross-device saves. No telemetry or external requests by default.

description.zh: 提供 25 套《终端美学》配色、中文优先等宽字体、紧凑对话布局，以及可折叠的思考块与工具链胶囊；还可显示官方账户余额、本轮成本和近 30 天用量图表。
description.en: Provides 25 Terminal Aesthetics palettes, Chinese-first monospaced font options, a compact conversation layout, and collapsible thinking/tool-chain capsules. It can also show official account balance, per-turn cost, and a 30-day usage chart.

description.zh: 以 DeepSeek 首页为灵感的 DSH Web 主题：深蓝渐变、半透明玻璃、程序化流体背景、鼠标弹性网格和两条会避让指针的小鱼；效果可开关，并适配减少动态效果。
description.en: A DSH Web theme inspired by the DeepSeek homepage, with a deep-blue gradient, translucent glass, a procedural fluid background, a mouse-reactive elastic grid, and two fish that avoid the pointer. Effects are toggleable and respect reduced-motion preferences.

description.zh: 把 DSH 的思考块与工具输出分段播放，让视口跟随新内容，并在运行开始时展开、下一条内容出现后收起；另可切换 Claude 配色、字体与单个动态 Logo。
description.en: Replays DSH thinking blocks and tool output in segments, follows new content, expands blocks when work starts, and closes them when the next item appears. Optional layers switch the Claude palette, fonts, and a single animated logo.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 状态文字旁播放两套黑白鲸鱼循环动画：Refined Dive 与 Classic；支持深色主题、84/72/60 像素响应式尺寸、减少动态效果和离线内嵌，后台标签页恢复可见后会立即更新。
description.en: Plays two black-and-white whale loops beside DSH Web status text: Refined Dive and Classic. It supports dark themes, responsive 84/72/60 px sizing, reduced motion, offline embedding, and immediate refresh when a background tab becomes visible.

description.zh: 一套 DSH Web 个性化与效率工具：提供背景、天气和玻璃效果、项目文件夹、提示词库、会话导出与搜索、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复、批量归档、Ctrl/Cmd+K 快捷面板，以及本地用量分析、预算和备份。
description.en: A DSH Web suite for personalization and productivity: backgrounds, weather and glass effects, project folders, a prompt library, conversation export/search, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, batch archiving, a Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette, plus local usage analytics, budgets, and backups.

description.zh: 非官方《鸣潮》清宵同人 DSH Web 皮肤，采用冰蓝、青碧、月白与玄夜蓝配色，支持可替换背景、开屏动画、毛玻璃面板、粒子装饰和可选人格库。
description.en: An unofficial Wuthering Waves Qingxiao fan skin for DSH Web, using ice-blue, jade, moon-white, and dark-blue palettes with swappable backgrounds, an intro animation, frosted panels, optional particles, and a persona library.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 与桌面界面改成磨砂玻璃风格，提供 SVG 边缘折射、实时可调玻璃参数和多种壁纸来源；桌面端还把会话栏并入系统标题栏并提供全屏按钮，网页版同样支持单行顶栏。
description.en: A frosted-glass skin for DSH Web and Desktop with SVG edge refraction, live glass controls, and multiple wallpaper sources. Desktop also merges the session bar into the system title bar and adds a fullscreen button; the web UI gets a one-row header as well.

description.zh: 提供 34 款同时适配浅色与深色外观的预设主题，支持跟随系统；可调 macOS 侧边栏透明度，并能创建、导入和分享带背景图片或视频的自定义主题。
description.en: Provides 34 preset themes adapted to both light and dark appearance, with a system-following option. It also controls macOS sidebar transparency and lets users create, import, and share custom themes with image or video backgrounds.

description.zh: 个人、非商业的非官方《明日方舟》P.R.T.S. 同人 UI 主题，将 DSH Web 的工作区、会话与对话组织成罗德岛设施终端；提供日夜模式、三套预设、四档材质、响应式与减少动效适配，且无运行时网络请求。
description.en: A personal, non-commercial, unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S. fan UI theme that presents DSH Web workspaces, sessions, and conversations as a Rhodes Island facility terminal. It includes day/night modes, three presets, four material levels, responsive and reduced-motion support, and no runtime network requests.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 换成 Windows 98 风格：青绿桌面、深蓝标题栏、银灰 3D 控件、MS Sans Serif 字体、带箭头的复古滚动条和 Win98 设置对话框；桌面模式默认开启，也可关闭仅保留换肤。
description.en: A Windows 98–style DSH Web skin with a teal desktop, navy title bar, silver 3D controls, MS Sans Serif, arrowed retro scrollbars, and a Win98 settings dialog. Desktop mode is enabled by default and can be turned off to keep only the skin.

description.zh: 以 Marathon 风格的大色块、硬边界和工业排版重做 DSH 外观，提供工作区色条、调色盘联动动效、每日 token 活动图与随机 Max 效果，支持 Windows 和 macOS。
description.en: Recasts DSH in a Marathon-inspired industrial style with block colors, hard edges, workspace color bars, palette-driven motion, a daily token activity chart, and randomized Max effects. Supports Windows and macOS.

description.zh: 把 DSH 界面换成 550C 控制台外观，提供琥珀、绿、青、白四套磷光配色，以及可开关的扫描线、暗角、等宽字体和机器读数栏；设置可实时生效并记住选择。
description.en: Recasts the DSH interface as a 550C console with amber, green, cyan, and white phosphor schemes, optional scan lines and vignette, monospace text, and readout rails. Settings apply live and persist locally.

name.zh: 昔涟 · 粉白毛玻璃主题

description.zh: 以《崩坏：星穹铁道》昔涟为主题的 DSH 粉白渐变毛玻璃皮肤，支持在侧栏编辑人格、管理表情包与长期记忆，并提供可上传、轮换且可绑定深色模式的整页背景。非官方同人项目。
description.en: An unofficial DSH frosted-glass skin themed around Cyrene from Honkai: Star Rail, with a pink-and-white gradient UI, sidebar persona editing, sticker and long-term-memory management, and full-page backgrounds that can be uploaded, rotated, and bound to dark mode.

name.zh: 按模型切换的背景规则

description.zh: 按当前模型名称匹配有序规则并切换背景；每条规则可配置多张图片，每张图片可独立设置布局、裁切、主题色、不透明度、亮度、模糊和轮换。支持规则集导入导出与本机存储。
description.en: Match ordered rules against the current model and switch backgrounds accordingly. Each rule can hold multiple images, with per-image layout, framing, theme color, opacity, brightness, blur, and rotation settings. Rule sets can be imported, exported, and stored locally.

description.zh: 从 DSH 侧栏打开壁纸抽屉，选择系统预设、纯色、渐变、图片或视频背景；支持缩放定位、适配模式、毛玻璃、亮暗文字方案，以及由模型调用的 bg_apply 工具。本地媒体保存在本机。
description.en: Open a wallpaper drawer from the DSH sidebar and choose system presets, solid colors, gradients, images, or videos. Adjust zoom and position, fit modes, glass effects, and light/dark text schemes, or let the model use the bg_apply tool. Media stays on the local machine.

description.zh: 以白蓝配色、毛玻璃侧栏与输入框重塑 DSH 外观，右侧显示带渐隐处理的鲸鱼娘女仆立绘，并替换新会话与插件页图标；无构建与运行时依赖，卸载后可还原原生界面。代码与美术分别许可。
description.en: A lightweight blue-and-white DSH theme with frosted sidebars and composer, a softly faded whale-maid illustration on the right, and custom new-session and plugin icons. It has no build or runtime dependency and restores the native interface when uninstalled; code and artwork are licensed separately.

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供 Claude Code Desktop 风格的浅深色界面，含模型与思考强度选择器、像素鲸鱼互动、附件与输入框优化、上下文分解和用量卡片；面向 macOS 与 Windows。
description.en: A Claude Code Desktop-style light/dark interface for DSH Desktop, with model and effort pickers, an interactive pixel whale, attachment and composer refinements, context breakdowns, and usage cards. Targets macOS and Windows.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 角落提供可交互的 3D 虎鲸桌宠，支持拖拽旋转、右键定位、爱心、弹跳和发送消息时翻跟头；可调整大小、灵敏度与显示文字。可单独安装，也已并入 dsh-ventus-plugins 整合包。
description.en: An interactive 3D orca pet for the corner of the DSH Web GUI, with drag rotation, right-click positioning, hearts, bouncing, and a celebratory flip when a message is sent. Adjust its size, sensitivity, and display text. It is available standalone and in the dsh-ventus-plugins bundle.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 与 0.2 Desktop 下方铺设独立动态壁纸层，支持内置图片、自定义图片/视频和可选的 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库；可调遮罩、模糊、亮度、安全放大与播放队列，WE 库需配套插件。
description.en: Place an independent animated wallpaper layer beneath DSH Web and the 0.2 Desktop app, using built-in images, custom images or videos, and an optional Wallpaper Engine library. Adjust overlays, blur, brightness, safe zoom, and playback queues; the WE library requires a companion plugin.

description.zh: 为 macOS 与 Windows 11 x64 提供对应系统风格的 DSH 设置界面、主题配色、壁纸和字体配置，含 27 个浅深色主题、从壁纸生成配色和可选蓝鲸桌宠；外观与桌宠可分别开关。
description.en: A DSH customization suite for macOS and Windows 11 x64 with platform-styled settings, themes, wallpapers, and fonts, including 27 light/dark themes, wallpaper-based palette generation, and an optional blue-whale pet. Appearance and pet features can be toggled separately.

name.zh: 魔法使之夜视觉小说皮肤
name.en: Witch on the Holy Night Visual-Novel Skin

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面改造成《魔法使之夜》视觉小说式画面，提供昼夜场景、三名角色的立绘与表情、原作风格菜单、BGM、人格 skill 和固定 78% 上下文片尾彩蛋；支持角色切换与紧急关闭。非官方项目。
description.en: Transforms the DSH Web interface into a Witch on the Holy Night visual-novel scene with day/night backgrounds, three characters with portraits and expressions, an original-style menu, BGM, persona skills, and a fixed 78% context end-credit easter egg. Supports character switching and an emergency shutoff. Unofficial project.

description.zh: 奶黄、奶油白与嫩绿色的奶蛙主题，支持浅色与深色模式；为空会话加入半颗奶蛙背景、标题/图标与发送按钮替换，并在顶层会话开始和完成时播放提示音。尊重系统的“减少动态效果”设置；空状态标题修改依赖当前 Web UI 结构。
description.en: A cream, ivory, and fresh-green frog theme for light and dark modes. It adds a half-frog empty-state backdrop, frog title, icon, and send-button treatments, and plays short sounds when a top-level session starts and completes. It respects system reduced-motion settings; the empty-state title change depends on the current Web UI structure.

description.zh: 赛博朋克外观，提供流动 RGB 霓虹、CRT 扫描线、暗色霓虹城市背景和可自定义背景图库；右上角可拖动、可收起的 HUD 集成外观切换与本地音乐播放器。歌单和播放状态持久化，刷新后恢复进度但不会自动播放；系统开启减少动态效果时自动关闭动效。
description.en: A cyberpunk appearance with flowing RGB neon, CRT scanlines, a dark neon-city backdrop, and a customizable background gallery. Its draggable, collapsible top-right HUD includes a theme toggle and local music player. Playlists and playback state persist across refreshes, restoring position without autoplay; animations disable automatically when the OS requests reduced motion.

description.zh: 融合 Material 3 与 Fluent 2 的主题：从壁纸派生明暗调色板，提供亚克力/云母磨砂材质、日夜圆形过渡和可调壁纸；另含系统音频声纹可视化、悬浮工具球、元素拾取、右侧多标签面板与可停靠工作台。纯 Web 部署的声纹监听需要 `getDisplayMedia` 授权并共享系统音频；壁纸会压缩为 JPEG dataURL 保存。
description.en: A Material 3 × Fluent 2 theme that derives light and dark palettes from a wallpaper and adds acrylic/mica surfaces, adjustable wallpaper framing, and a circular day/night transition. It also includes system-audio waveform visualization, a floating tool orb, an element picker, a multi-tab right sidebar, and a dockable workspace. On the Web, audio visualization requires `getDisplayMedia` permission and system-audio sharing; wallpapers are stored as compressed JPEG data URLs.

description.zh: 《死亡搁浅》风格的 BB 生命体征主题：以暗色 DS 蓝黑/琥珀线条和亮色冥滩白变体重塑界面，并在输入区上方显示 ECG 走纸；BPM 根据会话快照中的 Agent 思考、工具执行和回合状态实时变化。保留 DeepSeek 鲸鱼品牌蓝，视觉层不拦截交互。
description.en: A Death Stranding–styled BB vital-signs theme with dark DS blue-black and amber styling plus a Beach-white light variant. An ECG monitor strip above the composer updates its BPM from session snapshots of agent thinking, tool execution, and turn activity. DeepSeek whale blue stays intact, and the visual layers remain pointer-transparent.

description.zh: 在设置 → 皮肤中使用本地图片、图片 URL 或本地文件夹作为全屏背景，支持顺序/随机轮播（随机一轮内不重复）、图片适合度、暗化、模糊与表面透出调节；明暗主题自动适配，设置和轮播进度可跨刷新/重启恢复。支持 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP；文件夹扫描与路径读取需要宿主半区。
description.en: Use local images, image URLs, or a local folder as a full-screen background from Settings → Skin. It supports sequential or random slideshows without repeats within a random round, fit modes, darkening, blur, and surface translucency, with light/dark adaptation and persistence across refreshes and restarts. Supports PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP; folder scanning and path-based access require the host half.

description.zh: 以《鸣潮》爱弥斯为灵感的粉白主题皮肤：樱花粉与纯白渐变，深色模式加入粉紫霓虹和青色点缀，内置角色背景图，配合半透明面板、悬停粉光与粉色滚动条；提供浅色/深色两套配色。
description.en: An Aemeath-inspired skin with cherry-pink and white gradients, pink-violet neon with cyan accents in dark mode, a bundled character backdrop, translucent panels, pink hover glow, and pink scrollbars across light and dark variants.

description.zh: 右下角桌面宠物插件，提供 5 状态 × 32 帧的精灵图动画，并根据 Agent 的思考、工作和完成状态切换动作；支持拖拽定位、闹钟、番茄钟、便签、久坐/喝水提醒，以及可更换皮肤和预览。设置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`；默认皮肤素材来自用户提供并经 AI 处理的图片，使用时需自行确认素材权利。
description.en: A floating desktop pet with 5 state animations of 32 frames each, reacting to agent thinking, work, and completion. It adds draggable placement, alarms, a Pomodoro timer, notes, sedentary/hydration reminders, and selectable skins with previews. Settings live in browser `localStorage`; the default skin uses user-provided images processed with AI, so users should verify their rights to the assets.

description.zh: 新粗野主义客户端主题，内置「蓝统治」与「做旧报纸」两套方案，可在设置中实时切换；使用硬偏移阴影、直角和 2px 边框，并适配 `dsh-voice-input` 的弹层、按钮与状态色。支持浅色/深色/跟随系统，方案选择和开关保存在 `localStorage`。
description.en: A neo-brutalist client skin with live-switchable Blue Command and Aged Newspaper schemes. It adds hard offset shadows, sharp corners, 2px borders, and themed `dsh-voice-input` popovers, buttons, and states. Light/dark/system modes remain available, and the scheme plus master toggle persist in `localStorage`.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 与 Web 的 Arcaea 视觉主题，提供浅色选曲场景、深色侧栏、斜切输入/新会话表面，以及随包提供的 Exo 可变字体和 Noto Sans CJK SC 字体。启用时固定使用 `arcaea-light` 配色，停用后恢复底层主题偏好；运行时资源内嵌，不发起网络请求，也不修改会话数据。当前实机验证为 Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3，macOS/Linux 未实测。
description.en: An Arcaea visual theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web, with a light song-selection scene, dark sidebar, angular composer and new-session surfaces, and bundled Exo variable plus Noto Sans CJK SC fonts. It pins the `arcaea-light` palette while enabled and restores the underlying theme preference when disabled; runtime assets are embedded, with no network requests or session-data changes. Verified on Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3; macOS/Linux were not device-tested.

description.zh: 受《碧蓝航线》金狮启发的非官方主题，把 Web 界面构成深墨绿月泉圣所：森林、月亮、遗迹与水面围合工作区，输入框呈月泉玻璃，清晰角色立绘作为独立图层显示。素材随插件内置，支持昼夜背景、响应式布局与减少动态效果；当前面向 HTTP `web` profile，已在 Host 0.1.0-rc.7 / Web UI 0.1.0-rc.8 验证。
description.en: An unofficial Azur Lane–inspired theme that turns the Web UI into a dark-emerald moonwell sanctuary: forest, moon, ruins, and water surround the workspace, the composer becomes moonwell glass, and clear character art remains a separate layer. Assets are bundled, with day/night backgrounds, responsive layout, and reduced-motion safeguards. It targets the HTTP `web` profile and was verified with Host 0.1.0-rc.7 and Web UI 0.1.0-rc.8.

description.zh: 「深海世界 / 浅海世界」双模式主题：深色以亮度、浅色以清澈度区分信息层级，并让界面随系统明暗切换；对话栏加入轻量浮游生物动画，生成中的 “Deep diving…” 状态会触发上涌与柔光增强，右上角水母按钮可实时调整粒子参数。开启减少动态效果时退化为静态帧；插件只做主题与颜色，不改变布局。
description.en: A Deep Sea / Shallow Sea theme with dark mode using brightness and light mode using clarity to express hierarchy, while following the system appearance. A lightweight plankton animation fills the conversation area; the “Deep diving…” state adds upward motion and soft glow, and a jellyfish button exposes live particle controls. Reduced-motion mode falls back to a static frame; the plugin changes theme and color, not layout.

description.zh: 面向 Web GUI 与桌面端的外观套件，提供 32 款莫兰迪、马卡龙和中国传统色主题，支持视频/静态壁纸、7 种东方纸纹、分区透明度与文字深浅调节，并附带可拖动、缩放的键盘桌宠。支持跟随系统/浅色/深色；分区样式与桌宠依赖宿主 shell 结构，升级后可能需要适配。
description.en: An appearance kit for Web and Desktop with 32 Morandi, Macaron, and Chinese-traditional presets, video and still wallpapers, seven adjustable East-Asian paper textures, per-zone opacity and text depth, and a draggable, resizable keyboard pet. It supports system/light/dark modes; per-zone styling and the pet depend on the host shell structure and may need adjustment after upgrades.

description.zh: 从设置中导入 PNG/JPG/WebP 图片，使用 k-means 提取主色、辅色和强调色，自动生成明暗主题令牌，并将图片作为可调浓度/模糊的背景；另提供独立的桌面宠物窗口，含 5 种形象、拖拽定位和 Agent 忙闲联动。宠物窗口通过 Windows WPF/PowerShell 启动，位置使用 Win32 坐标；插件设置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`。
description.en: Import PNG/JPG/WebP images from Settings and use k-means to derive primary, secondary, and accent colors for light and dark theme tokens, with adjustable background intensity and blur. It also provides a separate desktop pet window with five character options, drag positioning, and agent-busy linkage. The pet uses Windows WPF/PowerShell and Win32 coordinates; plugin settings are stored in browser `localStorage`.

description.zh: 设置 → 主题中的主题管理器，内置「森林绿」和「海洋蓝」，支持上传可信的 `__ModuleLoader__.load` 格式 JS 主题，应用 `overrideTokens`、CSS 和 slots UI，并在主题间一键切换。主题文件与选中状态保存到 DSH home 磁盘；上传的 JS 会在页面中直接执行，请只使用可信文件。
description.en: A Settings → Themes manager with built-in Forest Green and Ocean Blue themes. It accepts trusted `__ModuleLoader__.load` JavaScript themes that can apply `overrideTokens`, CSS, and slots UI, and provides one-click switching. Theme files and the selected state are stored on disk in the DSH home; uploaded JavaScript executes directly in the page, so use trusted files only.

description.zh: 移植 YiziMarkdown 设计语言的 19 款主题包，全部提供亮/暗配色并跟随系统；支持自定义主题工作室（从一个主题色派生完整调色板）、自定义 Logo/字样/徽章/新会话标题、品牌尺寸调节和 `/theme` 切换命令。当前 0.5.x 面向 Harness ≥ `v0.1.2-alpha.1` 的 `dsh-client-store` 一代；更老的 rc.5/rc.8 需使用 0.3.x。
description.en: A 19-theme pack porting the YiziMarkdown design language, with light/dark palettes that follow the system. It includes a custom-theme studio that derives a full palette from one accent, custom logo/wordmark/badge/new-session branding, brand-size control, and the `/theme` command. The 0.5.x line targets the `dsh-client-store` generation of Harness ≥ `v0.1.2-alpha.1`; older rc.5/rc.8 builds need the 0.3.x line.

description.zh: Dota 2 The International 2016（TI6）主题，使用深空蓝黑表面、TI6 红飘带和不朽盾金点缀，并在聊天主面板绘制矢量翅膀与星空背景；浅/深模式分别提供 TI Light 与 TI Dark。设置 → TI6 Wings 可开关飘带动画层。
description.en: A Dota 2 The International 2016 (TI6) theme with deep void-navy surfaces, TI6 crimson ribbon accents, Aegis gold, and a vector-wings plus starfield background on the main chat panel.
