Light and dark modes use TI Light and TI Dark respectively; the ribbon animation can be toggled in Settings → TI6 Wings.

description.zh: 第三方 Dracula 深色主题，覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 与 `--shiki-*` 令牌，并在设置 → Themes 中提供主题切换；首次使用默认启用 Dracula，偏好持久化于 `localStorage`。仅提供深色外观。
description.en: A third-party Dracula dark theme that overrides the `--dsw-alias-*` and `--shiki-*` tokens and adds a Settings → Themes switcher. It defaults to Dracula on first use and persists the preference in `localStorage`. Dark mode only.

description.zh: 遵循 Material You / Material 3 的皮肤，以 HCT 算法从种子色生成色调调色板，并使用随包的 Maple Mono NF CN 字体；支持浅/深配色、M3 圆角与动效，并尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。仓库已归档，开发已迁移至 `mtaech/melon`；当前固定版本仅随包提供 Regular 字重，Medium/Bold 使用合成或系统字体回退。
description.en: A Material You / Material 3 skin that derives a tonal palette from a seed color with HCT and uses the bundled Maple Mono NF CN typeface. It provides light/dark palettes, M3 shape and motion treatments, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. The repository is archived and development moved to `mtaech/melon`; this pinned version bundles only the Regular weight, with Medium/Bold synthesized or falling back to system fonts.

description.zh: 根据当前会话的模型与推理等级切换四挡强调色、光晕和输入框上方指示条：`deepseek-v4-flash`/`deepseek-v4-pro` 的 `high`/`max` 分别映射为蓝/靛或琥珀/红色档位，并提供可拖动的鲸鱼滑轨。它作为强调层叠加在现有皮肤上；未知或缺失的 `reasoningEffort` 会回落到 `high`，且当前仅匹配上述模型系列。
description.en: A four-level accent, glow, and composer indicator driven by the active session model and reasoning effort. `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` map their `high`/`max` levels to blue/indigo or amber/red stages, with a draggable whale slider. It layers over the current skin rather than replacing it; unknown or missing `reasoningEffort` falls back to `high`, and only the listed model families are matched.

description.zh: 《新世纪福音战士》三套机体主题：初号機/Unit-01、零号機/Unit-00、弐号機/Unit-02；每套覆盖整套 `--dsw-*` 令牌、配套壁纸与侧边栏切换器，并加入警示条纹、HUD 瞄准框、扫描线和蓝图网格。三套均为深色外观，背景使用 wallhaven 同人图，且启用后会强制维持 EVA 机体主题；插件不修改 Harness 源码，素材仅供本地个人 GUI 使用。
description.en: Three Neon Genesis Evangelion unit themes—Unit-01, Unit-00, and Unit-02—with complete `--dsw-*` token sets, per-unit backdrops, and a sidebar switcher. Hazard stripes, HUD brackets, scanlines, and a blueprint grid complete the mecha treatment. All three are dark schemes; the backgrounds use wallhaven fan art, and the plugin enforces one of the EVA themes while enabled. It does not modify Harness source, and the artwork is for local personal GUI use.

description.zh: 主题调色板插件，内置 VSCode Red、Solarized Dark 和 Solarized Light，并在设置 → 插件配置中按浅色/深色外观选择映射；调色板通过 `theme.overrideTokens` 叠加、跟随系统明暗切换并持久化。还提供 `themePalettes` 注册 API 供第三方插件贡献调色板；它不会扩展 Harness 的 Appearance 主题列表，也不修改语法高亮 `tokenColors`。
description.en: A theme-palette plugin with built-in VSCode Red, Solarized Dark, and Solarized Light palettes. Settings → Plugin Configuration maps palettes to light and dark appearances; the selected palette is layered through `theme.overrideTokens`, follows system appearance changes, and persists. A `themePalettes` registration API lets third-party plugins contribute palettes. It does not extend the Harness Appearance picker or modify syntax-highlighting `tokenColors`.

description.zh: Claude 风格的 WebUI 主题：暖羊皮纸底色、Terracotta 品牌色、全界面 Georgia/中文宋体衬线字体和黄褐调中性灰，覆盖明暗两套主题令牌；代码保持等宽字体，焦点环保留可达性所需的蓝色。纯客户端插件，停用或移除后恢复默认外观。
description.en: A Claude-style Web UI theme with a warm parchment canvas, Terracotta branding, Georgia/Chinese Songti serif typography, and yellow-brown neutrals across light and dark token sets. Code remains monospace, while the blue focus ring is retained for accessibility. It is client-only and restores the default appearance when disabled or removed.

description.zh: 壁纸与动态背景中心：浏览/搜索 Alphacoders 热门壁纸，按主题分别保存背景，并支持收藏、历史、自动更换、毛玻璃与遮罩调节；MoeWalls 和 DesktopHut 提供视频壁纸目录，视频需从原站下载后上传本地，插件不做在线流式播放。支持 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 与 WebM/MP4，本地上传上限 200MB；依赖访问这些站点及其 CDN，壁纸版权归原作者。
description.en: A wallpaper and live-background center for browsing/searching Alphacoders popular wallpapers, keeping per-theme backgrounds, and managing favorites, history, auto-change, glass blur, and masks. MoeWalls and DesktopHut provide video-wallpaper catalogs; videos must be downloaded from the source site and uploaded locally because the plugin does not stream them online. It accepts PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF and WebM/MP4 with a 200MB local-upload cap; it requires access to those sites and CDNs, and wallpaper rights remain with their authors.

description.zh: 一个面板管理主题、背景与氛围灯：内置深夜蓝、护眼绿、赛博朋克和纸墨白，提供梦幻渐变与本地图片背景、可调透明度的毛玻璃，以及 7 色可选、1–10 秒可调速的环绕流动氛围灯；设置会自动保存并恢复。
description.en: One panel for themes, backgrounds, and ambient lighting: it includes Midnight Blue, Eye-Friendly Green, Cyberpunk, and Paper-and-Ink themes, dreamy gradients and local-image backgrounds, adjustable frosted glass, and a circulating ambient-light effect with seven colors and a 1–10 second speed range. Settings save and restore automatically.

description.zh: 绿色黑底的 Matrix/赛博朋克主题，覆盖背景、文字、按钮、代码高亮、滚动条、弹窗和侧栏等设计令牌；加入可在减少动态效果时自动关闭的矩阵雨、CRT 扫描线、银河星空、太阳系、透视战斗机与右下角虚拟人动效。纯浏览器端、无外部依赖、无网络请求和持久化。
description.en: A green-on-black Matrix/cyberpunk theme that overrides design tokens for backgrounds, text, buttons, syntax highlighting, scrollbars, dialogs, and the sidebar. It adds Matrix rain, CRT scanlines, a galaxy, a solar system, a perspective fighter jet, and a lower-right virtual avatar, with motion disabled under reduced-motion preferences. It is browser-only, has no external dependencies, and makes no network requests or persistent storage.

description.zh: 可深度定制的主题面板，提供 Aurora、Midnight、Sakura、Forest、Amber 与 Mono 六套预设，支持明暗模式、分区毛玻璃/浮雕/霓虹样式、图片或渐变背景、四区透明度、字体/阴影/动效以及免 F12 的分区自定义 CSS；配置保存到可导入/导出的 `config.json`。本地路径图片受扩展名与 8 MiB 限制，背景风格层会自动切换到深色模式，部分分区选择器依赖 DSH 版本的 CSS 类名。
description.en: A deeply customizable theme panel with six presets—Aurora, Midnight, Sakura, Forest, Amber, and Mono—plus light/dark modes, per-area glass/embossed/neon styles, image or gradient backgrounds, four-zone opacity, fonts, shadows, motion, and per-area custom CSS without opening DevTools. Settings are stored in importable/exportable `config.json`; path-based images have an extension allowlist and an 8 MiB limit, background style layers switch to dark mode automatically, and some area selectors depend on DSH CSS class names.

description.zh: 8-bit/CRT 像素皮肤，提供 retro、cyberpunk、sunset 和 mono 四套浅/深配色、Fusion Pixel 字体、像素化表格/代码/骨架屏、可调扫描线/暗角/像素光标与字体模式；设置持久化于 `localStorage`，尊重减少动态效果。构建必须针对相邻 `deepseek-harness` checkout 运行，更新 Harness 后需重建以适配 CSS Module 哈希。
description.en: An 8-bit/CRT pixel skin with retro, cyberpunk, sunset, and mono palettes for light and dark modes, Fusion Pixel fonts, pixel-styled tables/code/skeletons, adjustable scanlines, vignette, pixel cursor, and font modes. Settings persist in `localStorage`, and animations respect reduced-motion preferences. The build must target an adjacent `deepseek-harness` checkout and be rerun after Harness updates to refresh CSS-Module hashes.

description.zh: 维什戴尔风格的爆破终端主题，采用黑灰信息层、细线框、编号、警示切角与红色状态轨；在此基础上提供任务看板、工作区目录选择、Git 图谱、可选右侧工作台和设置中心。任务看板支持真实 DSH Agent 执行、失败重跑与 cron；右侧工作台默认关闭，且新版本 DSH 的原生文件/终端/工作台会优先承接相应功能。已针对 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 验证并兼容列出的旧版，所有素材内嵌、不访问远程资源。
description.en: A Wishadel demolition-terminal theme with black-gray information layers, fine rules, numbered elements, warning cut corners, and red status tracks. It also provides a task board, workspace directory picker, Git graph, optional right-side workbench, and settings center. The task board runs real DSH Agent sessions with retries and cron scheduling; the workbench is off by default, and newer DSH builds take over the native file, terminal, and workbench functions. Verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 with the listed older versions; all assets are embedded and no remote resources are accessed.

description.zh: FGO 迦勒底风格的五套主题包：迦勒底·夜、迦勒底·晨、阿尔托莉雅·蓝金、摩根·黑紫和玛修·白紫；使用程序生成的原创星图/魔术回路 SVG、金色刻线与随主题变化的边框装饰。皮肤选择在设置中持久化于 `localStorage`，仅修改展示层；不包含 FGO 官方美术素材，且为非官方粉丝项目。
description.en: A five-theme FGO Chaldea-inspired pack: Chaldea Night, Chaldea Dawn, Artoria Blue/Gold, Morgan Black/Purple, and Mash White/Purple. It uses procedurally generated star-chart/magic-circuit SVG backdrops, gold trim, and theme-specific border decorations. Skin selection persists in `localStorage`, the plugin changes only presentation, and it contains no official FGO artwork; this is an unofficial fan project.

description.zh: 将 Web 界面变成暖米色宣纸水墨画：右上竹枝、左下远山、右下老梅与朱砂“墨”印，配合覆盖浅/深模式的米白/墨色/朱红色板和全屏飘落竹叶动画。使用内联 SVG 与 Web Animations API，卸载后可完整恢复默认外观；需要 Chromium 浏览器（含 Electron）。
description.en: A warm rice-paper ink-wash skin with a bamboo branch in the upper right, distant mountains in the lower left, an old plum twig and vermilion “墨” seal in the lower right, plus falling bamboo leaves across the screen. It uses inline SVG and the Web Animations API, restores the default appearance on unload, and requires a Chromium-based browser, including Electron.

description.zh: 主题中心提供按浅色/深色分组的 11 款内置主题和一键切换，支持自定义图片壁纸的裁剪、平移、缩放、遮罩与表面透明度调节，以及 `dsh-theme` 文件导入导出；选择和壁纸参数会持久化。未列入内置目录的 14 款主题以可恢复的归档 `dsh-theme` 文件保留。
description.en: A theme center with 11 built-in themes grouped by light and dark appearance, one-click switching, custom-image wallpaper cropping/panning/zooming, overlay and surface-translucency controls, and `dsh-theme` import/export. Theme choices and wallpaper parameters persist, while 14 themes outside the built-in catalog remain available as restorable archived `dsh-theme` files.

description.zh: 「神里印象」以《原神》神里绫华的青蓝、靛蓝与金色为灵感，提供浅色与深色两套配色，并用汉仪文黑作为标题字体。它只覆盖颜色、标题字体和少量视觉样式，不改变页面结构；汉仪文黑需由用户自行安装，水印图片默认不随包提供。
description.en: Kamisato Impression draws on Kamisato Ayaka’s cyan, indigo, ice-blue and gold palette for light and dark modes, with 汉仪文黑 used for headings. It only changes colors, heading typography and a small amount of styling; the font must be installed separately, and watermark images are not bundled by default.

description.zh: 粒子鲸鱼背景将 DeepSeek 鱼形轮廓由不同尺寸粒子重建：入场组装、待机游动、鼠标径向推力与随光标移动的手电筒照明，适配浅色/深色主题。装饰层以 30 FPS 渲染，固定在 DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` Web profile 验证，后续版本可能需要调整。
description.en: Particle Whale Background rebuilds the DeepSeek fish silhouette from varied-size particles, with an entrance assembly, idle swimming, radial mouse push, and cursor-following flashlight effect. It supports light and dark themes and renders the decorative layer at 30 FPS; the fixed README lists validation against the DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` Web profile, and later releases may require updates.

description.zh: StyleVault 提供 30 套深浅色经典配色，并在 Style Settings 面板中实时调整颜色、UI/代码字体、字号和圆角；当前方案可保存、导入、导出和分享。它只覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，不改布局；DSH 预览版升级后，部分内部 class 可能需要适配，在线字体离线时会回退。
description.en: StyleVault provides 30 classic light and dark palettes with live controls for colors, UI and code fonts, font scale, and corner radius. Save, import, export, and share your schemes from the Style Settings panel. It overrides `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens without changing layout; DSH preview updates may require adaptation, and online fonts fall back to the system stack offline.

description.zh: 翻到页面背面的悬浮毛玻璃任务控制台，实时展示当前会话的后台任务、子代理、工作区、插件状态和会话概览。内置卡片与用户卡片均可拖拽、缩放、折叠、全屏并持久化；对话中的 `[taskcard]` 块可生成卡片，卡片还能发布到无限画布并通过内置 WebSocket relay 协作。兼容范围为 DSH `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`。
description.en: Flip the page to a floating frosted-glass task console showing the current session’s background jobs, subagents, workspace, plugin state, and session overview. Built-in and user cards can be dragged, resized, collapsed, fullscreened, and persisted; conversation `[taskcard]` blocks can author cards, which can also be published to an infinite canvas and shared through the bundled WebSocket relay. The declared DSH range is `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`.

name.zh: Fate / Twin Contract · 赤钢契约

description.zh: 非官方 Fate 灵感皮肤，以 Archer × Rin 为中心，随 DSH Light、Dark 和 System 模式切换，完全离线运行。它是纯展示层，不读取会话、工作区或模型配置，不改主题偏好或 `localStorage`；窄屏和移动端会隐藏人物背景，人物美术不属于代码的 MIT 授权范围。
description.en: An unofficial Fate-inspired skin centered on Archer × Rin that follows DSH Light, Dark, and System modes and runs fully offline. It is presentation-only: it does not read conversations, workspaces, or model configuration, and does not change theme preferences or `localStorage`. Character artwork is hidden on narrow and mobile layouts and is outside the code’s MIT grant.

description.zh: 葫芦娃 HULUWA EDITION 把 DSH Web UI 变成暖色宣纸与七彩葫芦娃风格：会话、文件夹和状态条使用七兄弟配色，并提供“葫芦宝匣”开关、山中时钟、修炼中状态和主题彩蛋。打字、消息与通知音效由 Web Audio 实时合成；小屏会隐藏装饰，减少动态效果会停用循环动画。
description.en: HULUWA EDITION turns the DSH Web UI into a warm rice-paper and Calabash Brothers setting: conversations, folders, and status elements use the seven-color palette, with a control chest, mountain clock, “cultivating” state, and themed easter eggs. Typing, message, and notification sounds are synthesized in real time with Web Audio; small screens hide decoration and reduced-motion settings stop looping animation.

description.zh: 本地优先的鲸鱼世界把仅限会话 ID、事件序号、事件类型和时间戳的元数据转成可拖动伙伴、20 种可解锁鲸灵、潮汐时间线、个人海湾、收藏、成就和非惩罚远征。支持六套海湾主题、本地 PNG/文本分享和减少动态效果；不读取或导出提示词、输出、代码、路径、工具参数或工具结果。目标版本为 DSH `0.1.2-rc.1`；进度不跨设备同步，鲸群卡片仅支持本地文件导入导出，覆盖层每 5 秒轮询。
description.en: This local-first whale world turns only session ID, event sequence, event type, and timestamp metadata into a draggable companion, 20 unlockable whale spirits, a tide timeline, personal cove, collectibles, achievements, and a non-punitive expedition. It includes six cove themes, local PNG/text sharing, and reduced-motion support; it never reads or exports prompts, outputs, code, paths, tool arguments, or tool results. The target is DSH `0.1.2-rc.1`; progress does not sync across devices, whale-circle cards are local-file only, and the overlay polls every five seconds.

name.zh: 一九四五年八月十五日

description.zh: 以陈坚油画《公元一九四五年九月九日九时》（南京受降）作为 DSH Web 对话区底图，另为选中会话和标题栏加入史料风格标记。插件只改展示层，不读会话、凭据或用户文件，不联网，卸载可还原 DOM/CSS；面向 `desktop` profile，README 以 DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` 的实测为兼容依据，油画版权另见 NOTICE。
description.en: This historical skin uses Chen Jian’s painting *The Ninth Hour of September 9, 1945*—the Nanjing surrender—as the DSH Web conversation background, with archival markers for the selected session and title bar. It is presentation-only: it reads no sessions, credentials, or user files, makes no network requests, and restores DOM/CSS on removal. It targets the `desktop` profile; the README documents testing against DSH `0.1.7-rc.1`, and the painting has a separate NOTICE.

description.zh: 微信风格皮肤把 DSH Web UI 重排为 Windows 微信观感：左侧功能栏、会话列表、微信式绿/白消息气泡、头像和可拖拽调整高度的输入框，并提供 5 档字号与头像上传。它只作用于浅色模式；深色模式自动回退官方外观，副标题记录在浏览器 `localStorage`，窄屏侧栏收起仍由 DSH 自身控制。
description.en: WeChat Skin gives the DSH Web UI the look of WeChat for Windows: a far-left function rail, conversation list, WeChat-style green and white bubbles, avatars, and a composer whose height can be dragged. It adds five font-size levels and avatar upload. The skin applies only to light mode; dark mode falls back to the official look, subtitles are stored in browser `localStorage`, and narrow-screen sidebar collapse remains DSH behavior.

description.zh: 质感书房是一套 3D 书房皮肤：奶油墙、浅木家具、第一人称 WASD/空格移动，并可从门外进入体素风世界进行挖掘与放置。WebGL 不可用时回退到内置插画背景；需要安装现有 DSH Web 插件，不会修改官方 `.app`，浅色模式更适合。
description.en: Cozy Study is a 3D study-room skin with cream walls, light-wood furniture, first-person WASD/Space movement, and a voxel-like outdoor area for digging and placing blocks. When WebGL is unavailable it falls back to a built-in illustrated background. It installs as a plugin for an existing DSH Web setup, does not modify the official `.app`, and is recommended with light mode.

description.zh: 草薙宁宁主题提供按本地时间切换的日/夜背景（06:00–18:00 为白天）、可调背景模糊和侧栏透明度、可拖动立绘，以及随 Agent 执行/待机状态变化的动画和日中双语台词。仅供个人测试和非商业同人使用；角色与图片素材不在 MIT 代码授权范围内。
description.en: Nene Theme provides day/night backgrounds that follow local time (06:00–18:00 is daytime), adjustable background blur and sidebar opacity, a draggable character illustration, and animations with Japanese/Chinese lines that react to Agent execution or idle state. It is for personal testing and non-commercial fan use; the character and image assets are outside the MIT code license.

description.zh: 自适应毛玻璃皮肤允许使用任意图片作为壁纸，并从主色自动生成明暗主题令牌；界面组件使用自适应遮罩、镜面边缘高光和 `backdrop-filter` 玻璃表面。未设置壁纸时会使用渐变玻璃背景，并以 WCAG AA 正文对比度下限维持可读性。
description.en: Adaptive Frosted-Glass Skin accepts any image as a wallpaper and derives light/dark theme tokens from its dominant color. Components use adaptive scrims, mirror-edge highlights, and `backdrop-filter` glass surfaces. Without a wallpaper it supplies a gradient-glass fallback, while a WCAG AA body-contrast floor preserves readability.

description.zh: Colorizer 在设置页提供 Ocean Blue、Forest Green、Sunset Orange、Royal Purple 和 Monochrome 五套内置配色，可独立叠加在浅色/深色/跟随系统外观之上，并在浏览器 `localStorage` 中持久化。它不提供自定义主题编辑，代码高亮和滚动条不随配色改变，首次加载前仍会先显示默认主题。
description.en: Colorizer adds five built-in themes—Ocean Blue, Forest Green, Sunset Orange, Royal Purple, and Monochrome—to Settings. They layer independently over the Light, Dark, or System appearance and persist in browser `localStorage`. There is no custom-theme editor; code highlighting and scrollbars are not recolored, and the first paint still uses the default theme before the plugin activates.

description.zh: 莱茵生命主题把 DSH Web 对话工作区重组为研究档案终端：浅色为暖纸、浓墨和研究橙，深色为炭黑与青色状态强调，并在设置 → 通用提供开关。主题不读用户数据集或下载模型/外部图片，尊重减少动态效果和窄屏降级；兼容目标为 DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` Web，缺少页面锚点时只跳过装饰，宿主控件与布局保持不变。
description.en: Rhine Lab Theme recasts the DSH Web conversation workspace as a research archive terminal: warm paper, dense ink, and research orange in light mode; charcoal surfaces and cyan state accents in dark mode; and a toggle in Settings → General. It reads no user datasets and downloads no models or external images, respects reduced motion and narrow-screen fallback, and targets DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` Web. Missing page anchors only omit decoration; host controls and layout remain intact.

description.zh: 极光主题使用深黑蓝底、电光青强调色、90 颗星组成的星网、极光光晕与细网格背景，并在设置页提供主题开关和动态/静态背景模式。主题关闭后会还原配色、背景和侧栏卡片；仓库同时提供持久化静态双面包与重启即失效的会话级动态 `client.js` 版本。
description.en: Aurora Theme uses deep blue-black surfaces, electric-cyan accents, a 90-star network, aurora glows, and a fine grid, with Settings controls for enabling the theme and choosing animated or static backgrounds. Disabling it restores the palette, background, and sidebar card. The repository provides a persistent static dual-face bundle as well as a session-level dynamic `client.js` form that does not survive a restart.

name.zh: 天气主题与 FishLogo 鲸鱼宠物

description.zh: 天气主题与 FishLogo 鲸鱼宠物会在打开页面时从 Open-Meteo 获取天气，并通过公网 IP 自动定位（可手动指定城市），据此切换整页配色、雨雪/阳光/闪电等氛围层、季节粒子和天气宠物；右下角 HUD 与聊天卡片还提供详情、科普和声音开关。IP 定位使用 `ipwho.is`→`ipapi.co` 回退链，受代理/VPN 出口和免费服务限额影响；减少动态效果会保留色罩但关闭动画。
description.en: Weather Themes & FishLogo Pet fetches weather from Open-Meteo when the page opens and uses public-IP geolocation, with a manual city override, to switch full-page palettes, rain/snow/sun/lightning ambience, seasonal particles, and a weather pet. Its bottom-right HUD and chat cards expose details, facts, and sound controls. Geolocation falls back from `ipwho.is` to `ipapi.co`, so proxy/VPN egress and free-service limits affect results; reduced motion keeps the color wash but disables animation.

description.zh: DPH 终末地主题以冷黑工业界面、荧光黄色状态信号、切角面板和响应式布局重塑 DSH Web，并在输入框旁提供待机、输入、思考/执行三套 24 帧角色动画。首页可打开官网消息抽屉，读取公开公告接口的 6 条内容并缓存 5 分钟；仅支持 Web profile，不上传会话或输入内容，窄屏会隐藏角色动画和消息抽屉，角色素材另有授权边界。
description.en: DPH Endfield Theme reshapes DSH Web with a cold-black industrial interface, fluorescent-yellow state signals, chamfered panels, and responsive layout, plus three 24-frame mascot animations for idle, typing, and thinking/execution beside the composer. The home page can open a news drawer that reads six items from the public Endfield news API and caches them for five minutes. It supports only the Web profile, does not upload sessions or input, hides the mascot and drawer on narrow screens, and has separate rights boundaries for character assets.

description.zh: DSH 皮肤管理器提供可拖动的鲸鱼按钮：左键恢复官方外观，右键列出检测到的已安装皮肤并互斥切换，按钮位置和当前选择保存在 `localStorage`。它是纯客户端展示工具，不修改插件安装状态或模型请求；只识别符合 `dsh-client-ui-skin-<id>` 命名约定的皮肤，列表显示名使用包名 id。
description.en: DSH Skin Manager provides a draggable whale button: left-click restores the official look, while right-click lists detected installed skins and switches them exclusively. The button position and current choice are stored in `localStorage`. It is a client-side presentation utility that does not change plugin installation state or model requests; it recognizes the `dsh-client-ui-skin-<id>` naming convention and displays package IDs as names.

description.zh: Glassic Mist 在默认浅色皮肤上叠加雾蓝蒙版、74 秒缓慢漂移的白色云雾和覆盖菜单、Modal、设置面板、输入框等表面的毛玻璃效果。设置页提供启用开关和 10%–100% 浓度滑块，也可用 `/misttheme` 切换；默认主题不被替换，`prefers-reduced-motion` 会停用云雾动画，且该主题注册为浅色 `mist-blue`。
description.en: Glassic Mist overlays the default light skin with a mist-blue veil, slowly drifting white clouds on a 74-second cycle, and frosted-glass surfaces across menus, modals, Settings, and the composer. Settings provides an enable switch and a 10%–100% intensity slider, and `/misttheme` can toggle it. The default theme is not replaced, `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the cloud animation, and the registered `mist-blue` theme is light-only.

description.zh: 纸质主题以 Claude Code 为灵感，使用奶油纸背景、暖墨色文字、陶土色强调、衬线 CJK 字体和暖色代码块，并把“纸质”加入浅色/深色/跟随系统同一组外观选择。选择会写入 `localStorage`，卸载后内置外观行恢复；README 以 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 验证为依据。
description.en: Paper Theme is inspired by Claude Code, with a cream-paper background, warm-ink text, terracotta accents, serif CJK typography, and warm code blocks. It adds Paper alongside Light, Dark, and System in the Appearance choices. The selection is stored in `localStorage`, the native Appearance row returns after uninstall, and the README documents validation against DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`.

description.zh: 高级配色在设置页新增“配色”行，内置 Tokyo Night、Nord、Catppuccin Mocha、Everforest、Rosé Pine、Ayu Mirage、Catppuccin Latte 和 Paper Gold 八套方案，并支持输入名称、明暗、底色与强调色导入自定义配色。完整令牌覆盖背景、边框、按钮、文字、代码块、侧栏和滚动条；选择与导入方案持久化，点击“默认”可回到原有明暗偏好。需要组合树中的 `ui-theme`，基于 dsh `^0.1.0-rc.6` 构建。
description.en: Premium Palettes adds a Palette row in Settings with eight built-ins—Tokyo Night, Nord, Catppuccin Mocha, Everforest, Rosé Pine, Ayu Mirage, Catppuccin Latte, and Paper Gold—and an import dialog for custom palettes defined by name, scheme, background, and accent. Full token maps cover backgrounds, borders, buttons, text, code surfaces, the sidebar, and scrollbars. Choices and imports persist, while Default restores the prior appearance preference. It requires `ui-theme` in the composition and is built against dsh `^0.1.0-rc.6`.

description.zh: DeepSeek Palenight 主题以深靛 Palenight 配色覆盖深色模式，以暖米灰与青绿色强调覆盖浅色模式，约 100 个主题变量涵盖表面、菜单、文字、代码块和滚动条。推荐的持久化 dsh bundle 会随宿主重启保留；仓库中的旧动态 Cordis 形态已弃用，重启即失效。
description.en: DeepSeek Palenight applies indigo Palenight colors to dark mode and warm parchment neutrals with teal accents to light mode, covering about 100 theme variables across surfaces, menus, text, code blocks, and scrollbars. The recommended persistent dsh bundle survives host restarts; the repository’s deprecated dynamic Cordis form is reference-only and is lost on restart.

description.zh: THE MACHINE HUD 以深蓝黑和机器青重绘界面，叠加等宽字体、网格与扫描线，并在右下角提供接入真实会话遥测的悬浮面板：Agent 运行时雷达、工具成功/错误率、上下文窗口占用、解码 tok/s 和真实工具事件流。皮肤设计为仅深色，并在卸载后还原官方外观。
description.en: THE MACHINE HUD repaints the interface in deep blue-black and machine cyan, with monospace typography, grid, and scanline atmosphere. Its bottom-right floating panel uses live session telemetry for a running-state radar, tool success/error rates, context-window occupancy, decoded tok/s, and the session’s real tool-event stream. The skin is dark-only by design and restores the official look on uninstall.

description.zh: Ivory for DSH 用暖中性色覆盖浅色与深色界面，兼顾桌面和移动端，并提供阅读/复制控制、响应式文件与插件管理、内置安全 Markdown 预览（始终可看源码、链接仅 HTTP(S)）和 WCAG AA/强制颜色/减少动态效果支持。插件无网络、遥测、文件系统或进程访问，仅保存两个浏览器本地偏好；已针对 DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.1` 与 Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` 验证，其他版本可回退到令牌级主题。
description.en: Ivory for DSH applies warm neutrals to light and dark modes across desktop and mobile, with reading and copy controls, responsive file and plugin management, a bounded safe Markdown preview with source view and HTTP(S)-only links, and WCAG AA, forced-colors, and reduced-motion support. It makes no network, telemetry, filesystem, or process access and stores only two browser-local preferences. It is verified against DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.1` and Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`; other hosts can fall back to token-level theming.

description.zh: DeepSeek 便签提供可拖动的文字待办和图片便签，支持勾选、双击编辑、隐藏/展开、自定义标题和每张便签独立的 9 套皮肤。它在 Host 的 `~/.dsh/sticky-notes.json` 持久化；模型工具 `sticky_notes_read` 可读取便签，`sticky_notes_add` 只能新建或追加，不能修改或删除已有内容，图片便签只暴露元数据。
description.en: Sticky Notes for DSH provides draggable text to-dos and image notes with check-off, double-click editing, hide/show, custom titles, and nine per-note skins. Data persists on the Host at `~/.dsh/sticky-notes.json`. The `sticky_notes_read` model tool can read notes, while `sticky_notes_add` can only create or append and cannot modify or delete existing content; image notes expose metadata only.

description.zh: 图片与视频壁纸皮肤可将本地 JPG/PNG/WebP 或静音循环 MP4/WebM 作为应用背景，并把面板变为半透明；右下角面板支持预览、启用/关闭和实时切换，路径可在 Settings → Plugins 中修改，配置改动无需重启。壁纸素材不随仓库提供，需要用户使用本地文件。
description.en: Image & Video Wallpaper Skin uses a local JPG, PNG, or WebP image—or a muted looping MP4/WebM—as the application background and makes panels translucent. A bottom-right panel previews, enables, disables, and switches wallpapers live; the path is editable in Settings → Plugins without a restart. Wallpaper media is not bundled, so users provide their own local files.

description.zh: 星露谷主题把 DSH Web UI 换成温暖的像素农场风，包含聊天气泡、侧栏 Logo、农舍配色和昼夜场景；在设置 → 通用 → 主题风格中手动开启，默认关闭，浅/深外观对应白天/黑夜。主题只改视觉且内嵌图片；插件代码为 MIT，但随包美术素材不在 MIT 范围内，仅供非商业同人使用。
description.en: Stardew Valley Theme turns the DSH Web UI into a warm pixel-art farm with themed chat bubbles, sidebar logo, farmhouse palette, and day/night scenes. Enable it manually in Settings → General → Theme Style; it is off by default, with Light and Dark mapped to day and night. The theme is visual-only and embeds its images. The plugin code is MIT, but the bundled artwork is not and is intended for non-commercial fan use.

description.zh: 我的主题管理器可从本地路径或 GitHub 导入主流 DSH 皮肤包，扫描 Web profile 的 `node_modules`，预览、使用、刷新和管理皮肤，并在 Host 端持久化库；本地导入可选择原地引用或托管复制，界面跟随 DSH 中英文。被导入的包需包含 `dsh.bundle`、`skin.json` 和导出 `apply(ctx)` 的 `lib/client.js`。
description.en: My Themes Manager imports mainstream DSH skin packages from local paths or GitHub, scans the Web profile’s `node_modules`, and lets users preview, use, refresh, and manage them from a host-persisted library. Local imports can stay in place or be copied into managed storage, and the UI follows DSH Chinese/English. Imported packages must declare `dsh.bundle`, include `skin.json`, and provide a `lib/client.js` ModuleLoader bundle exporting `apply(ctx)`.

description.zh: 主题选择器在设置页统一管理应用主题与已安装主题插件，同一时间只保留一个主题生效，并通过 dsh-market API 自动禁用其他主题、持久化选择和每 6 秒同步状态。它依赖 `dshmarket` 的安装清单与 HTTP API；对无法被市场分类的 `git+https://` 皮肤会按仓库地址补充分类，并在 `use-skin` 被拒绝时回退到手动互斥切换。
description.en: Theme Picker adds a Settings page for app themes and installed theme plugins, keeping only one active at a time. It uses the dsh-market API to disable other themes, persist the choice, and refresh state every six seconds. It requires `dshmarket`’s installed list and HTTP API; skins installed from unclassified `git+https://` specs are supplemented by repository URL, with manual exclusive switching as a fallback when `use-skin` is rejected.

description.zh: Rick and Morty for dsh 提供三套主题（Lab Coat、Meeseeks Blue、C-137 Portal）和六种可切换桌宠，桌宠会对开始工作、完成、出错、等待确认/提问与空闲作出不同反应。支持拖动、点击/连击、五级熟悉度、任务称号和冒险日志，全部台词与界面双语；偏好与存档仅在浏览器 `localStorage`，角色图片为非商业同人素材，不在 MIT 代码许可范围内。
description.en: Rick and Morty for dsh provides three themes—Lab Coat, Meeseeks Blue, and C-137 Portal—and six switchable pets that react differently when work starts, completes, errors, waits for approval or a question, and idles. Pets support dragging, clicking and combos, five familiarity levels, task titles, and an adventure log; all lines and labels are bilingual. Preferences and saves stay in browser `localStorage`, while the character images are non-commercial fan assets outside the MIT code grant.

description.zh: Synthwave Theme 提供霓虹 hover/focus 发光、半透明面板、图片轮播或本地/HTTP(S) 视频背景、0–40px 渲染层模糊和 `fontScale` 根字号缩放，并在插件详情页编辑 `config.dsh-theme-synthwave.jsonc`。背景视频默认静音；移动端默认不自动播放，缓存或用户点击后才播放，配置解析失败会暂用默认值且不改原文件。v0.3.0 适配 DSH `0.1.6-alpha.2`，更早版本需使用 v0.2.1。
description.en: Synthwave Theme adds neon hover/focus glow, translucent panels, image rotation or local/HTTP(S) video backgrounds, 0–40px render-layer blur, and root `fontScale` control. Its plugin-details page edits `config.dsh-theme-synthwave.jsonc`. Background video is muted by default; mobile autoplay is off until cached or explicitly started, and parse failures temporarily use defaults without changing the original file. Version 0.3.0 targets DSH `0.1.6-alpha.2`; use v0.2.1 for earlier releases.

description.zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》卡芙卡主题皮肤，以深紫、洋红与幽黑为主色，提供浅色/深色玻璃卡片、角色立绘、粒子、蛛网和彼岸花装饰；设置中可调背景可见度并选择“卡芙卡·星核猎手”配色。
description.en: A Kafka (Honkai: Star Rail) theme skin with a deep-purple, magenta, and black palette. It adds light/dark glass cards, character artwork, particles, spider-web and spider-lily accents, plus a settings palette and background-visibility control.

description.zh: 自定义壁纸引擎，为 DSH Web GUI 提供官方、深蓝渐变和浅蓝渐变预设，以及本地图片上传；客户端自动压缩 WebP/JPEG，支持 0–20px 背景模糊、30%–100% 面板不透明度、按壁纸亮度联动字体颜色和独立的浅/深主题配置。图片只在浏览器本地处理与保存；余额显示需手动开启。
description.en: A custom wallpaper engine for the DSH Web GUI with official, deep-blue gradient, and light-blue gradient presets plus local image upload. It compresses images client-side to WebP/JPEG, offers 0–20px blur, 30–100% pane opacity, wallpaper-brightness-linked font colors, and separate light/dark settings. Images stay local in the browser; balance display is opt-in.

description.zh: BestUI 是壁纸与外观工作室：上传图片或使用预设，按图像亮度生成浅/深配色，分别调节表面透明度、元素颜色、字体、圆角、模糊和界面缩放，并可导入/导出完整 JSON 方案。设置保存在 localStorage；超限图片会自动压缩，停用时移除覆盖层。
description.en: BestUI is a wallpaper and appearance studio: upload an image or use a preset, derive light/dark palettes from the image, tune surface opacity, element colors, fonts, radius, blur, and UI scale, and import/export a complete JSON scheme. Settings live in localStorage; oversized images are compressed automatically, and disabling the plugin removes its overrides.

description.zh: Aurora Skins 提供三套手工调校配色：Aurora（深夜蓝、电光青、暖珊瑚）、Paper（冷白纸面、深青）和 Hologram（近黑、青柠青）。它只覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` token，不修改 DSH 核心；选择保存在 localStorage，可用“Follow system”恢复内置外观。
description.en: Aurora Skins provides three hand-tuned palettes: Aurora (midnight navy, electric cyan, warm coral), Paper (cool paper white, deep teal), and Hologram (near-black, lime-cyan). It uses only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, persists the selection in localStorage, and offers “Follow system” to restore the built-in appearance.

description.zh: 道奇 17 主题以道奇蓝 `#005A9C` 和棒球缝线红打造“白昼场”与“夜场”两套配色，在设置中一键切换并跨启动记忆选择；可随时恢复系统默认，不含队标或球员肖像。
description.en: Dodger 17 offers Day Game and Night Game palettes built around Dodger blue (`#005A9C`) with baseball-stitch red accents. Switch them from Settings, keep the choice across launches, or return to the system default; the fan design uses no team logos or player imagery.

description.zh: Cerrda 暗色主题采用 rose/purple OKLCH 配色与 Sora、Fraunces、JetBrains Mono 字体，加入 Liquid Glass 输入栏/主视觉面板/回到底部按钮、Silk WebGL2 动态背景，以及 CardSpotlight、Ripple、ShimmerBorder 等效果。它是静态 Web bundle，安装后需重启 DSH；卸载后恢复默认外观。
description.en: Cerrda is a dark re-theme with rose/purple OKLCH colors and Sora, Fraunces, and JetBrains Mono fonts. It adds Liquid Glass composer, hero panel, and back-to-bottom controls, a Silk WebGL2 animated background, and CardSpotlight, Ripple, and ShimmerBorder effects. It ships as a static web bundle, so activation requires a DSH restart; uninstall restores the default appearance.

name.zh: DSH 春日山谷像素皮肤

description.zh: 春日山谷像素皮肤把原创农场像素背景、木质侧栏、羊皮纸面板、金色选中态和绿色主操作带入 DSH Desktop 与 Web UI；发送按钮采用浇水壶轮廓，支持字体缩放、0–16px 背景模糊及浅/深主题。当前 README 标注适配 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`、Node.js `>=22.19.0`。
description.en: An original spring-farm pixel skin for DSH Desktop and Web UI, with a farm backdrop, wood sidebar, parchment surfaces, gold selection states, and green primary actions. The send button uses a watering-can outline; font scaling, 0–16px background blur, and light/dark themes are supported. The README targets DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` and Node.js `>=22.19.0`.

description.zh: DSH BG Tool 是本地 `rembg`/BiRefNet 去背景工具：Agent 调用 `remove_background` 后，可用 `general`、`portrait` 或 `fast` 模式生成透明 PNG，结果写入工作区输出目录。图片不上传、不需要 API Key；运行依赖 Windows + NVIDIA GPU，以及预先准备的 `.bg-tools/` 本地环境。
description.en: DSH BG Tool is a local `rembg`/BiRefNet background-removal tool. The Agent can call `remove_background` in `general`, `portrait`, or `fast` mode to write transparent PNGs to the workspace output directory. Images stay on the machine and no API key is needed; it requires Windows with an NVIDIA GPU and a prepared local `.bg-tools/` environment.

description.zh: 月升 Moonrise 是一套深夜写代码风格的暗色主题，以深蓝夜色为底、琥珀色为强调；通过 `ctx.theme.register()` 覆盖 DSH 文档化的 `--dsw-alias-*` 语义 token，安装后可在设置 → 外观选择。
description.en: Moonrise is a late-night coding theme with an amber-on-midnight palette. It registers a dark `ThemeDefinition` through `ctx.theme.register()`, overriding DSH's documented `--dsw-alias-*` semantic tokens; select it in Settings → Appearance after installation.

description.zh: Amadeus 主题皮肤将《Steins;Gate 0》/Amadeus 风格带入 DSH Web，使用 Future Gadget Lab 场景背景、Kurisu 立绘、Amadeus 风格对话框与输入区，并在删除会话时触发 Reading Steiner 世界线扰动效果。README 建议使用深色模式。
description.en: An Amadeus (Steins;Gate 0) skin for DSH Web with a Future Gadget Lab backdrop, Kurisu artwork, Amadeus-style conversation and composer surfaces, and a Reading Steiner worldline-distortion effect when sessions are deleted. The README recommends dark mode.

description.zh: Odette 冰雪梦幻主题为 DSH 提供深/浅双模式背景、13 个主题 token 的冰蓝/冰紫覆盖、毛玻璃面板与输入框装饰；支持随客户端明暗切换、左下角小兽/侧栏雪花按钮开关，并将状态保存到 `localStorage`。项目声明使用《原神》官方素材的粉丝同人内容，非官方且仅作个人非商业使用。
description.en: Odette is a light/dark DSH skin with icy blue-violet token overrides, frosted panels, and decorative composer assets. It follows the client appearance setting, can be toggled from the lower-left mascot or sidebar snowflake button, and persists its state in `localStorage`. It is an unofficial fan work using official Genshin Impact assets for personal, non-commercial use.

description.zh: Nebula 动漫皮肤包内置忍者、樱花、竹林、落日和苍龙五套主题，每套都有独立的浅/深背景与点缀色；右上角“衣服”菜单可换肤，透明度滑杆范围为 0–100%（默认 50%），选择和透明度保存在 `localStorage`。
description.en: Nebula is an anime skin pack with five built-in themes—Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, and Ryujin—each with its own light/dark artwork and accent color. A shirt-icon menu switches skins; its transparency slider ranges from 0–100% (default 50%), with the selection and opacity saved in `localStorage`.

description.zh: DSH Beautify 是一站式外观包，包含 29 套主题、10 态鲸鱼光标、可互动的主鲸鱼与子代理小鲸鱼、声音控制和自定义皮肤；还可桥接本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 HTML/JS 或视频壁纸，并提供暗化、模糊、边框和玻璃调节。兼容 DSH `>=0.1.6-alpha.2`，不兼容更早的 `0.1.0-rc.8` 契约。
description.en: DSH Beautify is an all-in-one appearance pack with 29 themes, a 10-state whale cursor, interactive main and sub-agent whale pets, sound controls, and custom skins. It can also bridge local Wallpaper Engine HTML/JS or video wallpapers, with dimming, blur, border, and glass controls. It targets DSH `>=0.1.6-alpha.2` and is not compatible with the earlier `0.1.0-rc.8` client contract.

description.zh: Dracula 主题将官方 Dracula 色板接入 DSH 的内置主题运行时，提供经典 `#282a36` 与 Dracula Soft `#343746` 两种暗色变体，并覆盖界面表面、侧栏、输入框、菜单和 `--shiki-*` 代码高亮；在设置 → 通用一键切换，选择会跨会话保存。DSH Desktop 2.0.4+ 应使用 1.1.0。
description.en: Dracula integrates the official Dracula palette into DSH's built-in theme runtime with two dark variants: classic `#282a36` and Dracula Soft `#343746`. It covers UI surfaces, the sidebar, composer, menus, and `--shiki-*` syntax highlighting; switch it from Settings → General, with the choice persisted across sessions. DSH Desktop 2.0.4+ requires version 1.1.0.

description.zh: 本地壁纸玻璃皮肤允许在设置 → 背景图输入本地图片路径（≤8MB），将壁纸放在 DSH Web 窗口下方并把侧栏、对话框变为半透明玻璃；浅/深主题自适应，路径保存于 `localStorage`，重启自动恢复，图片只在本机传输且不联网。
description.en: A local-wallpaper glass skin for DSH Web: enter a local image path (up to 8 MB) in Settings → Background Image, place it behind the window, and make the sidebar and dialogs translucent. It adapts to light/dark themes, stores the path in `localStorage`, restores it after restart, and keeps the image local without network upload.

description.zh: 米黄色主题提供温暖的奶油白/米黄浅色界面，以纸张卡片、玻璃浮层、木质侧栏和纸张代码页组成视觉层，适合长时间 AI 编程阅读；基于 DSH `--dsw-alias-*` token 和稳定 DOM 钩子，只改视觉，不改业务逻辑。
description.en: A warm cream-and-beige light theme for DSH, with paper-like cards, glass overlays, a wood sidebar, and paper-style code pages designed for long coding sessions. It uses DSH `--dsw-alias-*` tokens and stable DOM hooks, changing the visual layer without touching application logic.

description.zh: C-137 皮肤提供 28 张 Rick and Morty 目录海报、自定义场景、霓虹外观，以及 Rick、Morty 和传送枪叠加宠物；可在皮肤行调节透明度、管理最多 12 张自定义场景，并拖动角色进入传送门互动。需要 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x`（已在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证），不是官方产品。
description.en: The C-137 skin provides 28 Rick and Morty catalog posters, custom scenes, neon chrome, and Rick, Morty, and portal-gun overlay pets. Its skin row supports opacity control and up to 12 custom scenes, while the pets can be dragged into the portal for interactions. It requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` (verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`) and is unofficial.

description.zh: 官网风格主题把 deepseek.com 的视觉语言带入 DSH：新会话页的 WebGL2 流体渐变背景、鼠标交互点阵网格、可被打散并回正的粒子鱼 LOGO、标题聚光灯和磨砂玻璃，并随 `color-scheme` 自动适配浅/深色。它是纯客户端注入，依赖 WebGL2、Canvas 2D 与 `backdrop-filter`，且没有设置页开关；项目声明非官方。
description.en: This site-inspired theme brings deepseek.com's visual language into DSH with a WebGL2 fluid gradient backdrop on the new-session page, a mouse-reactive dot grid, a particle-fish logo that can scatter and reform, a title spotlight, and frosted glass that follows `color-scheme` for light/dark modes. It is a client-only injection requiring WebGL2, Canvas 2D, and `backdrop-filter`; there is no settings toggle, and the project is unofficial.

description.zh: DSH Icon Theme 为设置导航和侧边栏操作自动分配统一图标，并允许逐项手动覆盖；它发现实时 `settings.section` 与 `sidebar.footer.action`，内置 50 个 Fluent UI 16 Regular 图标和 dsh-market 单色图标，选择按稳定键保存，卸载/热重载可恢复宿主 SVG。兼容 DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`。
description.en: DSH Icon Theme assigns coherent icons to Settings and sidebar actions, with per-target overrides. It discovers live `settings.section` and `sidebar.footer.action` contributions, ships 50 Fluent UI 16 Regular glyphs plus the dsh-market monochrome glyph, persists choices by stable key, and restores host SVGs on unload or hot reload. It targets DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`.

name.zh: 天魔命曲 DSH 皮肤

description.zh: 《弹丸论破：天魔命曲》主题皮肤使用同人游戏素材打造全屏 DSH Web 外观：自定义光标、全屏壁纸、梯形侧栏、对话输入条、动态底部数据走马灯、发送按钮、运行轮盘和新会话按钮。数据条会在智能体更新节点时保持动画相位，悬停时暂停；项目使用公开 DOM 钩子，游戏素材按单独许可发布，属于非官方同人作品。
description.en: An Angels & Demon Fate Symphony skin for DSH Web built from fan-game assets, with a custom cursor, full-screen wallpaper, trapezoid sidebar, composer bar, animated bottom data ticker, send button, running spinner, and new-session button. The ticker keeps its animation phase when agent updates rebuild nodes and pauses on hover; it uses public DOM hooks, and the game assets follow a separate license. It is unofficial fan work.

description.zh: DSH 动漫皮肤管理器提供经典、亚丝娜、明日香、加藤惠、远坂凛和阿尔托莉雅六套皮肤，并配套浮动 `☰` 菜单、按工作区分组的会话列表、皮肤切换弹窗和主题化 UI 覆盖；选择通过 cookie 与 `localStorage` 持久化。它是 plain Cordis 插件，不应加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`；会话菜单不提供删除操作。
description.en: A browser-side manager for six skins—Classic, Asuna, Asuka, Megumi Kato, Rin Tohsaka, and Artoria—with a floating `☰` menu, workspace-grouped session list, skin picker, and theme-aware UI overrides. The selection persists through a host cookie with a localStorage fallback. It is a plain Cordis plugin, not a `dsh.bundle`; do not add it to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The session menu does not provide deletion.

description.zh: 股市行情终端将 DSH Web 变为交易终端，并提供自选跑马灯、实时行情、持仓盈亏、指数快照和可缩放拖拽的日/周/月 K 线图（蜡烛、MA、成交量与十字光标）。支持 A 股、港股、美股、指数、加密货币和外汇，刷新间隔可设为 15/30/60 秒；行情来自腾讯、Binance、Yahoo 与 Frankfurter 聚合。
description.en: A trading-terminal skin and market panel for DSH Web with a watchlist ticker, live quotes, portfolio P/L, index snapshots, and zoomable, pannable day/week/month candlestick charts with MA, volume, and crosshair overlays. It covers A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks, indices, crypto, and FX; polling can be set to 15/30/60 seconds, using data aggregated from Tencent, Binance, Yahoo, and Frankfurter.

description.zh: DSH UI Enhancer 组合桌面式工作区、壁纸、桌面宠物和文件引用：支持本地图片/URL 壁纸及模糊、遮罩、透明度调节，宠物可命名、拖动、缩放、隐藏并管理最多 12 个本地形象，输入 `@` 可插入工作区文件引用，右侧可预览 Markdown、代码/Diff、CSV、PDF、图片、HTML 和 URL。文件读取限制在 Harness 工作区并做 realpath 校验，宠物与素材留在浏览器本地。
description.en: DSH UI Enhancer combines a desktop-style workspace, wallpaper controls, a customizable desktop pet, and file references. It supports local or URL wallpapers with blur, mask, and opacity controls; named, draggable pets with up to 12 locally stored appearances; `@` file references; and right-pane previews for Markdown, code/Diff, CSV, PDF, images, HTML, and URLs. File access is restricted to Harness workspace roots with realpath checks, and pet assets stay in the browser.

description.zh: 十三动态背景为 DSH Web 提供实时壁纸，支持 GIF、动图 WebP/APNG、PNG/JPG 及 MP4/WebM/MOV；按扩展名或 MIME 自动识别，视频静音循环并在切后台时暂停，图片存为 CSS 背景。上传内容保存于 IndexedDB；远程媒体使用 HTTP(S) URL，本地文件路径不能直接作为 URL。
description.en: Thirteen Live Wallpaper adds live backgrounds to DSH Web, accepting GIF, animated WebP/APNG, PNG/JPG, and MP4/WebM/MOV. It detects formats by extension or MIME; videos loop muted and pause when the page is backgrounded, while images use a CSS background. Uploaded media is stored in IndexedDB; remote media uses HTTP(S) URLs, and local file paths cannot be entered as URLs.

description.zh: Weniger 是一套受迪特·拉姆斯启发的极简主题：暖纸白、发丝线边框、近黑墨色与单一信号橙，采用 0–4px 方角网格和扁平表面；同时重映射明暗两套 token、代码高亮、用户气泡与输入控件，并提供中德双语的十项设计原则面板。项目是非官方致敬作品。
description.en: Weniger is a Dieter Rams-inspired minimalist theme with warm paper whites, hairline borders, near-black ink, one signal-orange accent, a 0–4px squared geometry grid, and flat surfaces. It remaps the token graph in both light and dark modes, including syntax highlighting, user bubbles, and composer controls, and adds a Chinese/German panel quoting the ten principles of good design. It is an unaffiliated homage.

description.zh: 复古麦金塔将 Mac OS 8/9 Platinum 风格带入 DSH Web：铂金灰、Chicago/Geneva/Monaco 字体、CSS 条纹壁纸、浮雕控件、硬阴影和方形滚动条。提供 Platinum/Graphite 两种皮肤，各含 Classic Blue 与 System Teal 高亮，支持可选 Happy Mac 启动屏；选择按浏览器存入 `localStorage`，可逐像素恢复内置外观。
description.en: Retro Macintosh brings Mac OS 8/9 Platinum styling to DSH Web with platinum greys, Chicago/Geneva/Monaco fonts, a CSS pinstripe desktop, beveled controls, hard shadows, and square scrollbars. It offers Platinum and Graphite skins, each with Classic Blue or System Teal accents, plus an optional Happy Mac startup splash. Choices persist in browser `localStorage`, and switching back restores the built-in appearance pixel-identically.

description.zh: DSH Diorama 是角色舞台皮肤，提供“雪乃·暖阳日常”和“隐秘年代志”两套角色主题，每套含双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可在装饰看板中拖动、缩放、旋转并调节透明度，上传自定义素材，还能将素材与布局导入/导出为可分享 JSON 包。选择和装饰配置保存于 `localStorage`。
description.en: DSH Diorama is a character-stage skin with two themes—Yukino: Warm Daily and Occult Chronicle—each with dual character sprites and sticker sheets. Its decoration board supports dragging, resizing, rotating, opacity, and anchor controls; you can upload custom assets and import/export shareable JSON packs containing assets and layout. Skin and decoration settings persist in `localStorage`.

description.zh: 余额血量条把 DeepSeek 余额显示成游戏式 HP：HP 为当前余额，上限为余额加今日消耗（可估算，也可在界面同步平台值），每 5 分钟刷新并记录今日消耗。设置中提供默认进度条、Minecraft 红心、暗黑破坏神血球、守望先锋分格条和三国杀勾玉五种样式；数据写入工作区 `.dsh-balance-history.json`，余额查询之外不外发网络请求。充值会使当前上限口径同步抬高，README 将其列为待优化项。
description.en: Balance HP turns DeepSeek balance into a game-style health display: HP is the current balance, while the cap is balance plus today's estimated spend, with an option to sync the platform value. It refreshes every five minutes and records daily usage. Choose among a default bar, Minecraft hearts, Diablo blood orb, Overwatch segmented bar, or Sanguosha taiji jades; state is stored in `.dsh-balance-history.json`, with no outbound requests beyond the balance query. The README notes that top-ups currently raise the cap under this accounting model.

description.zh: 深海男仆工坊是鲸鱼男仆主题皮肤，加入少年鲸鱼男仆与成年鲸鱼管家两张左右立绘、Q 版侧栏吉祥物、日夜宫殿背景及深海蓝金 UI；支持响应式着陆页、对话页、工作区和窄侧栏，素材以内嵌 data URI 提供。项目为衍生创作，采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，仅限非商业使用。
description.en: A deep-sea butler skin with two original male whale characters—a young whale butler and an adult whale steward—plus a Q-version sidebar mascot, day/night palace backdrops, and navy-and-gold UI. It adapts across the landing, conversation, workspace, and narrow-sidebar views, with artwork embedded as data URIs. This derivative work is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and non-commercial.

name.zh: DSH 潮汐液态玻璃皮肤

description.zh: 潮汐液态玻璃皮肤以极光潮汐、深海焦散和 SVG 海浪动画铺设背景，把对话、侧栏、设置、消息气泡和输入卡变为可调液态玻璃；左侧工作区可拖动/折叠，Q 版鲸鱼娘可拖动并打开四区域调节面板。玻璃参数保存在 `localStorage`，主题偏好写入 `settings.yaml`；支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，卸载后清理 DOM 并恢复官方界面。
description.en: Tide is a liquid-glass skin with an aurora-tide backdrop, deep-sea caustics, and animated SVG waves. It turns chat, sidebar, settings, message bubbles, and the composer into tunable glass; the left workspace is draggable/collapsible, and a draggable Q-version whale-girl opens four-region tuning controls. Glass parameters persist in `localStorage`, while the theme preference is written to `settings.yaml`; `prefers-reduced-motion` is honored, and unloading cleans up the DOM and restores the official UI.

description.zh: 以皇家马德里为主题的双模式皮肤：暗色采用深蓝与浅金的伯纳乌夜场，亮色采用暖白、金边与黑色条纹，并加入“1902”水印、队徽和字标。装饰位于内容后方，不遮挡输入框或文字；仅支持 DSH Web profile，属于非官方、个人非商业球迷作品。
description.en: A Real Madrid dual-mode skin: a navy-and-pale-gold Bernabéu night scene in dark mode, and warm white, gold trim, and black stripes in light mode, with “1902,” crest, and wordmark layers. Decorations stay behind content so inputs and text remain unobstructed. Web profile only; unofficial fan work for personal, non-commercial use.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 对话输入栏的主发送按钮图标替换为鲸鱼图形，使用 CSS mask 并随按钮文字色适配亮暗主题。只改外观，不改变发送行为，也不会替换停止或队列按钮；零依赖。
description.en: Replaces the main send-button icon in the DSH Web composer with a whale graphic using a CSS mask that follows the button text color in light and dark themes. It changes appearance only, leaving send behavior, the stop button, and queue controls untouched; no dependencies.

description.zh: Leafy 在 DSH Web GUI 上叠加浅色翡翠绿与深色薄荷绿两套调色板，提供分层背景、深色侧栏、柔和圆角、绿色阴影、薄荷色选区、细滚动条和克制动效，并跟随亮色、暗色或系统外观切换。组件字号与布局保持宿主原样；Windows 上的半透明菜单是颜色分层，不是真正的透窗模糊。
description.en: Leafy overlays the DSH Web GUI with light emerald and dark mint palettes, layered surfaces, softer corners, green-tinted shadows, mint selection, slim scrollbars, and restrained motion. It follows light, dark, or system appearance. Component sizing and layout remain unchanged; on Windows, translucent menus are color layering rather than true see-through blur.

description.zh: 像素风 INFJ Sage 桌宠会根据 DSH 会话状态切换静观、阅读、共情、充电和受挫等姿态；可点击对话、拖拽并记住位置，右键打开设置。支持会话范围、尺寸、休息延迟、配色和动效选项，跟随 DSH 语言与明暗主题；只读取会话身份和状态，不调用模型、不联网或上传遥测。
description.en: INFJ Sage is a pixel-art companion that changes between observing, reading, empathy, recharging, and setback poses as DSH sessions change. Click for characterful lines, drag it to a remembered position, and right-click for settings such as session scope, size, nap delay, palette, and motion. It follows DSH language and appearance, reads session identity and status only, and makes no model calls, network requests, or telemetry.

description.zh: 使用 Anime2.5DRig 将一张干净背景的角色图或 PSD 自动装配为 WebGL 2.5D 桌宠，提供发丝物理、眨眼与表情动画，并映射思考、空闲、出错、完成和等待审批等 DSH 状态。支持自定义 PSD、人设、34 个参数、帧率、透明度、拖拽和左右翻转；需要支持 WebGL 的浏览器，当前版本面向 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。
description.en: Turns a clean-background character image or PSD into a WebGL 2.5D pet with Anime2.5DRig auto-rigging, hair physics, blinking, expressions, and DSH state mirroring for thinking, idle, errors, completion, and approval waits. Supports custom PSDs, personas, 34 live parameters, FPS and opacity controls, dragging, and horizontal flipping. Requires a WebGL-capable browser and targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

description.zh: Q 版芙莉莲桌宠会跟随 Agent 的空闲、思考、工具调用、流式输出、等待审批、计划评审和报错状态切换动画与气泡。支持单击挥手、双击跳跃、拖拽定位、隐藏/恢复，并记住位置；开启减少动态效果时显示静态状态帧。素材为个人非商业同人作品。
description.en: A chibi Frieren pet follows Agent idle, thinking, tool-call, streaming, approval, plan-review, and error states with matching animations and speech bubbles. Click to wave, double-click to jump, drag to reposition, or hide and restore it; the position is remembered, and reduced-motion mode uses static state frames. The artwork is personal, non-commercial fan art.

description.zh: 双世界背景皮肤：暗色是月读夜水、鸟居朱红与月轮金，亮色是东京白昼的纸感街景；两套原创背景含分层景深，暗色另有流星群与水面涟漪。支持明暗主题切换、90+ 主题令牌和可选自备立绘槽位；公开构建不附带角色立绘，动效可按减少动态效果停用。
description.en: A two-world backdrop skin: moonlit Tsukuyomi night water with vermilion torii and gold moonlight in dark mode, and a paper-like Tokyo daytime scene in light mode. Original layered backgrounds add depth; dark mode also renders meteors and water ripples. It includes light/dark token mapping and optional slots for your own standees. The public build ships without character art, and reduced-motion mode disables the effects.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek-Refined 的 Obsidian Border 风格移植到 DSH Web，提供 Border、Nord、Twilight、GitHub 和 Atom One 五套主题，亮暗外观跟随系统；同时美化 Markdown、代码块、工具卡片与 diff，并支持行内代码点击复制和会话头部主题切换。主题不联网、不改 DSH 源码；少数依赖哈希类名的细化规则可能在宿主升级后回退。
description.en: A DeepSeek-Refined port for the DSH Web GUI with five Obsidian Border-style themes—Border, Nord, Twilight, GitHub, and Atom One—that follow light and dark system appearance. It also refines Markdown, code, tool, and diff cards, adds click-to-copy for inline code, and provides a header theme switcher. It makes no network requests or source changes; a few hashed-class refinements may fall back after host upgrades.

name.zh: 月宝儿 Moony 音乐播放器

description.zh: 将音乐播放器接入 DSH 对话框：可用自然语言搜索、点歌、整理歌单、查看歌词、推荐播放、切歌、暂停和收藏；右下角的月宝儿 Moony 浮窗会随播放律动并显示工作状态。支持十种 Moony 形象、拖拽/折叠/隐藏和本地推荐记忆；音乐服务只监听 127.0.0.1，授权的本地音乐路径不会上传。
description.en: An integrated music player built into the DSH conversation: search, play, organize playlists, view lyrics, get recommendations, skip, pause, and save tracks with natural-language requests. A floating Moony pet moves with playback and reflects DSH work status; it offers ten forms plus drag, collapse, hide, and local preference memory. The music service listens on 127.0.0.1, and explicitly authorized local music paths stay local.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 8 个皮肤家族、15 套明暗主题：Glass、Claude、Nord、Coffee、Matrix、Ocean、Mono 和 Sakura。设置页内置皮肤中心，可在浅色、深色与系统默认之间一键切换并即时恢复；主题只覆盖官方 `--dsw-*` 令牌，不读写会话、请求或工作区数据。一次只应启用一个皮肤插件。
description.en: A DSH Web skin family with eight groups and 15 light/dark themes: Glass, Claude, Nord, Coffee, Matrix, Ocean, Mono, and Sakura. Its built-in skin center switches between light, dark, and the system default, with immediate restoration. It overrides only the official `--dsw-*` tokens and does not read or modify session, request, or workspace data. Use only one skin plugin at a time.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Dracula 深色配色，并通过 `--dsw-*`、`--shiki-*` 和 `--json-tree-*` 令牌统一代码块、语法高亮、JSON 树、差异视图及界面元素。另调优编程字体、正文列宽、代码块横向滚动和工具输出高度；切回浅色外观即恢复宿主配色。
description.en: A Dracula dark theme for the DSH Web GUI that maps `--dsw-*`, `--shiki-*`, and `--json-tree-*` tokens across code blocks, syntax highlighting, the JSON tree, diff views, and interface surfaces. It also tunes programming fonts, reading-column width, horizontal code scrolling, and tool-output height; switching back to light appearance restores the host palette.

description.zh: 一只可配置的智子悬浮桌宠，提供 11 款动态眼睛皮肤、瞳孔跟随鼠标、眨眼/东张西望、幽灵模式，以及头顶目标进度与短标题。支持拖拽、尺寸、台词、人设、动效和 AI 模式设置，并包含面向产品设计任务的五步流程与质量闸。语音实时交互和摄像头跟随在固定 README 中仍标为规划中。
description.en: A configurable floating Sophon pet with 11 animated eye skins, mouse-following pupils, blinking and idle glances, ghost mode, and a goal-progress/title display. It supports dragging, size, dialogue, persona, motion, and AI-mode settings, and includes a five-step product-design workflow with a verification gate. Real-time voice and camera tracking are still listed as planned features in the fixed README.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中自由游动的原创 3D 鲸鱼桌宠。任务完成、出错或等待批准时播放 attention 动画，并在浏览器允许时播放鲸吟；支持单击、双击、拖拽、自由游动、隐藏，以及原地睡觉或回到右下角睡 5 分钟。
description.en: An original 3D whale pet that swims freely in the DSH Web interface. It plays an attention animation for task completion, errors, or approval waits, with whale-call audio when the browser allows it. Click, double-click, drag, hide it, or send it to the lower-right corner to sleep for five minutes.

description.zh: 将照片铺满 DSH Web GUI，并把面板、边框和品牌色变成配套的玻璃质感主题。提供浅/深两套 token、0–100% 浓淡滑块、五套配色、自定义强调色、可替换图片，以及右下角可拖动胶囊和完整设置页；图片无法加载时插件不介入。自定义图片保存在浏览器本地，安装或更新后需重启 Web profile 并强制刷新页面。
description.en: Paints a photo across the DSH Web GUI and turns panels, borders, and brand colors into matching glass-like surfaces. It provides light and dark token sets, a 0–100% density slider, five palettes, a custom accent color, image replacement, and both a draggable corner pill and a full settings page; if the image cannot load, the plugin does nothing. Custom images stay in the browser, and installation or updates require restarting the Web profile and hard-reloading the page.

description.zh: 将 DSH 的设计令牌映射为 Claude Design System 风格的暖灰表面、陶土橙强调色、圆角、阴影和排印，提供明暗两套配色。组件细化覆盖输入框、侧栏、Markdown、表格、代码块、工具卡片与 diff，并支持主题模式、强调色、表面暖度、圆角、阴影和组件精修等设置；默认代码块自动换行。可选的宿主补丁用于恢复 edit/write 卡片的真实文件行号，缺少宿主起点时显示“—”。
description.en: Maps DSH design tokens to a Claude Design System look with warm-gray surfaces, a clay-orange accent, rounded shapes, shadows, and typography in light and dark modes. Component refinement covers the composer, sidebar, Markdown, tables, code blocks, tool cards, and diffs, with settings for theme mode, accent, surface warmth, radius, shadow, and component polish. Code blocks wrap by default; an optional host patch restores real file line numbers for edit/write cards, which otherwise show “—” when the host has no source offsets.

description.zh: 暖调像素主题：亮色为暖米白纸面与深褐墨字，暗色为街机琥珀磷光；提供像素字体、方角/硬描边、CRT 扫描线、开屏自检和流式输出状态动效。可在设置中调整强度、动效、扫描线和字体，开启减少动态效果时关闭动效；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上。
description.en: A warm pixel theme with cream paper and dark-brown ink in light mode, and arcade amber phosphor in dark mode. It adds pixel fonts, square hard-edged surfaces, CRT scanlines, a startup self-test, and streaming/state effects. Configure intensity, motion, scanlines, and fonts in Settings; reduced-motion mode disables the effects. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer.

name.zh: DSH Nekojishi VN 视觉小说主题

description.zh: 将 DSH 变成视觉小说舞台：背景、左右人物、悬浮对话流、贴底输入框和随任务状态变化的表情，同时保留原生模型、项目、工具和权限。公开版默认使用原创生成的三张场景与合成音乐，不含游戏角色资源；可在本机导入 Nekojishi 1.06s 资源。当前仅完整验证于 Windows 桌面端 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，其他系统与版本未完整验证。
description.en: Turns DSH into a visual-novel stage with backgrounds, side characters, a floating dialogue flow, a bottom-anchored composer, and expressions driven by real task states while keeping native models, projects, tools, and permissions. The public build uses three original generated scenes and synthesized music and does not include game character assets; Nekojishi 1.06s resources can be imported locally. Full verification is documented only for Windows Desktop with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.

description.zh: 神里绫华主题插件：右侧半透明立绘、输入框右上角可点击的 Q 版头像（语音与文字气泡同步）、樱花与雪花飘落，以及亮/暗双模式的冰蓝配色。安装到 DSH Web 后需重启；README 建议使用深色外观，否则浅色模式可能出现过亮的白底效果。
description.en: A Kamisato Ayaka theme for the DSH Web client with a translucent right-side portrait, a clickable chibi Ayaka at the composer, synced voice and text bubbles, falling sakura and snow, and an icy-blue light/dark palette. Restart DSH Web after installation; the README recommends dark appearance because light mode can become overwhelmingly white.

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供 Tokyo Night 亮色与暗色主题，包含主题运行时配色、半透明/亚克力面板、材质模糊、遮罩模糊和可搜索的等宽字体选择器；颜色与面板透明度按可读性约束。支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上，0.2.1-rc.2 已验证；README 明确网页端尚未完成真实测试。
description.en: Tokyo Night light and dark themes for DSH Desktop with runtime theme registration, translucent/acrylic panels, material and mask blur, and a searchable monospace-font picker. Surface alpha is guarded for readability. It targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+ with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 verified; the README says the Web profile has not received full real-device testing.

description.zh: 按 Windows 2000 度量表重塑 DSH Web GUI：经典灰色控件、双色渐变标题栏、1px 立体浮雕、绝对直角和 16px 滚动条；面板可拖动、折叠并切换暗色模式，随包提供点阵字体。全局字号为 11px，头像、状态点和开关滑块也会变成方形；少数依赖宿主哈希类名的细化规则可能在升级后回退。
description.en: Repaints the DSH Web GUI using Windows 2000 metrics: classic gray controls, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, hard square corners, and a 16px scrollbar. The panel is draggable and collapsible, supports a dark paint, and ships bitmap fonts. Global text drops to 11px, avatars, status dots, and switch knobs also become square, and a few hashed-class refinements may fail after host upgrades.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web/Desktop 客户端改成 Windows 11 WinUI 3 / Fluent 2 风格：Segoe UI Variable 与 Cascadia 字体、Mica 风格底层、亚克力弹出层、Fluent 圆角、焦点环和语义色。浅暗模式跟随 DSH 外观，Windows 系统强调色可同步；非 Windows 或无法读取注册表时回退到 WinUI 默认蓝。Mica 是页面内的模拟效果，不是系统桌面材质。
description.en: A Windows 11 WinUI 3 / Fluent 2 skin for the DSH Web and Desktop clients, with Segoe UI Variable and Cascadia fonts, a Mica-like canvas, acrylic popups, Fluent corners, focus rings, and semantic colors. Light/dark modes follow DSH appearance, and Windows system accent colors can be synchronized; other environments fall back to WinUI blue. Mica is simulated in the page, not the system desktop material.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 背后加入缓慢漂移的极光背景，并将面板改为轻量半透明玻璃；支持多套预设、远程图片、本地上传、深浅色跟随、压暗强度与玻璃通透度实时调节。它不使用 `backdrop-filter` 或实时模糊管线；远程图片会向图片服务暴露用户 IP，本地图片以 data URL 存入 profile，单张上限 4 MB。当前包面向 DSH 0.2.x，DSH 0.1.x 需使用 `dsh-aurora-glass@0.1.0`。
description.en: Adds a slowly drifting aurora background behind the DSH Web UI and lightweight translucent panel surfaces. It supports presets, remote images, local uploads, light/dark adaptation, and live controls for dimming and transparency. It does not use `backdrop-filter` or a real-time blur pipeline; remote images expose the user's IP to the image host, while local images are stored as data URLs in the profile with a 4 MB limit. The current package targets DSH 0.2.x; DSH 0.1.x requires `dsh-aurora-glass@0.1.0`.

description.zh: 像素动态星空主题，提供 Matrix、Sakura、Ocean、Sunset 和 Vapor 五套明暗配色、四套分层文字方案、五款内嵌像素字体（含简体中文）、方角/柔和/圆角预设、像素时钟、旋转星空与流星。所有效果可在设置页调整，减少动态效果时关闭扫描线与动效；不需要网络请求。
description.en: A pixel starfield theme with five light/dark palettes—Matrix, Sakura, Ocean, Sunset, and Vapor—four layered text schemes, five embedded pixel fonts including Simplified Chinese, corner presets, a pixel clock, a rotating starfield, and meteors. Configure everything in the settings tab; reduced-motion mode disables scanlines and motion, and no network requests are needed.

description.zh: 把 DSH 当前会话的 todo 任务清单搬到常驻悬浮球：显示已完成/总数、进行中任务名和进度环，点击展开完整清单，右键切换胶囊模式，并支持拖拽、历史归档、固定多个会话和上下/左右布局。提供 130 款共享皮肤、字色切换和浅深色跟随；只读同步，不修改官方面板或对话，支持 Desktop 与 Web，零遥测。
description.en: Moves the current DSH todo list into a persistent floating ball that shows completed/total counts, the active task name, and a progress ring. Click to expand the full list, right-click for capsule mode, and use dragging, history archiving, pinned multiple sessions, and stacked or side-by-side layouts. It includes 130 shared skins, text-color controls, light/dark following, Desktop and Web support, read-only synchronization, and no telemetry.

description.zh: Q 版 SVG 龙猫“绒绒”常驻 DSH Web 右下角，提供待机、开心、睡觉和进食四种姿态，以及喂食、抚摸、玩耍、睡觉/唤醒等养成互动。支持拖拽、大小与透明度调节、闲置隐藏、图鉴和本地持久化；纯 JavaScript、零构建、无第三方运行时依赖。
description.en: A hand-drawn chibi Totoro SVG named Rongrong lives in the lower-right corner of the DSH Web GUI, with idle, happy, sleeping, and eating poses plus feed, pet, play, sleep, and wake interactions. It supports dragging, size and opacity controls, idle hiding, a pose gallery, and local persistence; it is plain JavaScript with no build step or third-party runtime dependencies.

name.zh: 深海鲸蓝 UI 装饰

description.zh: 深海鲸蓝的 DSH Web 装饰层，覆盖亮/暗两套 14 个主题令牌，并加入鲸尾女仆元素、时钟与天气卡片、可折叠硬件状态面板和签名贴纸。背景图不随包提供，可自备；硬件面板显示哪些指标取决于本机，风扇与温度等额外传感器需要 HWiNFO 或 LibreHardwareMonitor。
description.en: A deep-sea whale-blue decoration layer for DSH Web with 14 light/dark theme tokens, whale-tail maid elements, a clock and weather card, a collapsible hardware panel, and a composer signature sticker. No background image is bundled—you supply your own. Hardware metrics depend on the machine; extra fan and temperature readings require HWiNFO or LibreHardwareMonitor.

description.zh: “山栖”把真实 DSH Web/Desktop 界面置于手绘山湖场景中：天空按本机时间连续经历晨光、白昼、黄昏与夜晚，星月和萤火在夜间出现；当前对话运行任务时，田间农人进场耕作，结束、取消或出错后离开。支持时间轴/手动预览、浅深色配色、环境微动与完整恢复宿主主题；使用 DSH 公开会话状态，不读取思考正文。
description.en: Shanqi places the real DSH Web/Desktop interface in a hand-drawn mountain-and-lake scene. The sky moves continuously through dawn, day, dusk, and night from local time, with stars, moonlight, and fireflies after dark; a farmer enters to work while the current conversation is running and leaves when it ends, is canceled, or errors. It supports timeline/manual preview, light/dark styling, ambient motion, and full host-theme restoration, using public session state rather than reading thought text.

description.zh: 一扇会随时间流动的插画天空，位于 DSH 工作区之后：根据城市、日期与时区估算日出日落，连续呈现晨光、晚霞、月牙和星光；支持时间轴、四个时间预设、一天播放，以及暂停当前天空作为工作区壁纸。城市、天空浓度和动效偏好仅存本地；不计算月亮轨迹，也不获取实时天气。新安装推荐 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，已有 0.1.1-rc.2 环境也有运行记录。
description.en: A living illustrated sky behind the DSH workspace: estimate sunrise and sunset from a city, date, and time zone, then move continuously through dawn, sunset, a crescent moon, and stars. Use a timeline, four time presets, or day playback, and pause a moment as the workspace wallpaper. City, sky intensity, and motion preferences stay local; it does not calculate a lunar path or fetch live weather. New installations are recommended to use DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with existing 0.1.1-rc.2 runs also documented.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 右下角提供会随会话状态变化的鲸鱼悬浮桌宠：空闲、加载、推理、评分、完成和报错时切换动画与气泡，支持点击、悬停、拖拽、位置持久化，以及自定义/Petdex 皮肤源和随机选择。当前 v0.2 艺术层统一使用内联鲸鱼 SVG；外部皮肤的专属像素图和设置页皮肤选择器仍在路线图中。
description.en: A floating whale pet for the lower-right DSH Web UI that changes animations and bubbles for idle, loading, inference, scoring, completion, and error states. It supports clicking, hovering, dragging, persistent positioning, custom or Petdex skin sources, and random selection. In the current v0.2 art layer, all selections render through an inline whale SVG; dedicated pixel art for external skins and a settings-panel picker remain on the roadmap.

description.zh: Whale3 在 DSH Web UI 顶部加入会水平游动的鲸鱼桌宠，默认座头鲸，可右键循环切换座头鲸、蓝鲸和虎鲸，双击回到第一种。三种鲸鱼有独立轮廓，支持拖拽定位、眨眼、摆尾、喷水和配置页即时生效；安装在用户 profile 中，应用升级后仍保留。
description.en: Whale3 adds a whale pet that swims horizontally across the top of the DSH Web UI. It starts as a humpback; right-click cycles through humpback, blue whale, and orca, while double-click returns to the first. The three whales have distinct silhouettes, with dragging, blinking, tail and spout animation, and an in-plugin configuration page with immediate effect. It lives in the user profile and survives app upgrades.

description.zh: 莫奈壁纸主题将本地图片、图片链接或内置渐变的颜色提取为 Material 3 动态色板，并映射到 DSH 亮/暗主题；提供整窗壁纸、主体/侧栏独立毛玻璃、设置页透视、8 组色板与 8 组渐变壁纸，以及风格、强度、明度和动效控制。仅在插件设置页生效，不改主页面/左侧栏槽位；远程图片受页面 CSP 限制，关闭或卸载后恢复默认界面。
description.en: This Monet wallpaper theme extracts Material 3 dynamic colors from a local image, image URL, or built-in gradient and maps them onto DSH light and dark themes. It provides a full-window wallpaper, independently configurable frosted surfaces for the main area and sidebar, a translucent settings view, eight palette presets, eight gradient wallpapers, and controls for style, intensity, brightness, and motion. It lives only in the plugin settings page, does not occupy the main or sidebar slots, remote images can be blocked by page CSP, and disabling or uninstalling restores the default UI.

description.zh: 一次安装即可获得多套由 JSON 定义的全屏主题和侧栏场景，并附带可选的调色选择器、宠物挂件、标题栏心情问候与菜单折叠卡；新增皮肤只需添加 JSON，无需改代码或重新安装插件。
description.en: Install once for a collection of JSON-defined full-screen themes and sidebar scenes, plus optional palette, pet-widget, title-bar greeting, and menu-collapse cards. Add another skin by dropping in JSON—no code change or plugin reinstall required.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成 MiMo 风格的暖白编辑版面：黑色发丝分隔线、衬线正文、橙色强调色，并提供浅色与深色外壳、可调强调色和顶部滚动字标。
description.en: Reskins the DSH Web GUI in MiMo's warm editorial style with off-white paper, black hairline rules, serif prose, and an orange accent. It includes light and dark shells, an adjustable accent, and an optional scrolling wordmark.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供近黑纸面、薄荷绿强调色、顶部渐变字标状态带，以及 2px 直角和 0.5px 内高光；支持深色、浅色和跟随产品的外壳。
description.en: Reskins the DSH Web GUI with near-black paper, a mint accent, a gradient wordmark status band, 2px corners, and 0.5px inner highlights. Choose dark, light, or follow the product's appearance.

description.zh: 以 Sublime Text 的 Mariana 配色为默认预设，提供 18 个可调色位、9 类 Markdown 正文角色、可保存预设、实时 WCAG 对比度提示，以及明暗模式。可选的 Glass 界面还支持壁纸、生成渐变和程序化等高线背景。
description.en: Uses Sublime Text's Mariana palette as the default and adds 18 adjustable color slots, 9 Markdown prose roles, saved presets, live WCAG contrast warnings, and light/dark modes. Optional Glass UI can layer the theme over a wallpaper, generated gradient, or procedural contour background.

description.zh: 提供两套完整的壁纸主题：深色「深空观测站」与浅色「黎明星云」，以白字和柔和阴影保证照片背景上的可读性，并配套 Montserrat + Noto Sans SC 可变字重排版与 74-token 明暗色板。另在设置的模型页提供模型可用性、真实上下文窗口和端点支持的推理档位探测；这些探测会向模型端点发起请求。
description.en: Nebula Core ships two fully designed wallpaper themes—dark Deep-Space Observatory and light Dawn Nebula—with white text and soft shadows for readable over-photo copy, variable-weight Montserrat + Noto Sans SC typography, and a 74-token light/dark palette. It also adds a Model Probe panel that checks which configured models answer, their real context window, and the reasoning levels an endpoint accepts; probing sends requests to those endpoints.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 与桌面版的浮层中显示一只会跟随会话状态切换 GIF 的桌宠；支持点击/双击互动、拖动定位、审批/提问/计划评审提醒、按状态自定义 GIF，并在资源加载失败时使用着色占位动画。
description.en: Adds a desktop pet overlay to the DSH Web UI and desktop app, switching GIFs with the current session state. It supports click/double-click interactions, dragging with a saved relative position, approval/question/plan-review alerts, per-state custom GIFs, and a tinted placeholder when a GIF fails to load.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 右下角固定显示会轻微浮动的动画猫咪 GIF；长按 450ms 可拖动，位置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，并可配置大小、显隐和无障碍文案。图片加载失败时会自动隐藏，不影响页面。
description.en: Pins a gently floating Salary Cat GIF to the bottom-right of the DSH Web UI. Hold for 450 ms to drag it; its position is saved in browser `localStorage`, and size, visibility, and accessibility text are configurable. A failed image load hides the pet without affecting the page.

description.zh: 用「哦鲸鲸」替换智能体团队面板成员行的状态图标和子代理下拉中的状态点，并在会话头部增加供主会话与子代理共用的跑道。成员行、子代理列表和标题栏跑道可分别开关；跑道会读取名册与会话状态。
description.en: Replaces Agent Team member-row status icons and subagent-dropdown status dots with “ohjingjing” whales, and adds a shared runway in the session header for the lead session and its subagents. The member-row skin, subagent list, and header runway can be toggled independently; the runway follows the roster and session state.

description.zh: 以罗德岛终端为灵感的 DSH 皮肤：直角切角、黑色发丝线、警示黄条、四角登记标记和全屏细网格，提供浅色纸面与暗色作战终端两套底色。它面向 `dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1` 的托管发现、切换与持久化；README 描述了未安装控制台时的自立模式，但 manifest 也提示缺少 `uiSkinLoader` 可能让皮肤处于等待状态。
description.en: A Rhodes Island terminal-style DSH skin with square cut corners, black hairlines, warning-yellow bars, corner registration marks, and a full-screen fine grid. It is designed for managed discovery, switching, and persistence through `dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1`; the README documents a standalone mode without the skin console, while the manifest warns that a missing `uiSkinLoader` may leave the skin pending.

description.zh: 提供 16 个仅使用本地资源的动态萌宠模板；悬停或点击会按 Harness 当前中英文语言随机问候，并支持选择角色、左右停靠、大小、暂停、隐藏和快速隐藏。会跟随 DSH 的明暗主题与中英文设置，并尊重减少动效偏好。
description.en: Adds 16 local-only animated pet companions. Hover or click one for a short random greeting in the current Harness language; choose the character, dock it left or right, set its size, pause or hide it, and use the quick-hide control. It follows DSH light/dark and Chinese/English settings and respects reduced-motion preferences.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的插件设置页中调整界面字体、代码字体和 24 套调色板；配色会覆盖主题令牌与 Markdown 样式并立即保存到当前 profile，还会修复宽表格的 hover 抖动。已在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 实测兼容。
description.en: Configure UI and code fonts plus 24 color palettes from the DSH Web GUI's plugin settings page. Palette choices override theme tokens and Markdown styling, save to the current profile immediately, and also fix wide-table hover jitter. Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

description.zh: 像 Word 一样在设置中即时调整界面与代码字体、字号、字重、颜色和版式；支持中西文字体分开设置、Windows 已安装字体读取，以及内置的 STIX2Text 和 Latin Modern Mono Light。配置自动保存到 `~/.dsh`，不会修改系统字体。
description.en: A Word-like settings editor for DSH typography: change UI and code fonts, sizes, weights, colors, and layout with immediate WYSIWYG updates and auto-save. It supports separate CJK and Latin font choices, reads installed Windows fonts, and bundles STIX2Text and Latin Modern Mono Light without modifying system fonts; settings are stored in `~/.dsh`.

description.zh: 一套非官方的 Claude 风格 DSH Web 主题：暖纸色 `#F5F3EE`、陶土橙强调色 `#DA7756`、Noto Serif SC 界面字体和 Cascadia Mono 代码字体；与 Anthropic、DeepSeek 均无关联。
description.en: An unofficial Claude-inspired DSH Web theme with warm paper `#F5F3EE`, a clay-orange accent `#DA7756`, Noto Serif SC for the UI, and Cascadia Mono for code. It is not affiliated with Anthropic or DeepSeek.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供象牙白、墨色、淡玫瑰与古金配色，配合整页背景图、毛玻璃面板、飘落花瓣、黑冠徽记和可跳过的开屏动画；明暗模式跟随宿主外观设置。背景图、侧栏立绘和开屏素材需用户自备，缺少素材时会自动降级。
description.en: A DSH Web theme in ivory, ink, pale rose, and antique gold, with a full-page background, frosted-glass panels, falling petals, a black-crown emblem, and a skippable opening animation. Light and dark follow the host appearance setting. Backgrounds, sidebar artwork, and opening assets are user-supplied; missing assets fall back automatically.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 像素鲸作为 DSH Web 的右下角浮层桌宠，并按会话状态切换悬停、工作、受惊、庆祝、喝咖啡和睡眠等反应。图形以 40×31 网格像素化为单个带 CSS keyframes 的 SVG，不使用 GIF、APNG 或脚本。
description.en: Adds Seek, a pixelated DeepSeek whale, as a bottom-right overlay pet for DSH Web. It reacts to session states with idle, working, startled, celebration, coffee, and sleep animations. Each state is a single SVG with its own CSS keyframes—no GIF, APNG, or script.

description.zh: 一套非官方的太空歌剧风 DSH Web 暗色主题：深空背景、霓虹 HUD、黑洞吸积盘、行星轨道、扫描器、彗星轨迹、能量束和遥测面板，并为发送消息加入超空间风格效果。使用通用科幻元素，不包含或复刻特定作品的标志、角色或舰船设计；支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: An unofficial space-opera dark skin for DSH Web with deep-space layers, neon HUD chrome, a black-hole accretion disk, planetary orbits, scanner UI, comet trails, energy beams, and a telemetry panel, plus a hyperspace-style send effect. It uses generic sci-fi language rather than logos, characters, ships, or other protected designs from a specific franchise, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 设计成一间玻璃工作室：三层材质阶梯、按面积分档的模糊、放大的正文阅读标尺，以及氛围/专注与清透/标准/沉静场景。壁纸是唯一可变输入，可导入 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP（上限 32MB）；设置页提供钩子自检和可导出的 JSON 报告。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into a glass studio with a three-level material ladder, area-based blur tiers, a larger reading scale, and ambience/focus plus clear/standard/quiet scene modes. The wallpaper is the only variable input; JPEG, PNG, and WebP imports are accepted up to 32 MB, and the settings page includes hook checks with an exportable JSON report.

description.zh: 以主题画廊为首个模块的 DSH 定制 UI 套件，当前提供 23 套一键切换的主题，包括品牌风格适配与原创方案。每套主题约含 110 个 `--dsw-*` token，覆盖背景、边框、按钮、交互态、Markdown、侧栏、气泡、浮层、阴影与字体栈。
description.en: A DSH custom-UI suite whose current first module is a one-click theme gallery with 23 themes, including brand-style adaptations and original palettes. Each theme maps roughly 110 `--dsw-*` tokens across backgrounds, borders, buttons, interaction states, Markdown, the sidebar, bubbles, overlays, shadows, and font stacks.

description.zh: 在侧栏底部提供「主题与壁纸」面板：上传本机图片，分别为浅色/深色设置壁纸，管理图库和 6 套渐变预设，并调节各界面的磨砂材质。支持整窗铺满或浮窗布局、1/3/6/12/24 小时自动轮换；壁纸存储在本机。
description.en: Adds a Theme & Wallpaper panel to the sidebar footer for uploading local images, assigning separate light/dark wallpapers, managing a gallery and six gradient presets, and tuning frosted surfaces. It supports full-bleed or floating-card layouts and 1/3/6/12/24-hour rotation; wallpapers are stored locally.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 加入黑蓝暗调主题和会话区助理形象，支持静图与无缝循环片段、按文件名自动发现并切换形象，以及常驻呼吸/眨眼和点击或低频触发的动作。形象素材需放入 `assets/looks/`；卸载后还原界面，且不会替换 DSH 侧栏品牌位。
description.en: Adds a black-and-blue dark theme and an assistant character layer to the DSH Web GUI, with still images, seamless loops, filename-based discovery and switching, quiet breathe/blink idle states, and click or low-frequency actions. Character assets must be placed in `assets/looks/`; uninstall restores the UI and leaves DSH's sidebar branding in place.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中增加「外观」页，提供 Codex 风格蓝灰预设、跟随系统/浅色/深色模式、自定义颜色、字体字号、侧栏模糊、动效和对比度控制；设置保存在当前桌面应用的本地浏览器存储中。它是社区插件，并非官方 Codex 或 DeepSeek 产品；目前仅在 macOS 的 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上验证，Windows 实机效果尚未验证。
description.en: Adds an Appearance page to DSH with a Codex-inspired blue-gray preset, system/light/dark modes, custom colors, typography, sidebar blur, motion, and contrast controls. Settings stay in the current desktop app's local browser storage. This is an independent community plugin, not an official Codex or DeepSeek product; installation and the settings UI were verified on macOS with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, while Windows runtime behavior remains unverified.

description.zh: 提供 4 套预设配色与自定义配色，并分别为浅色/深色重建色阶；通过 OKLCH 色域处理和真实承载面上的对比度求解，调节文字色调、侧栏深度、Markdown 强调、滚动条与开关颜色。支持高对比度、配置导入导出和 4 种界面语言，使用 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens` 叠加颜色，不改宿主源码或外观偏好。
description.en: Provides four preset palettes plus a custom palette, with independent light and dark ramps. OKLCH gamut handling and contrast solving on the actual host surfaces drive controls for text tint, sidebar depth, Markdown emphasis, scrollbars, and switches. It also supports high contrast, configuration import/export, and four UI languages, applying colors through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens` without patching host source or changing the appearance preference.

description.zh: 一套以 Pornhub 风格为灵感、与其无关联且不含露骨内容的恶搞主题：炭黑/橙色配色、胶囊按钮、圆角「Deephub」字标、18+ 入口提示、HD/直播中徽章和「今日热门」侧栏卡片。它只改变外观与装饰，不改变 DSH 的功能，并随系统明暗模式切换。
description.en: A non-explicit, unaffiliated Pornhub-style parody skin with a charcoal-and-orange palette, pill buttons, a rounded “Deephub” wordmark, an 18+ entry gag, HD/LIVE badges, and a “today's hot pick” sidebar card. It changes appearance and decoration rather than DSH functionality, and follows the system light/dark mode.

description.zh: 以太极道君背景图、黛青强调色和楷体界面组成的 DSH Web 主题，提供宣纸/墨色罩层、半透明面板及自动跟随宿主明暗模式的边框、文字和滚动条配色。停用插件会移除 `--dsw-*` token 覆盖并还原官方外观。
description.en: A Guofeng Taiji theme for DSH Web with a Taiji-master background, dark-cyan accents, and a KaiTi-first interface. It adds paper/ink overlays, translucent panels, and scheme-aware borders, text, and scrollbar colors; disabling the plugin removes its `--dsw-*` token overrides and restores the stock UI.

description.zh: 提供 Aurora、Night Flight、Nordfjord 和 Sakura 四套精选配色，另有 Default 原生外观；每套都含浅/深色方案，自动跟随 DSH 外观设置，选择会保存并可一键恢复默认。
description.en: Ships four curated color skins—Aurora, Night Flight, Nordfjord, and Sakura—plus the Default stock look. Each skin has light and dark palettes that follow DSH's Appearance setting; the choice is persisted and Default restores the native UI.

description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供可视化外观编辑：用「检查元素」逐项选中文字并调整颜色、字号、字重、阴影与背景；另可切换预设配色、设置分区背景图、界面/代码字体、聊天宽度，并导出 JSON/CSS、导入 JSON 设置。修改实时生效，保存于 DSH 数据目录。
description.en: Provides a visual appearance editor for DSH: use Inspect Element to select individual pieces of text and adjust color, size, weight, shadow, and background. It also offers preset palettes, per-region background images, UI/code fonts, chat-width controls, JSON import/export, and CSS export. Changes apply live and are saved in DSH's data directory.

description.zh: 《原神》梦见月瑞希同人展示层主题，提供「暖梦纸灯」亮态与「夜樱月见」暗态，包含主题背景图、樱花玻璃气泡、半透明滑杆、对话细节配色和落瓣氛围层。素材来自作者本地资源；作品为非商用同人创作，与 HoYoverse 无关联，且仅运行在展示层，不读取或修改会话与模型请求。
description.en: A fan-made display-layer skin themed after Yumemizuki Mizuki from Genshin Impact, with the light “Paper-Lamp Daydream” and dark “Night-Sakura Moon” states, themed backgrounds, sakura-glass bubbles, opacity controls, chat-detail styling, and falling-petal ambience. Assets come from the author's local material library; it is a non-commercial fan work unaffiliated with HoYoverse and stays presentation-only, without reading or modifying sessions or model requests.

description.zh: 把助手 Markdown 中符合规范的 `> [!NOTE]`、`TIP`、`IMPORTANT`、`WARNING` 和 `CAUTION` 引用块渲染为主题感知的提示卡片，不修改会话内容或 DSH 核心渲染器；格式错误或未知标记会保留为普通文本。
description.en: Turns qualifying assistant-Markdown blockquotes—`> [!NOTE]`, `TIP`, `IMPORTANT`, `WARNING`, and `CAUTION`—into theme-aware callout cards without changing stored session content or DSH's core renderer. Malformed or unknown markers remain ordinary text.

description.zh: 仅在 DSH 新建会话页显示的字形背景：固定中文字形以雾状明暗流动，点击空白区域会荡开涟漪，并带稀疏蓝色字形点缀；进入已有会话或插件页后自动卸载。当前仅验证 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 Windows 桌面版，其他版本、平台、深色模式与 Web profile 未验证；README 预览 GIF 是两张截图轮播，不是连续录屏。
description.en: A glyph background that appears only on DSH's new-conversation screen: fixed Chinese glyphs flow in mist-like opacity, blank-area clicks create ripples, and sparse blue glyph clusters add accents. It unloads when you enter an existing conversation or the Plugins page. Only the DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Windows desktop build is verified; other versions, platforms, dark mode, and the Web profile are unverified, and the README GIF is a two-screenshot slideshow rather than a continuous recording.

description.zh: 一只活泼好奇的女儿形象桌宠，停在 DSH Web UI 窗口底部，会走动、眨眼、被拖动和抛接，并对点击、指针和长时间忽略作出反应；支持中文语音、字幕、音效和背景音乐，均可独立开关。资源全部随包提供、无需联网；安装「梁子」后还可触发父女互动场景。
description.en: A cheerful, curious daughter character that lives at the bottom of the DSH Web UI. It walks, blinks, can be picked up and dropped, and reacts to clicks, the pointer, and being ignored; Chinese voice lines, subtitles, sound effects, and background music each have their own switch. All assets ship locally with the package, with no network required; installing Liangzi adds father-and-daughter scenes.

description.zh: 以 DeepSeek 创始人为原型的沉稳父亲形象桌宠，会走动、眨眼、拖动、睡眠，并对点击与指针作出反应；支持中文语音、字幕、音效和背景音乐，均可独立开关。资源全部随包提供、无需联网；与「大肥鱼」同时安装时可演出六段父女小剧场。
description.en: A calm father character based on DeepSeek's founder that walks, blinks, sleeps, can be dragged, and reacts to clicks and the pointer. Chinese voice lines, subtitles, sound effects, and background music each have their own switch. All assets ship locally with the package, with no network required; installing Dafeiyu enables six father-and-daughter playlets.

description.zh: 在侧边栏“设置”触发器上方加入 DeepSeek API 余额卡片，读取官方 `GET /user/balance`，展示 `total_balance`、`topped_up_balance` 与 `granted_balance`，以及更新时间和基于卡片加载以来余额差的近似期间用量。默认每 60 秒自动刷新，也可手动刷新；刷新失败会保留上次成功值，`total_balance` 不高于 `lowBalanceThreshold`（默认 `5`）时显示低余额警告。Host 端读取已配置的凭据并只返回归一化数字，密钥不会发送到浏览器。该接口是预付费余额模型，不提供真正的“总配额/已用”字段。MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds a balance card above the sidebar Settings trigger.
