It reads DeepSeek’s official `GET /user/balance` endpoint and shows `total_balance`, the `topped_up_balance`/`granted_balance` breakdown, last-update time, and an approximate usage delta from when the card loaded. It refreshes every 60 seconds or manually, warns when `total_balance` is at or below `lowBalanceThreshold` (default `5`), and keeps the last good snapshot after a failed refresh. The host reads the configured credential and returns only normalized numbers; the credential never reaches the browser. The API is prepaid credit, not a true total/used quota. MIT licensed.

description.zh: Tidy Chat 将正常完成回合的中间工作折叠到可展开的回合标题中，同时保留最终答案、实时回合计时、紧凑排版和 Markdown 表格样式；表格支持圆角框、主题表头、行列分隔线，以及在 748px 阅读栏内横向滚动。插件通过 `Session.chat` 和原生语义锚点添加展示控件，不替换、移动或复制 React 节点，不改写模型输出或会话日志；它不发网络请求、不写浏览器存储，展开选择只保存在内存中，刷新即重置。当前活动分组支持 `bash`、`pwsh`、`read`、`write`、`edit`、`glob`、`grep`、`web_search`、`web_fetch` 等工具，其他工具保持原生展示；独立 Chat store 的宿主由 Harness 自己负责工作过程显示。目标版本为 DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.6`，已在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 验证；与其他排版插件的样式可能冲突。MIT 许可。
description.en: Tidy Chat folds the intermediate work of normally completed turns into an expandable header while keeping the final answer visible, and adds live turn timing, compact typography, and styled Markdown tables. Tables get rounded frames, themed headers, row and column rules, and horizontal scrolling inside DSH’s existing 748px reading column. It attaches presentation controls through `Session.chat` and native semantic anchors; it does not replace, move, or clone React nodes, rewrite model output, or modify session logs. It makes no network requests and writes no browser storage; expansion choices live in memory and reset on reload. Grouping currently covers `bash`, `pwsh`, `read`, `write`, `edit`, `glob`, `grep`, `web_search`, and `web_fetch`; other tools keep their native presentation. Hosts with a separate Chat store keep Harness’s own work disclosure. Targets DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.6` and is verified with `0.2.1-rc.2`; other layout plugins may compete for the same styles. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角放置会随 Agent 状态变化的桌宠：宿主监听持久化 `session/event`，折叠出 `idle`、`busy`、`thinking`、`streaming`、`tool`、`done`、`error` 七种姿态；浏览器通过 `/pet-mood?sessionId=…` 每 800ms 轮询，并在不可用时用 `useSessions` 快照兜底。桌宠注册到 `shell.overlay`，可拖动、点击触发互动动画；完成时由 Host 播放平台提示音（Windows `System.Media.SoundPlayer`、macOS `afplay`、Linux `ffplay`）。按 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 验证，其他版本需自行核对 API；需要 Node ≥20。仓库代码按 MIT 许可，但内置 GIF/PNG 来自公开第三方资源，仅供学习交流，商业使用边界不由 MIT 代码许可覆盖，权利人可要求移除。
description.en: Places an interactive pet in the bottom-right of DSH Web. The host folds persistent `session/event` records into seven poses—`idle`, `busy`, `thinking`, `streaming`, `tool`, `done`, and `error`—while the browser polls `/pet-mood?sessionId=…` every 800ms and falls back to the `useSessions` snapshot if polling is unavailable. The pet registers in `shell.overlay`, can be dragged, and plays interaction animations when clicked; the Host plays a platform-specific completion sound via `System.Media.SoundPlayer` on Windows, `afplay` on macOS, or `ffplay` on Linux. It was verified against DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`; other versions require API checking, and Node ≥20 is required. The repository code is MIT-licensed, but its bundled GIF/PNG artwork comes from public third-party sources for learning and exchange only; that does not grant commercial rights, and rights holders may request removal.

description.zh: 一次安装后，可在 DSH 设置中导入任意 Codex spritesheet 图集，不必为每只宠物编写插件代码。运行时自动识别 v1 `1536×1872`（9 行）与 v2 `1536×2288`（11 行、含 16 个注视帧），支持拖动持久化、悬停挥手、双击跳跃、`idle`/`waiting`/`running`/`review` 姿态和工具名或流式文本进度气泡；也可原地读取 `~/.codex/pets`（可用 `CODEX_HOME` 改目录）以及 `~/.dsh/pets` 中的图集。可选的定期 LLM 总结默认关闭；开启后只自动观察选定会话之后完成的请求，或由用户手动分析历史请求，并会把用户、助手、工具和错误内容的有界摘录发送给所选模型，产生服务商用量或费用。完成、错误和中断提示音可替换，上传音频存放在 `~/.dsh/pets/sounds/`。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.0-rc.1+；代码按 MIT 许可，内置示例 `nastya`（娜斯佳）图集按 CC BY-NC 4.0 授权，作为该角色使用时仍受非商业限制。
description.en: Install the runtime once, then import Codex spritesheet atlases from DSH settings without writing a plugin for each pet. It auto-detects v1 atlases at `1536×1872` (9 rows) and v2 atlases at `1536×2288` (11 rows, including 16 look cells), with persistent dragging, hover-to-wave, double-click jumping, `idle`/`waiting`/`running`/`review` poses, and progress bubbles for tool names or streaming text. It can also read `~/.codex/pets` in place (override the directory with `CODEX_HOME`) and use atlases in `~/.dsh/pets`. Optional periodic LLM summaries are off by default; when enabled, automatic summaries cover requests completed after a session is selected, while earlier requests require explicit analysis, and bounded excerpts of user, assistant, tool, and error content are sent to the selected model, incurring that provider’s usage or cost. Completion, error, and interruption sounds can be replaced; uploaded audio is stored under `~/.dsh/pets/sounds/`. It supports DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.0-rc.1+. The code is MIT-licensed, but the bundled `nastya` atlas is CC BY-NC 4.0, so using that character remains non-commercial.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面后方播放单个全屏循环视频，默认静音；右下角控件可还原原背景、播放/停止、切换静音和调节音量，并用“背景遮挡”滑杆同步控制 `--dsh-video-bg-scale` 与 `--dsw-skin-scrim`。标签页隐藏时暂停解码，`prefers-reduced-motion` 用户只显示静态遮罩，也可配合皮肤中心的模糊和遮挡控制。默认素材为 1440p/30fps，可替换 `assets/background.mp4`，但每次安装只支持一个视频，持续解码会占用 GPU。Host 通过仅允许 GET/HEAD 的同源隔离路由 `/api/video-bg/video.mp4` 提供包内固定文件，不接受路径输入，不涉及凭据、用户数据或远程执行。Apache-2.0 许可。
description.en: Plays one full-screen looping video behind DSH Web, muted by default. A bottom-right control provides restore-original, play/stop, mute, volume, and a background-occlusion slider that synchronizes `--dsh-video-bg-scale` with `--dsw-skin-scrim`; it also works with the skin center’s blur and occlusion controls. Playback pauses while the tab is hidden, and `prefers-reduced-motion` users get a static veil. The shipped asset is 1440p/30fps and can be replaced at `assets/background.mp4`, but each installation supports only one video and continuous decoding uses GPU resources. The Host serves the fixed packaged file through the GET/HEAD-only, same-origin-fenced `/api/video-bg/video.mp4` route with no path input, credentials, user data, or remote execution. Apache-2.0 licensed.

description.zh: codex-ui 将 DSH Web 的窗口边缘、侧栏分界、右栏、输入区、浅深色调色板和设置模态框按 Codex 风格重做；默认可接管模型选择器，提供按提供方分组的模型列表与可拖动、可用 ←/→/Home/End 操作的推理功率轨，关闭 `modelPicker` 后立即交回宿主原生菜单。它还提供 Trajectory 视图的“← 对话”出口，以及主题、强调色、字体、半透明侧栏和对比度配置。设置模态层只使用宿主锚点，不移动或复制宿主节点；主题覆盖默认空值时不产生覆盖，卸载后恢复下层主题。它是社区插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。目标宿主为 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`、Node ≥22；README 说明最新增量并未全部在真实 `dsh web` 实例上验证，宿主结构不匹配时部分层会告警并跳过。MIT 许可。
description.en: codex-ui restyles DSH Web’s window edges, sidebar dividers, right panel, composer, light/dark palettes, and settings modal to resemble Codex. Its model-picker face B is enabled by default and supplies provider-grouped models plus a draggable reasoning power rail with ←/→/Home/End controls; turning off `modelPicker` hands the seat back to the host’s native menu. It also adds a “← Chat” exit for Trajectory, along with settings for theme, accent, fonts, translucent sidebar, and contrast. The settings layer uses host anchors without moving or cloning host nodes; empty overrides leave the underlying theme untouched, and uninstall removes the layer. This is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product. It targets DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` and Node ≥22; the README notes that the newest additions were not all tested in a live `dsh web` instance, and layers warn and skip when host structure does not match. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 以鲸鱼娘为核心的全界面皮肤包，内置女仆工坊、夜庭银饰、深海、雪夜庭和桂月夜庭五套场景；每套包含壁纸、金银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、角落立绘和环境粒子，可选择覆盖全界面或仅工作区。它支持跟随主题或按时段切换明暗、遮罩/暗角/景深控制、`prefers-reduced-motion` 粒子，以及随审批等待、生成中、出错和完成状态变化的角落立绘；也支持用目录加 `skin.json` 安装第三方皮肤包和导入/导出自包含 JSON 设置。资源由插件自己的只读路由提供，不发外部请求、不做遥测。目标运行时为 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`；皮肤依赖 CSS-module 类名后缀和 `--dsw-*` 令牌，宿主改名后效果可能静默失效并回到出厂外观。代码 MIT；壁纸与立绘衍生自 `dsh-whale-musume`，README 要求按其许可仅作本地使用并查看第三方声明。
description.en: A full-interface whale skin pack with five built-in scenes—Maid Atelier, Silver Night Garden, Abyss, Snow Night Garden, and Moonlit Osmanthus Night Garden. Each combines wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner illustration, and ambient particles; the pack can cover the whole interface or only the workspace. It supports theme-following or time-based light/dark selection, occlusion/vignette/depth-of-field controls, `prefers-reduced-motion` particles, and a corner illustration that changes for approval waiting, generation, errors, and completion. Third-party packs use a directory plus `skin.json`, and settings can be exported or imported as self-contained JSON. Assets are served by the plugin’s read-only routes with no external requests or telemetry. The target runtime is DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`; it depends on CSS-module class-name suffixes and `--dsw-*` tokens, so host renames can silently disable the effects and restore the stock appearance. The code is MIT-licensed, while wallpaper and illustrations are derived from `dsh-whale-musume` and must follow its local-use terms and the repository’s third-party notices.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的工作区、会话列表、输入区和浮层统一为 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 启发的工业终端：沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何、硬边框、无阴影表面、项目标题、机械导轨、反色视频选中态、32px 网格和纸张纹理，并统一编辑器、菜单、对话框、代码块与语法高亮。保留 DSH 原有交互和浅深色模式，主题令牌覆盖可在主题重绘后继续生效；支持减少动态效果，不依赖运行时 CDN 或图片。它是非官方社区主题，与 Square Enix、PlatinumGames 或 NieR 权利方无隶属关系，也不包含游戏原始素材。MIT 许可。
description.en: Recasts the DSH Web workspace, session list, composer, and overlays as a NieR:Automata/YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal: sand and charcoal palettes, square geometry, hard borders, shadow-free surfaces, project headers, mechanical rails, reverse-video active sessions, a 32px registration grid, and paper texture. Composer, menus, dialogs, code blocks, and syntax highlighting share the same treatment while the original interactions and light/dark modes remain intact. Theme-token overrides survive DSH theme repaints, reduced motion is supported, and the current build has no runtime CDN or image dependencies. This is an unofficial community theme, unaffiliated with Square Enix, PlatinumGames, or NieR rights holders, and it contains no original game assets. MIT licensed.

description.zh: deepseek-pet 把用户输入、LLM 回复和工具结果转化为喂食事件：食物从会话中事件发生的位置飞向右下角鲸鱼娘，数量随 token 消耗变化。它包含 5 秒 Combo（经验倍率最高 `×3.0`）、15 秒暴食增益、心情/精力/睡眠、工具技能、Lv.10 一次性进化、多宠物与蛋、成就和每日任务；宠物可摸头、拖动，支持减少动效。状态保存在浏览器 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-pet-plugin/state`，多标签页共享，同一只宠物会按离线时间结算最多 24 小时但不会饿死。插件无需改动 DSH 仓库或重新构建前端，代码按 MIT 许可；安装文档同时说明使用的是 AI 插画/二创素材，相关素材的商业权利不能从代码许可自动推得。
description.en: deepseek-pet turns user messages, LLM replies, and completed tool calls into feeding events: food flies from the event’s location in the conversation to the whale pet in the bottom-right, with the amount tied to token usage. It includes a five-second Combo window with up to a `×3.0` experience multiplier, a 15-second overeating buff, mood/energy/sleep, tool skills, one-time evolution after level 10, multiple pets and eggs, achievements, and daily tasks; the pet can be petted and dragged and supports reduced motion. State lives in browser `localStorage` under `dsh-pet-plugin/state`, is shared across tabs, and catches up for at most 24 hours while offline without starving the pet. It does not require changing the DSH repository or rebuilding the frontend. The code is MIT-licensed, but the README identifies the artwork as AI/fan-made material, so commercial rights for those assets do not follow automatically from the code license.

description.zh: 宋律 · Songgrid 把宋代美学与瑞士国际主义设计结合为 DSH Web 主题：4pt 间距阶、2/4px 圆角、中文 `Noto Serif SC` 宋体与拉丁无衬线分工，并提供 `song-grid-xuanzhi`（宣纸浅色）、`song-grid-yemo`（夜墨深色）和 `system` 跟随系统三种选择。汝窑天青 `#3A7284`（对宣纸对比度 4.91:1，WCAG AA）承担按钮、焦点、选中态和链接；窑铜 `#9A6B50` 只用于引用和标记等编辑性强调。主题通过 design token 覆盖，不改宿主源码；需要 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2`，DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` 应改装 `dsh-theme-songgrid@0.1.0`。设置写回宿主的跨浏览器持久化依赖 loopback 地址（`localhost`/`127.x`/`::1`），其他入口只能依赖浏览器本地镜像；与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。MIT 许可。
description.en: Songgrid combines Song-dynasty aesthetics with Swiss International Style for DSH Web: a 4pt spacing scale, 2/4px radii, `Noto Serif SC` for Chinese headings, and a separate sans-serif face for Latin text. It offers `song-grid-xuanzhi` (rice-paper light), `song-grid-yemo` (night-ink dark), and `system` follow-host variants. Ru celadon `#3A7284` carries buttons, focus, selection, and links with 4.91:1 contrast on paper (WCAG AA); kiln copper `#9A6B50` is reserved for editorial accents such as blockquotes and markers. The theme overrides design tokens without patching host source. It requires DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2`; DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` users should install `dsh-theme-songgrid@0.1.0`. Cross-browser persistence through the host requires a loopback URL (`localhost`, `127.x`, or `::1`); other entry points rely on the browser-local mirror. It is not affiliated with DeepSeek. MIT licensed.

description.zh: ui-song-theme 通过可撤销的 `ThemeRuntime.overrideTokens()` 层提供宋式浅色与深色主题，同时保留用户的 `light`、`dark` 或 `system` 偏好。浅色使用绢纸表面、暖墨文字、植物灰绿色交互色和朱砂错误态；深色使用松墨绿黑表面与低饱和淡玉强调色，标题优先使用系统已安装的宋体/CJK 衬线，正文仍用 Harness 无衬线字体栈，并统一宿主残留的蓝色选中态和浏览器焦点轮廓。卸载时只移除自己的 token 层并恢复下方主题。兼容 DeepSeek Harness UI theme `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`；系统字体可用性会影响字形度量，仓库不捆绑字体文件。MIT 许可。
description.en: ui-song-theme contributes a reversible `ThemeRuntime.overrideTokens()` layer for Song-inspired light and dark palettes while preserving the user’s `light`, `dark`, or `system` preference. Light mode uses silk-paper surfaces, warm-ink text, botanical gray-green interactions, and cinnabar errors; dark mode uses pine-ink green-black surfaces with a restrained pale-jade accent. Headings prefer installed Song and CJK serif fonts, body text keeps the Harness sans-serif stack, and legacy blue selections plus the browser focus outline are brought into the same botanical family. Unloading removes only this token layer and restores the theme below it. It supports DeepSeek Harness UI theme `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`; system-font availability affects exact glyph metrics, and no font files are bundled. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 报纸衬线 · Newsprint Serif 用纯 CSS 把 Typora `newsprint` 的报纸排版带进 DSH Web：亮色暖白纸张、暖调暗色 `#1a1815`、衬线正文（Georgia → PT Serif → Noto Serif SC → SimSun），并重做标题细线、引用块、表头大写、斑马行、链接悬停下划线和代码块分隔线。它不使用 hooks、图片资产或任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` client peer，只向 DOM 注入 `dsh-newsprint-active` 作用域的 `style#dsh-theme-newsprint-styles`，依据 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 自行分流亮暗档；代价是不能由主题运行时的亮暗选择器驱动。字体按系统字族引用，不内嵌字体文件；多个主题同时启用会叠加，建议只保留一个。MIT 许可。
description.en: Newsprint Serif brings the newspaper typography of Typora’s `newsprint` theme to DSH Web with pure CSS: warm-white paper in light mode, a warm brown-black `#1a1815` dark scheme, and a serif stack of Georgia → PT Serif → Noto Serif SC → SimSun. It adds newspaper-style heading rules, blockquotes, uppercase table headers, zebra rows, hover underlines, and code-block separators. It uses no hooks, image assets, or `@deepseek-ai/*` client peer; it injects a scoped `style#dsh-theme-newsprint-styles` under `dsh-newsprint-active` and branches on `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` instead of the theme runtime. The trade-off is that the runtime theme picker cannot drive its schemes. Fonts are referenced by system family, not bundled; enabling multiple themes makes them stack, so keep one enabled. MIT licensed.

name.zh: AIR-pixel Liquid Glass 液态玻璃

description.zh: AIR-pixel Liquid Glass 提供可配置的半透明界面：磨砂表面、壁纸、强度/模糊/色调、Windows 桌面透明与窗口模糊、自定义光标、点击涟漪，以及人类消息和助手消息的独立对比度设置，并提供中英文设置界面。桌面透明和窗口模糊需要显式运行 `tools/asarpatch.py` 的 Host 端补丁；补丁会修改已安装客户端的 `lib/main.js`（封装在 `app.asar` 时也会修改其中文件），会保留备份且客户端更新后会丢失，需要重新应用。插件不发起外部网络请求。它刻意不声明 `engines.dsh` 或 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer，而用 `node tools/compat.mjs` 检查已安装核心、`settings.section`/`slots.register` 契约和补丁状态；`0.1.x` 核心不支持，应使用插件 `0.1.0`。MIT 许可。
description.en: AIR-pixel Liquid Glass provides configurable translucent surfaces, wallpaper, strength/blur/tint controls, Windows desktop transparency and window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and separate contrast controls for human and assistant messages, with English and Chinese settings UI. Desktop transparency and window blur require the explicit host-side `tools/asarpatch.py` patch; it modifies the installed client’s `lib/main.js` (including inside `app.asar` when sealed), keeps a backup, and is lost after each client update. The plugin makes no external network requests. It deliberately declares no `engines.dsh` or `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range; `node tools/compat.mjs` checks the installed core, the `settings.section`/`slots.register` contract, and patch status at runtime. `0.1.x` cores are unsupported; use plugin `0.1.0` there. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 许愿屋用原创 SVG 小屋替换侧栏与首屏品牌，并以灯火琥珀令牌、暖纸/靛夜双主题和动态许愿星空覆盖界面：今日真实月相、月相呼吸与轨迹、流星和星群视差、鼠标拖尾、回车许愿、标题 `heroHeadline` 场景化、启动揭幕、点月亮彩蛋、输入萤火、AI 生成时窗灯联动、Web Audio 合成风铃/微风声、时辰氛围、每日签语和 `localStorage` 快捷手札。大多数层都可在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中独立开关（如 `brand`、`theme`、`background`、`bgMoon`、`moonWish`、`heroStyle`），尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`；卸载或关闭时会清理副作用并还原官方外观。`ecoMode` 依赖 `navigator.getBattery`，而其他皮肤的 token 覆盖可能叠加冲突，建议一次只启用一个皮肤。代码 MIT 许可。
description.en: Xuyuanwu Wish House replaces the sidebar and hero branding with original SVG house artwork, then layers an amber-lantern token theme over warm-paper and indigo-night variants. Its living sky includes the current lunar phase, moon breathing and orbit, meteors, parallax star fields, mouse wish trails, Enter-triggered wishes, the `heroHeadline` treatment, a boot reveal, a clickable-moon easter egg, typing sparks, AI-streaming lamp feedback, Web Audio wind-chime/breeze synthesis, time-of-day ambience, daily fortune toasts, and a `localStorage` quick panel. Most layers can be toggled independently in `cordis.patch.yml`—including `brand`, `theme`, `background`, `bgMoon`, `moonWish`, and `heroStyle`—and the effects respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; unload or disable cleanup restores the stock appearance. `ecoMode` depends on `navigator.getBattery`, and token layers from other skins can overlap, so the README recommends enabling one skin at a time. MIT licensed.

description.zh: Kun Like 桌宠以静态 Host + Client bundle 运行在 DSH Web 或桌面客户端右下角，提供 9 种精灵动画、拖动和点击互动，并监听 `agent/status`、`tools/execute`、`approval/request`、`agent/request-error` 以及 `agents.list()` 轮询来显示工作、思考、等待、失败、完成和空闲状态。任务完成时 Host 按平台播放提示音：Windows 用 `System.Media.SoundPlayer`，macOS 用 `afplay`，Linux 需要 `ffplay`；可用 `kun_pet_debug` 和 `/kun-pet/state` 检查状态。当前 `2.2.0` 面向 DSH 0.2.x（`engines.dsh: ^0.2.0-rc.2`），需要 Node ≥22.19，Web 与 desktop 是独立 profile，安装后必须重启；Linux 还需可用音频播放程序。代码按 MIT 许可，但 `spritesheet.webp` 是粉丝二创像素素材，语音是网络二创梗片段，仅供个人学习交流，不能从 MIT 代码许可推得商业授权。README 还警告裸包名 `dsh-kun-like-pet` 已被另一发布者占用，建议使用该仓库的 `github:` 安装入口。
description.en: Kun Like Desktop Pet runs as a static Host + Client bundle in the bottom-right of DSH Web or the desktop client. It ships nine sprite animations, dragging and click interactions, and listens to `agent/status`, `tools/execute`, `approval/request`, `agent/request-error`, plus an `agents.list()` polling fallback to show working, thinking, waiting, failed, completed, and idle states. The Host plays a completion sound per platform—`System.Media.SoundPlayer` on Windows, `afplay` on macOS, and `ffplay` on Linux—and exposes `kun_pet_debug` and `/kun-pet/state` for inspection. Version `2.2.0` targets DSH 0.2.x (`engines.dsh: ^0.2.0-rc.2`), requires Node ≥22.19, treats Web and desktop as separate profiles, and needs a restart after installation; Linux also needs a usable audio player. The code is MIT-licensed, but `spritesheet.webp` is fan-made pixel artwork and the voice is an internet meme remix for personal learning and exchange only, so commercial rights do not follow from the code license. The README warns that the bare `dsh-kun-like-pet` package name is occupied by another publisher and recommends the repository’s `github:` install spec.

description.zh: 让每次短按在星光涟漪、蕾丝花绽、流星轻雨、星环回旋和星蝶轻舞五种 Canvas 动效间轮换；五次有效点击会完整走完一轮且相邻轮次不连播同一种。效果每次读取当前皮肤的配色，约 0.72–0.9 秒消散，支持 Reduce Motion；不联网、不采集遥测，也不拦截输入。
description.en: Cycles short clicks through five Canvas effects—star ripples, lace blossoms, comet showers, star orbits, and butterfly flutter. Each set of five accepted clicks uses every effect once without repeating across the boundary; colors are sampled from the active skin, effects last about 0.72–0.9 s, respect Reduce Motion, and make no network calls, collect telemetry, or intercept input.

description.zh: 宝蓝色像素鲸停在输入框上沿，跟随会话的思考、输出、审批、完成和错误状态变换表情；输入草稿非空时会停止巡游并注视你。空闲时每 30 秒进行一次去程与返程各 6 秒的下潜巡游，可改名字、大小和位置；纯 Canvas，无网络请求或宿主服务，要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0 < 0.3.0`。
description.en: A royal-blue pixel whale perches above the composer and changes expression with thinking, streaming, approvals, completed turns, and errors; a non-empty draft cancels its cruise and switches to an expectant pose. When idle, it makes a 30-second cruise with a 6-second outbound leg and a 6-second return, and its name, size, and position are configurable. It uses Canvas only, makes no network requests or host-side service calls, and requires DSH `>= 0.2.0 < 0.3.0`.

description.zh: 以 Nothing Phone 设计语言重做 DSH Web：16px 点阵背景、Space Grotesk/Space Mono 字体、黑白层级、零圆角/无阴影和 `#D71921` 信号红；同时提供 OLED 黑与米白纸面两套外观。可在 Settings → Nothing Skin 中逐项开关点阵、字体、壁纸、透明度、模糊和状态时钟等功能，配置保存在 `localStorage` 与 `$DSH_HOME/nothing-skin.json`。
description.en: Recasts the DSH Web UI in the Nothing Phone design language with a 16px dot-matrix background, Space Grotesk/Space Mono typography, monochrome hierarchy, zero-radius flat surfaces, and `#D71921` signal red, with OLED-black and off-white paper modes. Settings → Nothing Skin provides individual toggles for the grid, fonts, wallpaper, translucency, blur, status clock, and other features; configuration is saved in `localStorage` and `$DSH_HOME/nothing-skin.json`.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 换成保护伞公司风格：暗色为黑红页面配终端绿正文，浅色为灰白页面；完整覆盖 113 个 `--dsw-*` 别名 token 与 9 个 `--shiki-token-*`，并把白红伞标记放入侧栏、会话页、账号行和 HUD。720px 水印绕自身竖直中线自转，`prefers-reduced-motion` 下停止；标志由几何图形绘制，不含 Capcom 素材，是非官方粉丝作品。
description.en: Gives the DSH Web UI an Umbrella Corporation treatment: a black-and-red dark scheme with terminal-green prose, a grey-and-white light scheme, 113 `--dsw-*` alias tokens, and 9 `--shiki-token-*` syntax tokens. A white-and-red umbrella mark appears in the sidebar, conversation page, account row, and HUD; its 720 px watermark spins around its own vertical axis and stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. The mark is geometry-drawn with no Capcom assets; this is unofficial fan work.

description.zh: 提供只影响用户消息气泡的可切换皮肤库：内置「幸运草坡」「锦鲤跃潮」「DS鲸鱼娘·白瓷蓝」、QQ 蓝、装饰、毛玻璃、像素和极简等样式，亮/暗变体可热切换并自动保存。默认仍是 DSH 气泡；当前版本隐藏尾巴、背景和装饰设置，也不开放用户上传，只命中用户消息、pending steering 与 submission echo，不改助手、目标或问答气泡。
description.en: A switchable skin library for user-message bubbles, including Clover Meadow, Koi Rising, DS Whale Girl in Porcelain Blue, QQ Blue, QQ Deco, Glass, Pixel, and Minimal. Light and dark variants switch instantly and the stock DSH bubble remains available as the default. The current release hides tail, background, and decoration controls, does not accept user uploads, and targets user rows, pending steering, and submission echoes—not assistant, goal, or question bubbles.

name.zh: 渡劫飞升 · 王林修炼伙伴

description.zh: 把《仙逆》王林做成悬浮修炼伙伴，读取 `ctx.on('session/event')` 把等待、思考、工具调用、流式回复、完成和失败映射为动作，并随完成回合积累修为，在凝气至问鼎七重境界间升境换皮肤。点击可论道、喂丹药或拖动，隐藏时缩入天逆珠；`ascension_status` 可返回境界、修为与当前动画。
description.en: Turns Wang Lin from *Renegade Immortal* into a floating cultivation companion. It reads `ctx.on('session/event')` and maps waiting, thinking, tool calls, streaming replies, completion, and failure to animations; completed turns, pet clicks, and pill feeding build cultivation across seven realms from Qi Refining to Ascension, with a new skin at each breakthrough. Click, feed, or drag the pet, hide it inside the Tianni Pearl, or query `ascension_status` for the realm, cultivation, and current animation.

description.zh: 把 CSDN 博文排版带进 DSH：品牌色 `#fc5531`、16/24 正文、标题层级、引用块、实线网格表格、粉底红字行内代码，以及 Atom One Light/Dark 代码高亮；浅色/深色值各一套。它只注入 token 覆盖与一层可撤销 `<style>`，不改 DOM、不联网、不读写文件；`compact` 小字号区域不覆盖，深色方案则是按语义调出的非官方 CSDN 深色值。
description.en: Brings CSDN article typography to DSH with the `#fc5531` brand color, 16/24 body text, heading hierarchy, quote blocks, solid-grid tables, pink-backed red inline code, and Atom One Light/Dark code highlighting in paired light and dark values. It only adds a token override and a disposable `<style>` layer—no DOM changes, network calls, or file access—and leaves `compact` small-text regions untouched. The dark palette is an original semantic interpretation, not an official CSDN dark theme.

description.zh: 用暖白纸底、墨黑强调色和 3.5% 牛皮纸颗粒，把 DSH Web UI 变成纸墨素描；叠加马克笔轻描边、铅笔细线和楷体标题，但保留宿主布局、圆角、字号与状态色。只覆盖公开 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计令牌，浅/深色均适配，停用后可完整还原，不使用实心边框。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into an ink-on-paper sketch with a warm off-white paper base, ink-black accents, and 3.5% kraft-paper grain. Marker-like edge strokes, pencil hairlines, and KaiTi headings add texture while the host keeps its layout, radii, type scale, and semantic status colors. It only overrides public `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, supports light and dark modes, restores cleanly when disabled, and uses no solid borders.

description.zh: 把真实会话事件变成一眼可见的状态宠物：空闲慢飘，思考加速，工具执行显示紫色连线，错误显示红环并抖动，运行超过 10 秒的回合完成时跳跃庆祝。它会在五个候选角落避开输入框和焦点元素，`prefers-reduced-motion` 时退化为保留颜色/文字的静态角标；不会阻断工具 waterfall，也没有物理引擎或设置页。
description.en: Turns live session events into a status pet you can read at a glance: it drifts when idle, speeds up while thinking, draws purple tethers for active tools, shakes with a red ring on errors, and celebrates turns that ran for more than 10 seconds. It chooses among five corners to avoid text inputs and the focused element, degrades to a static badge with its status color and label under `prefers-reduced-motion`, never blocks the tool waterfall, and deliberately has no physics engine or settings page.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成拜仁慕尼黑主题：主场红/客场白两套画布，5 种背景（19 名一线队球员的内嵌赛场照、球衣、阵容号码墙、安联球场、纯色）和拜仁红、深红、拜仁蓝、冠军金四种强调色。设置即时保存并支持自定义图片 URL；照片缺失会回退到球衣插画。照片来自公开图片索引与报道，项目声明仅供个人非商业使用，非官方授权。
description.en: Recasts the DSH Web GUI in an FC Bayern München theme with home-red and away-white canvases, five backdrops—embedded match photos for 19 first-team players, drawn jerseys, a squad-number wall, Allianz Arena, and plain—and four accents: Bayern red, dark red, Bayern blue, and champion gold. Settings save immediately and accept a custom image URL; missing player photos fall back to jersey art. The project says its public-source photos are for personal, non-commercial theming only and are not official club material.

description.zh: 提供 22 套仅浅色配色（4 套 Pantone、14 套中国传统色、4 套莫兰迪色），可与 14 种单选表面效果组合成 308 种搭配；还支持十二时辰/定时轮换、工作区绑定、会话颜色标记，以及可选的账号昵称与内联头像编辑。没有深色模式；安全模式可停绘并恢复出厂。
description.en: Provides 22 light-only palettes—4 Pantone, 14 Chinese traditional, and 4 Morandi—plus 14 single-select surface effects for 308 combinations. It also supports shichen or timed rotation, workspace bindings, per-session color marks, and optional nickname and inline-avatar editing in the account row. There is no dark mode; Safe Mode can stop drawing and restore the factory appearance.

description.zh: 提供覆盖 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的完整越南语界面（58 个命名空间、2,615 个字符串）、三套越南主题（Sơn mài、Hạ Long sương、Lụa Hội An，各有浅/深/跟随系统）和来自 Wikimedia Commons 的越南风景轮换背景。照片支持透明度、模糊、Ken Burns 与离线缓存，并显示作者/许可证；开启背景会直接请求 `commons.wikimedia.org` 和 `upload.wikimedia.org`，不发送 DSH 数据。要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`。
description.en: Adds a complete Vietnamese UI for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2—2,615 strings across 58 namespaces—three Vietnamese themes (Sơn mài, Hạ Long mist, and Hoi An silk, each with light, dark, and system modes), and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop sourced from Wikimedia Commons. Backgrounds support opacity, blur, Ken Burns motion, offline caching, and per-photo attribution; enabling them makes direct requests to `commons.wikimedia.org` and `upload.wikimedia.org` but sends no DSH data. Requires DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`.

description.zh: 右下角的 Fritia 小人会在 Agent 工作时左右走动，待机时在两种姿态间切换，并可通过点击、连击、右键、长按和拖动触发高兴、困惑、生气、抓取与余额面板等状态；右键可读取 DeepSeek 账户余额并显示在举起的板子上。素材随包提供 20 张透明立绘，拖动后位置保留；这是基于同源 Host 路由的 Web 插件，安装或更新 Host 代码需要重启 DSH。
description.en: Fritia walks back and forth while an agent is working, alternates between two idle poses, and reacts to clicks, rapid clicks, right-clicks, long-presses, and dragging with happy, confused, angry, grab, and balance-panel states. Right-click can read the DeepSeek account balance and display it on the raised sign. The package includes 20 transparent portraits and preserves a dragged position; it uses same-origin host routes, so installing or updating host code requires a DSH restart.

description.zh: 手机优先的外观编辑器：在「设置 → 气泡与背景」中分别调用户/AI 气泡底色、渐变、描边、毛玻璃与文字/代码色，也可设置输入框、顶栏、侧栏和对话背景（图片支持定位、缩放、铺满/拉伸/适应/平铺）。纯前端、不改对话、不联网，配置和预设保存在 `localStorage`；≤700px 窄屏有专门适配，大图可能触发存储配额。
description.en: A phone-first appearance editor for separately tuning user and AI bubble colors, gradients, borders, frosted glass, and prose/code text from Settings → Bubbles & Backgrounds. It also styles the composer, top bar, sidebar, and conversation background, with image positioning, scaling, fill/stretch/fit/tile modes, and blur. The frontend-only plugin does not alter conversations or make network calls; settings and presets live in `localStorage`, narrow layouts ≤700 px receive dedicated tuning, and large images can hit browser storage limits.

description.zh: 在 DSH 全窗口后铺设本地照片，让侧栏、会话区和输入框表面透出玻璃质感；设置页可选择图片并调遮罩、模糊、饱和度和透明度，浅/深色随宿主切换而不影响文字、代码高亮和对话框。图片存于 `$DSH_HOME/wallpaper`（默认 `~/.dsh/wallpaper`），上传上限 40 MB；关闭壁纸会移除图层与样式。
description.en: Places a local photo behind the entire DSH GUI and makes the sidebar, conversation, and composer surfaces translucent so the image shows through. The settings page controls the scrim, blur, saturation, and translucency; light and dark follow the host without changing text, syntax highlighting, or dialogs. Images live in `$DSH_HOME/wallpaper` (default `~/.dsh/wallpaper`), uploads are capped at 40 MB, and disabling the wallpaper removes its layer and style.

description.zh: 给侧栏「外观」开关加入先滑动、后切换主题的三秒紫金时停波纹、反色转场和音效；动效层实时叠加且不拦截输入，音频预加载失败可在下次点击重试。系统启用 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时直接切换，不播放转场；需要 `sidebar.footer.action` 与主题服务，声明兼容 DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` 以上。
description.en: Adds a switch-first, theme-second transition to the sidebar Appearance control: a three-second purple-and-gold time-stop wave, color inversion, and sound play before the light/dark change. The live overlay does not block input, and failed audio preloading can retry on the next click. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, it switches immediately without the transition; it requires the `sidebar.footer.action` slot and theme service and declares compatibility with DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` and later.

description.zh: 让角落桌宠按 Agent 的具体活动切换姿态：思考、`web_fetch`、`web_search`/`skill`、`read`/`grep`、`bash`/`pwsh`、编辑、计划、子代理、审批和错误都有独立状态，还会显示命令/子代理徽标与 30 秒空闲睡眠。把图片与 `manifest.json` 放进 `assets/` 即可热更新，无需改代码；支持拖动、100–320px 缩放和点击状态气泡。素材服务只限配置目录且宠物为进程级共享，安装后需重启 `dsh web`。
description.en: Switches a corner pet to activity-specific poses for thinking, `web_fetch`, `web_search`/`skill`, `read`/`grep`, `bash`/`pwsh`, editing, planning, subagents, approvals, and errors, with command and subagent badges plus sleep after 30 seconds of idle time. Put images and `manifest.json` in `assets/` for hot reloads without code changes; the pet is draggable, resizable from 100–320 px, and opens a status bubble on click. Assets are served only from the configured directory, the pet is process-wide across sessions, and installation requires restarting `dsh web`.

description.zh: 在独立透明桌面窗口中显示会随 DSH agent 事件切换的宠物，内置 Lokki 科技狐狸与 Professor Leo 狮子科学家；支持 idle/working/waiting/review/error 姿态、悬停控制，以及可导入的动画图集或透明头像。宠物库从文件夹自动发现，可无需重装插件；首次启动会下载固定 Electron runtime，需要图形桌面（WSL2 需 WSLg），宠物文件、偏好和会话 ID 保存在本机。
description.en: Shows an activity-aware pet in a separate transparent desktop window, with Lokki the tech fox and Professor Leo the scientist lion included. It supports idle, working, waiting/review, and error poses, hover controls, and additional pets supplied as animation atlases or transparent portraits; new folders are discovered without reinstalling. The first launch downloads a pinned Electron runtime and requires a graphical desktop (WSLg for WSL2); pet files, preferences, and session IDs stay local.

description.zh: 在 Settings → General → Color Scheme 提供 7 套配色：Catppuccin Latte/Frappe/Macchiato/Mocha、Everforest Dark/Light 和 Nord；选择跨刷新与重启保存在 `localStorage`，tooltip 与 hover card 也跟随当前主题。新增配色需在 `./schemes` 添加数据文件、在 `schemes/index.ts` 注册并重新构建；当前未发布到 npm，需从 GitHub 或 tarball 安装。
description.en: Adds seven schemes to Settings → General → Color Scheme: Catppuccin Latte, Frappe, Macchiato, and Mocha; Everforest Dark and Light; and Nord. The choice persists across refreshes and restarts in `localStorage`, and tooltips and hover cards follow the active scheme. Add a scheme by creating a data file in `./schemes`, registering it in `schemes/index.ts`, and rebuilding; the package is not yet published to npm and must be installed from GitHub or a tarball.

description.zh: 为 DSH 工作台加入一次性工业风入场：等待外壳就绪后逐笔写出 `DEEPSEEK HARNESS`，再用反色整屏色块扫场退场；同时提供深/浅两套官方 token 皮肤。默认每个浏览器会话只播放一次，可分别关闭过渡层或主题，减少动效会缩短时长；皮肤不驱动 Fullscreen API，并在就绪异常时使用超时退场。
description.en: Adds a one-shot industrial entrance to the DSH workspace: after the shell is ready, it writes `DEEPSEEK HARNESS` stroke by stroke, then exits with an inverted full-screen color block. It also supplies light and dark official-token skins. By default it plays once per browser session; the overlay and theme can be disabled separately, reduced motion shortens the timing, the skin never drives the Fullscreen API, and a timeout lets it exit if readiness fails.

description.zh: 右下角的「核动力草泥马」会读取当前会话状态：空闲时慢走、50 秒后打盹，工作时快步巡逻并播报工具，等待审批时急跳提示，回合结束三连跳庆祝；点按、拖动还能触发语录、粒子和重力回弹。支持 DSH `v0.1.5+`，使用 CSS 与 `requestAnimationFrame`，卸载时清理节点和样式。
description.en: The bottom-right Nuclear Alpaca reads the current session: it strolls while idle, naps after 50 seconds, patrols briskly and announces tools while working, jumps anxiously for approval, and triple-jumps when a turn ends. Poke or drag it for quotes, particles, and gravity-like bounce-back. It supports DSH `v0.1.5+`, uses CSS and `requestAnimationFrame`, and removes its nodes and styles on unload.

description.zh: 把唐僧、孙悟空、猪八戒、沙僧和白龙马做成无边框、透明、置顶的悬浮窗；点击循环换人，拖动移动，悬停可收起，静止 6 秒自动播放师徒赶路追逐动画。角色由内联 SVG 绘制，无外部图片依赖，可安装到 DSH Web 或 Desktop profile。
description.en: Presents Tang Monk, Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, Sha Seng, and the White Dragon Horse in a frameless, transparent, always-on-top widget. Click to cycle characters, drag to move, hover to collapse, and leave it still for six seconds to start the group-chasing animation. The characters are inline SVG with no external image dependencies, and the plugin can run in DSH Web or Desktop profiles.

description.zh: 右下角可拖拽的 Foxbell 多宠物系统：按项目显示待审批、运行、完成未读和错误断联状态卡，提供语音提醒、拖拽物理、五场景动作绑定和一键显隐；内置 Foxbell，并可从本地文件夹、ZIP、`~/.codex/pets/` 或 Petdex 导入宠物后即时热切换。外部导入有 100MB/200 文件安全限制和 8 秒在线请求超时；用量看板按 token 统计，不换算金额。
description.en: A draggable Foxbell multi-pet system with per-project cards for approval, running, done-unread, and error/disconnected states, plus voice alerts, drag physics, five action bindings, and a show/hide control. Foxbell is built in; additional pets can be imported from a local folder, ZIP, `~/.codex/pets/`, or Petdex and hot-swapped immediately. External imports enforce a 100 MB/200-file safety limit and an 8-second online-request timeout; the usage dashboard counts tokens and never converts them to money.

description.zh: 侧栏列表下方的几何风「小蓝」会跟随真实会话进入待机、思考、工具、等待确认、完成或异常状态，并提供三段连贯点击动画、任务提醒、拖动/键盘定位和独立外观设置。支持 100–220px 大小、25–100% 透明度、安静模式与 `prefers-reduced-motion`；不发声音或 Windows 通知，也不会自动确认授权、回答问题、发送消息或调用模型。
description.en: Little Blue, a geometric sidebar companion, follows real sessions through idle, thinking, tool, approval, completed, and error states. It adds three complete click animations, task reminders, drag and keyboard positioning, and independent appearance settings with 100–220 px sizing, 25–100% opacity, quiet mode, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support. It makes no sound or Windows notifications and never approves requests, answers questions, sends messages, or calls a model automatically.

description.zh: 把整个 DSH Web GUI 换成可跟随宿主明暗的终端/蓝图主题：覆盖会话、侧栏、代码、工具卡、弹窗、输入框与设置页，并在空白首页提供字符雨、旋转 DSH-chan、等高线场、Boot 自检和真实 SYS/WORKSPACE/MODEL HUD；进入会话后保留遥测条，显示上下文压力、输入/输出/缓存命中与解码速度。模型账本来自 DSH 的 `storages/session_projcache`，时间窗按会话最近活动近似统计；CPU/温度/网络等系统指标按平台提供，缺失行会隐藏，全部数据只读本机。
description.en: Reskins the entire DSH Web GUI in a host-following terminal/blueprint style, covering sessions, sidebar, code, tool cards, dialogs, composer, and settings. The blank home screen adds sparse character rain, a rotating DSH-chan, contour fields, a boot self-test, and live SYS/WORKSPACE/MODEL HUD panels; sessions retain a telemetry strip for context pressure, input/output/cache hits, and decode speed. The model ledger reads DSH's `storages/session_projcache` and buckets time windows approximately by last session activity; platform-dependent CPU, temperature, and network rows are hidden when unavailable, and all data stays read-only on the machine.

description.zh: 常驻右下角的兔耳少女「小舞」是原创手绘 SVG 角色，会从当前会话真实状态推导待机、思考、工具、等待确认、完成、出错和睡眠七种心情；成功完成时跳起撒花并用 WebAudio 实时合成「做完啦……」，无录音或采样文件。点击可互动、面板可查看工具/会话，首次交互才解锁音频，`prefers-reduced-motion` 会压缩动画。
description.en: Xiaowu is an original hand-drawn SVG rabbit-eared companion in the bottom-right corner. She derives seven moods from the current session: idle, thinking, working, waiting, done, error, and sleep. On a successful completion she jumps with confetti and synthesizes “Done…” in real time with Web Audio—there are no recordings or sampled voice files. Click to interact, inspect the current tool and session in the panel, unlock audio on first interaction, and let `prefers-reduced-motion` shorten the animations.

description.zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》流萤「春日手信」同人皮肤：春草绿/萤火双主题、87 个 DSH token、春日橱窗（拱窗、光束、花瓣、萤火）、半透明玻璃面板和可隐藏的左右立绘，并在设置中分别开关皮肤与立绘。仅支持 Web，立绘为 HoYoverse/miHoYo 第三方素材，README 声明按同人指引仅限非商业使用并需署名。
description.en: A fan skin for Firefly's “Spring Missive” outfit from *Honkai: Star Rail*, with spring-grass and firefly palettes across 87 DSH tokens, a spring-window scene with arches, light beams, petals, and fireflies, translucent glass panels, and optional mirrored character art. The skin and artwork have separate settings toggles. Web only; the character art is third-party HoYoverse/miHoYo material and the README limits it to non-commercial fan use with attribution.

description.zh: 把 Anthropic Codex 风格的 `#F8F6F1` 暖白、`#1E1D1B` 墨色和 `#CA7554` 铜色配色注入 DSH Web UI，并配套 DM Sans / JetBrains Mono 字体栈与浅/深两套 token。此条目对应仓库子路径 `plugins/anthropic-theme` 的 `dsh-anthropic-theme` 包；不要把同仓库的 macOS Tauri 桌面壳误写成主题功能。
description.en: Injects an Anthropic Codex-style palette into the DSH Web UI: warm white `#F8F6F1`, ink `#1E1D1B`, copper `#CA7554`, and DM Sans / JetBrains Mono font stacks with light and dark token sets. This entry is the `dsh-anthropic-theme` package at `plugins/anthropic-theme`; the repository's separate macOS Tauri desktop shell is not part of the theme.

description.zh: 在 Settings → General → Theme 中提供 Cream、Novel、Calm、Modern Classic 和 Deep Work 五套主题，每套都有浅/深调色板，选择保存为 Host 偏好并可即时切换。通过 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` 覆盖约 117 个派生 token，只改变配色；字体、圆角、语法高亮和壁纸仍由 DSH 控制。项目已在 macOS Apple Silicon 的 DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2/0.2.1-rc.2 上验证，Windows/Linux 未验证。
description.en: Adds Cream, Novel, Calm, Modern Classic, and Deep Work to Settings → General → Theme, with a light and dark palette for each. The choice is persisted as a Host preference and switches live. It uses `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` to derive about 117 tokens while changing colors only; fonts, radii, syntax highlighting, and wallpapers remain DSH-controlled. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2; Windows and Linux are unverified.

description.zh: 用两层全屏、点击穿透 Canvas 构成动态鲸鱼背景：WHALE 轮廓粒子会从散点聚合、空闲呼吸，并沿指针路径留下约 1 秒后合拢的通道；底层叠加 90px 点线网格，指针悬停会放大点阵。主题随 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 每帧读取，动画约 30fps，页面隐藏时暂停；全局 CSS 会覆盖整个页面背景且没有设置面板。
description.en: Builds an animated whale background from two full-viewport, click-through canvases. Particles sampled from the WHALE silhouette assemble from scattered points, breathe at idle, and leave a pointer-path channel that closes after about a second; a 90 px dot grid underneath swells around the pointer. It reads `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` every frame, runs at about 30 fps, and pauses when the page is hidden. Its global CSS overrides the whole page background and the package has no settings panel.

description.zh: 琥珀磷光 CRT 终端皮肤：把 DSH 令牌换成琥珀单色阶，加入磷光泛光、扫描线、曲面暗角、直角与带角标的框选面板，并用 Web Audio 合成点击、悬停、输入、Enter/Backspace 音效。音效默认开启，首次交互后才播放，可用 `Alt` + `Shift` + `M` 静音；无需字体或音频文件。README 以 DSH Web `0.1.5-rc.1`/Desktop `0.1.7-rc.2` 的 Windows 11 为验证范围，其他版本未测。
description.en: An amber-phosphor CRT skin that replaces DSH's token palette with a monochrome amber ramp, adds phosphor bloom, scanlines, a curved-screen vignette, square corners, and boxed panels with corner brackets, and synthesizes click, hover, typing, Enter, and Backspace cues with Web Audio. Sound is on by default but starts only after the first interaction; `Alt` + `Shift` + `M` mutes it. No fonts or audio files are bundled. The README's verification scope is Windows 11 with DSH Web `0.1.5-rc.1` and Desktop `0.1.7-rc.2`; other versions are untested.

description.zh: 绿色 Pip-Boy 磷光主题用 Vault-Tec 角框、方形面板、玻璃高光和稳定的无扫描线画面重塑界面；警告保持琥珀色、错误保持红色，并提供首次交互后启用的 Web Audio 终端提示音。固定证据验证于 Windows 11 的 DSH Web 0.1.5-rc.1 与桌面版 0.1.7-rc.2；这是未获 Bethesda 背书的非商业粉丝主题，且未发布到 npm。
description.en: A green Pip-Boy phosphor treatment with Vault-Tec corner frames, squared panels, a glass sheen, and a stable screen with no scanlines or flicker; warnings stay amber, errors stay red, and synthesized Web Audio cues begin after the first interaction. The README verifies DSH Web 0.1.5-rc.1 and desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 on Windows 11; it is an unofficial, non-commercial fan theme and is not published to npm.

description.zh: 以 Night City 为灵感的主题覆盖黑紫底色、2077 黄（`#FCEE0A`）、霓虹青（`#00E5FF`）和品红，加入切角 HUD 面板、渐隐网格、CRT 扫描线、SVG 故障字标与三套可调光标；还可从 Wallpaper Engine 选择静态、视频帧或动态 WebP 壁纸。目标是 DSH Web `0.2.x`；Wallpaper Engine 与 `ffmpeg` 都是可选的，视频壁纸缺少 `ffmpeg` 时退回封面，部分样式依赖 DSH 内部类名后缀。
description.en: A Night City reskin with near-black purple surfaces, Cyberpunk 2077 yellow (`#FCEE0A`), neon cyan (`#00E5FF`), magenta accents, chamfered HUD panels, a receding grid, CRT scanlines, an SVG-glitch wordmark, and three adjustable cursors. It can also use static covers, extracted video frames, or animated WebP wallpapers from Wallpaper Engine. Targets DSH Web `0.2.x`; Wallpaper Engine and `ffmpeg` are optional, video falls back to a cover without `ffmpeg`, and some styling relies on DSH internal class-name suffixes.

description.zh: 一只手绘 SVG 鲸鱼娘会趴在 composer 上沿，眨眼、摇尾、喷水、冒泡泡，并随 DSH 的工作、思考、成功和报错状态切换动作；点击、三连击、拖拽和自动打盹也都有反馈。资源全部本地加载，不发遥测或外部网络请求，偏好保存在 `localStorage` 的 `whale-lap:*` 键中，并支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: A hand-drawn SVG whale girl perches on the composer edge, blinking, swishing her tail, spraying water, and blowing bubbles while reacting to DSH work, thinking, success, and error states. Clicks, triple-clicks, dragging, and automatic naps have their own feedback. Assets load locally with no telemetry or external network calls; preferences use `localStorage` keys under `whale-lap:*`, and `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.

description.zh: VPet 提供五种角色形态与对应配色，可用输入框旁的滑块实时切换；开启「VPet 绑定思考等级」后，松开滑块会选择最近的模型推理档位，关闭绑定则可自由选择全部五种形态。只在支持推理等级且有多个档位的模型上显示绑定滑块；角色图片来自 VPet 项目，代码采用 MIT。
description.en: VPet adds five illustrated character forms with matching palettes, selectable from a slider beside the composer. With “VPet reasoning-level binding” enabled, releasing the slider chooses the nearest model tier; with it disabled, all five forms remain freely selectable. The binding slider is hidden for models without reasoning tiers or with only one tier; the code is MIT, while the character artwork follows VPet’s separate attribution terms.

description.zh: 专为 `@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort` 推理档位控件设计的 CSS 皮肤：把 4px 轨道重绘为蓝紫渐变胶囊，加入星点、2.6 秒流光、着色 chip 和最高档加速效果，并分别适配浅色与深色主题。必须先安装并启用 `@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort`；它只覆盖推理档位控件，不改变全局材质，宿主 DOM 结构变化时可能静默失效，减弱动效时星点和流光会停用。
description.en: A CSS skin for the `@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort` control: it turns the plain 4px track into a blue-to-violet pill with a starfield, a 2.6-second sheen sweep, colored chips, and an accelerated highest-tier treatment, with separate light and dark palettes. `@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort` must be installed and enabled first; this skin only styles the reasoning-tier control, can silently stop matching after upstream DOM changes, and disables stars and sheen under reduced motion.

description.zh: 可拖拽的 DSH 互动宠物会跟随 `typing`、`thinking`、`working`、`done`、`error` 和 `sleep` 状态切换动作，并提供抚摸、喂食、玩耍、心情与亲密度记录。当前内置宠物是 `deepseek-whale` 的 JPG/栅格形象，设置面板可换色、导入自定义定义并通过 `window.dshPet` 管理；旧版手绘 SVG 内置宠物已移除。纯浏览器端运行，不读取 API Key、不上传数据，设置与养成数据保存在本机 `localStorage`。
description.en: A draggable DSH companion that reacts to `typing`, `thinking`, `working`, `done`, `error`, and `sleep`, with petting, feeding, play, mood, and affinity tracking. The current built-in pet is the JPG/raster `deepseek-whale`; the settings studio supports recoloring, custom definitions, and the `window.dshPet` API, while the former hand-drawn SVG built-ins have been removed. It runs entirely in the browser, reads no API keys, uploads nothing, and keeps settings and progression in local `localStorage`.

description.zh: Hello Kitty 粉色主题为 DSH Web UI 提供粉色 alias-token 配色、自定义壁纸以及浅色/深色两套样式，安装后随 Harness 启动自动恢复，不改变聊天、模型或任务功能。壁纸可替换为 `assets/kitty-wallpaper.jpg`，样式刷新即可热更新；部分界面依赖宿主 CSS 选择器，DSH 版本升级后可能需要调整。
description.en: A Hello Kitty pink theme for the DSH Web UI with an alias-token palette, a custom wallpaper, and separate light and dark styling. It restores automatically when Harness starts and does not alter chat, model, or task behavior; replace `assets/kitty-wallpaper.jpg` for a new background, and refresh after CSS changes. Some surfaces depend on host CSS selectors, so a DSH upgrade may require selector adjustments.

description.zh: Aqua 玻璃主题把侧栏、顶栏、发送栏及代码块、工具卡、菜单等表面改为磨砂玻璃，配合流体背景、浅深两套色板和可调的 `blur`、`frost`、`radius` 参数。当前没有设置面板，参数通过 `localStorage['dsh-aqua-glass']` 修改；视频壁纸、粒子鲸鱼等功能明确不在范围内，项目采用 AGPL-3.0。
description.en: Aqua Glass turns the sidebar, top bar, composer, code blocks, tool cards, menus, and other surfaces into frosted glass, with a fluid background, light/dark palettes, and runtime `blur`, `frost`, and `radius` controls. There is no settings panel; configure it through `localStorage['dsh-aqua-glass']`. Video wallpapers and the particle whale are explicitly out of scope, and the project is licensed under AGPL-3.0.

description.zh: Clawd 是住在 DSH Web GUI 角落的像素宠物，会响应会话和 Agent 状态，可拖动并支持主题。项目要求 DSH `>=0.1.7-rc.1` 与 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`；主题需另外放入 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clawd/themes/` 或 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clawd-themes/`，Clawd 与 Calico 等 `clawd-on-desk` 角色素材不随仓库分发，且项目明确声明为非官方同人作品。
description.en: Clawd is a draggable, themeable pixel pet that lives in the corner of the DSH Web GUI and reacts to session and agent state. It requires DSH `>=0.1.7-rc.1` and Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`; themes must be supplied under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clawd/themes/` or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clawd-themes/`. Clawd and Calico artwork from `clawd-on-desk` is not redistributed, and the project is explicitly unofficial fan work.

description.zh: 在 DSH 原生浅色、深色和跟随系统之外，提供 Nord、Dracula、Catppuccin、Tokyo Night、One Dark、Gruvbox、Solarized、GitHub、Everforest、Kanagawa 与 Rosé Pine 十一个配色家族。预设只改变配色，明暗仍由外观设置控制；选择写入 `theme-presets.config.preset`，跨刷新和重启保留，并覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 令牌。
description.en: Adds eleven color families—Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Gruvbox, Solarized, GitHub, Everforest, Kanagawa, and Rosé Pine—on top of DSH’s built-in Light, Dark, and System appearance modes. A preset changes the color family while appearance remains independent; the choice persists in `theme-presets.config.preset` across reloads and restarts, using the `--dsw-alias-*` token surface.

description.zh: 为侧栏每个工作区分配专属色相，并用页面背景 tint 和强度滑杆调整整体底色；10 个 OKLCH 等距色相、6 个背景预设、浅深主题独立令牌和设置页即时生效。还带有 `/ws-colors/api/reclaim` 内存回收状态面板，可查看 DSH/Chrome 内存与守护进程状态；超过 10 个工作区可能复用颜色，非 launchd 托管的回收进程不能自动重启。
description.en: Assigns each sidebar workspace its own hue and adds a page-background tint with a strength slider; it provides ten perceptually spaced OKLCH hues, six background presets, separate light/dark token layers, and live settings. It also exposes a `/ws-colors/api/reclaim` memory-reclaim panel for DSH/Chrome memory and daemon status. More than ten workspaces may reuse colors, and a reclaim process not managed by launchd cannot be restarted automatically.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 暗色模式的 Darksoft 主题，以 `--dsw-alias-label-*` 调低正文的暖灰对比，并为 h1–h6 提供柔和彩色标题；纯 CSS 注入、零运行时依赖，可与其他主题共存。它只作用于 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，浅色主题、TUI 和 headless profile 不受支持。
description.en: A Darksoft theme for DSH Web’s dark mode: `--dsw-alias-label-*` overrides soften body text into warm gray, while h1–h6 headings receive restrained colors. It is a zero-dependency CSS injection that can coexist with other theme plugins, but it only targets `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; Light mode, TUI, and headless profiles are not supported.

description.zh: 打开新对话或钉住的会话时播放可跳过的全屏视频片头，并可把另一段视频的静帧或最后 3 秒循环片尾作为工作区皮肤；入场动画与工作区壁纸可独立选择，侧边栏和工作区还有分开的透明度、模糊和字色控制。新对话默认每个会话只播一次，钉住的会话每次打开都会播；自动播放先静音，声音和真全屏需要用户手势，安装或升级后还需重启 DSH 并硬刷新。
description.en: Plays a skippable full-frame video intro when a new or pinned conversation opens, and can use a still frame or looping final three seconds from another clip as the workspace skin. Intro and wallpaper selections are independent, with separate sidebar/workspace transparency, blur, and text-color controls. New conversations play once per conversation while pinned conversations replay on every open; autoplay starts muted, sound and true fullscreen require a user gesture, and installation or upgrades require a DSH restart plus a hard refresh.

description.zh: 深空配色、缓慢闪烁的星点和四组淡淡的星座连线构成安静的全屏背景层，使用 `--dsw-*` 主题令牌且不抢指针、不改变布局，并遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`。这是深色限定主题：启用时会把浅色外观自动改回 Dark；关闭插件即可恢复原始配色和浅色选择。要求 DSH Web `>=0.2.1-rc.2`。
description.en: A quiet frame-wide sky layer with deep-space colors, slowly twinkling stars, and four faint constellation figures; it uses DSH theme tokens, does not capture pointers or shift layout, and honors `prefers-reduced-motion`. It is dark-only: while enabled it forces the appearance back to Dark if Light is selected. Disable the plugin to restore the original palette and Light choice. Requires DSH Web `>=0.2.1-rc.2`.

description.zh: 可多选上传 GIF、WebP、APNG 和 PNG/JPG/SVG 图片，也可混用 12 色纯色；按 3–120 秒以双图层交叉淡入淡出切换，支持顺序/随机播放、Ken Burns、contain/cover、虚化和主题自适应可读性保护层。资源与设置存入浏览器 IndexedDB，重启和刷新后恢复但不会跨设备同步；单张图片上限 25MB，并遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: Upload multiple GIF, WebP, APNG, PNG, JPG, or SVG images, mix them with a 12-color solid palette, and cross-fade between layers every 3–120 seconds with sequential or random playback, Ken Burns motion, contain/cover modes, blur, and a theme-adaptive readability scrim. Images and settings live in browser IndexedDB and survive reloads and restarts but do not sync across devices; each image is limited to 25 MB, and `prefers-reduced-motion` is honored.

description.zh: 按 Agent 生命周期切换八种逐帧循环动作：一次生成一张 6×8 精灵表，覆盖待命、思考、执行工具、等待确认、完成和出错等状态；内置云朵猫 Momo，也能使用已配置的图片生成服务生成新形象，或导入其他 AI 生成的精灵表而不需要 Key。它只观察状态事件和工具名称，不读取对话正文，位置与设置持久化；最后两行状态暂未接入触发器，也不提供云同步或社区提交。
description.en: Maps Agent lifecycle states to eight looping frame animations: one generation produces a 6×8 sprite sheet for idle, thinking, tool execution, approval waiting, done, error, and reserved states. Cloud-cat Momo is built in; new pets can be generated through a configured image service or imported from another image AI without a key. The plugin observes lifecycle events and tool names rather than conversation text, persists position and settings, and currently leaves the last two state rows untriggered; cloud sync and community submissions are not included.

description.zh: 提供 7 档背景（网格、纯色、暖光、拉丝、实景、自定义渐变、本地图片）、4 档玻璃材质和一条右缘刻度轨，主色会随背景色温变化，也可手选。刻度按当前已加载的对话轮数等距分布，只表示第几轮，不表示内容长度或完整历史；跨入口偏好同步依赖配套中控台，没有中控台时只在当前入口生效，整体不改 DSH 几何布局。
description.en: Offers seven backgrounds—grid, solid, warm glow, brushed metal, site photo, custom gradient, and local image—plus four glass-material levels and a right-edge rail whose accent color follows the background’s temperature or a manual choice. The rail is evenly spaced by conversation rounds currently loaded, not by content length or total history; cross-entry preference sync requires the companion control plane, otherwise settings stay local to the current entry point, and the skin deliberately makes no geometry changes.

description.zh: 一款偏安静的陪伴插件，内置银白龙娘、橙书娘和蓝鲸女仆三套角色，提供久坐、喝水、连续工作和深夜四类提醒、云朵气泡与页面内/独立桌面窗口两种显示方式，也可向同一 Profile 中的原版 `dsh-pet` 发送基础关怀。页面内模式在 macOS 实测；独立 Electron 窗口只支持 macOS arm64 与官方 Electron 43.3.0，Windows/Linux 未验证，角色美术为 CC BY-NC 4.0 非商业素材。
description.en: A deliberately quiet companion with three built-in characters—silver, orange, and blue-whale—plus break, water, long-session, and late-night reminders, cloud bubbles, and either an in-page or standalone desktop display. It can optionally send basic care messages to `dsh-pet` in the same profile. The in-page mode is tested on macOS; the standalone Electron window is limited to macOS arm64 with official Electron 43.3.0, Windows/Linux are unverified, and the character art is CC BY-NC 4.0 non-commercial material.

description.zh: 通过新浪 `hq.sinajs.cn` 免登录、免 API key 获取实时 A 股行情，把自选篮平均涨跌映射成奔跑的牛、熊或横盘状态；平均涨幅越接近 20%，速度、跳跃和扬尘越夸张。可拖动宠物、搜索最多 200 个标的、查看组合平均和按涨跌比例排列的行情赛道；数据仅供学习娱乐，不构成投资建议，也不是券商官方产品。
description.en: Uses Sina’s public `hq.sinajs.cn` endpoint—no login or API key—to turn the average move of an A-share watchlist into a running bull, bear, or calm state; as the average approaches a 20% gain, speed, jumps, and dust become more dramatic. The draggable panel supports searching up to 200 symbols, shows the portfolio average, and ranks holdings on a proportional market race track. Data is for study and entertainment, not investment advice, and the plugin is not an official broker or quote-provider product.

description.zh: 右下角鲸鱼挂件专为 API3D（`api3d.cn`）设计，显示站点余额、账号或当前 key 的今日已用、每轮对话消耗和可选额度，并支持自定义点击序列、模块化泡泡、图片、字体、音效、吸附与翻转。站点地址、字段、币种 CNY 和凭据名均已内置，用户只需把 API Key 写入 DSH 凭据服务；这是 API3D 专属版本，不再回退到官方 DeepSeek 余额接口。
description.en: A whale widget built specifically for API3D (`api3d.cn`) that shows site balance, account- or key-scoped daily usage, per-turn cost, and optional quota, with customizable click sequences, modular bubbles, images, fonts, sounds, snapping, and mirroring. The endpoint, fields, CNY currency, and credential name are built in, so the only required setup is an API Key stored through the DSH credential service. This is the API3D-only variant and no longer falls back to the official DeepSeek balance API.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的微信风格浅色主题：深色 72px 图标栏、灰色 288px 会话列表、浅绿色用户气泡、绿色发送按钮和紧凑的助手卡片，同时保留搜索、侧栏拖动、代码/表格滚动与附件编辑。已在 Windows 的 DSH Desktop 2.0.17 / Harness UI 0.2.0-rc.2 验证；不发额外网络请求，但少量局部选择器绑定已测 UI 版本，升级后需复核外观。
description.en: A WeChat-inspired light theme for DSH Desktop with a dark 72px icon rail, a gray 288px conversation list, pale-green user bubbles, a green send button, and compact assistant cards while preserving search, sidebar dragging, code/table scrolling, and attachments. Verified on Windows with DSH Desktop 2.0.17 / Harness UI 0.2.0-rc.2; it makes no extra network requests, but a few local selectors target the tested UI version and should be rechecked after upgrades.

description.zh: 用一份 `preset.json` 的颜色锚点和媒体文件替换整套 `--dsw-*` 配色与背景，支持静态图、`mp4`/`webm` 视频和 `sway`/`drift` CSS 微动，并提供 `/dsh-visual/` 点击切换页；Web profile 与桌面端均有固定证据验证。仓库只附带一张自绘 demo 壁纸，Steam 创意工坊等第三方素材不入库、不受 MIT 覆盖，使用其他预设时需要自行提供素材。
description.en: Uses a single `preset.json` of color anchors plus media to replace the full `--dsw-*` palette and background, supporting still images, `mp4`/`webm` video, `sway`/`drift` CSS motion, and a click-to-switch `/dsh-visual/` page. Fixed evidence verifies both the Web profile and desktop app. The repository ships only one original demo wallpaper; Steam Workshop and other third-party assets are omitted and are not covered by MIT, so other presets require user-supplied media.

description.zh: 自包含的桌面宠物插件，直接订阅 Harness 会话事件，提供帧动画、waiting/thinking/tool/review/done/failed 六阶段气泡、亲密度、每日 token 计量和可选鲸鱼装扮；可直接读取 Codex 的 `pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp`，无需网页宠物依赖。需要可用的 Electron 运行时，且只渲染 sprite2d 图集，会跳过 `live2d`/`frames2d` 宠物；鼠标穿透始终可从设置恢复。
description.en: A self-contained desktop companion that subscribes directly to Harness session events and provides frame animation, waiting/thinking/tool/review/done/failed bubbles, affinity, a daily token meter, and an optional whale decoration without requiring a web pet. It loads Codex `pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp` folders directly, requires an available Electron runtime, and intentionally skips `live2d`/`frames2d` pets because it renders sprite2d atlases; click-through can always be undone from Settings.

description.zh: Kami 风格的纸媒主题以暖羊皮纸画布、墨蓝强调色、衬线排版、发丝线边框和克制阴影统一浅色/深色界面，并用形状、填充、描边区分发送键的 disabled、idle、running 状态。面向 DSH Web `>=0.1.0-rc.6`，不打包字体而使用系统字体；部分状态选择器依赖宿主类名与结构，未来改版时会回落为原生外观而非修改布局。
description.en: A Kami-inspired editorial theme built around warm parchment, ink-blue accents, serif typography, hairline borders, and restrained shadows in both Light and Dark modes; send-button disabled, idle, and running states are distinguished by shape, fill, and stroke. It targets DSH Web `>=0.1.0-rc.6` and ships no font files, relying on system fonts. Some state selectors depend on host class-name fragments and structure, so future DSH changes may return those elements to the native appearance without altering layout.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 面板后循环播放静音的 `assets/wallpaper.mp4`，用 scrim 保护文字可读性；开启 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时停用视频并显示 `assets/poster.jpg`，面板本身的样式保持不变。固定证据只验证 DSH Web `>=0.1.0-rc.6` 中的 `0.1.0-rc.6`，视频、海报和截图的角色/商标权利也不包含在代码的 MIT 许可中，项目与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。
description.en: Loops the muted `assets/wallpaper.mp4` behind the DSH Web panels with a scrim for text contrast, while `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the video and shows `assets/poster.jpg`; the panels themselves keep their styling. Fixed evidence verifies only DSH Web `0.1.0-rc.6` within the declared `>=0.1.0-rc.6` range. Rights to the characters/trademarks in the video, poster, and screenshots are separate from the code’s MIT license, and the project is not affiliated with DeepSeek.

description.zh: 这里的 shell 指应用外壳而非侧边栏终端：插件提供约 1.5 秒开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多 9 张本地自定义图片、浅深主题面板透明度和启动底色，设置页改动即时预览。图片保存在当前浏览器的 IndexedDB，不上传也不跨设备同步；开场动画只在页面加载时播放一次，极端比例会裁切壁纸，Windows/Linux 的桌面透明效果尚未验证。
description.en: Here “shell” means the app shell, not the sidebar terminal. The plugin adds a roughly 1.5-second opening animation, three built-in wallpapers, up to nine local custom images, light/dark panel opacity, and a startup base color with live settings preview. Images stay in the current browser’s IndexedDB, never upload, and do not sync across devices; the intro plays once per page load, extreme aspect ratios crop wallpapers, and desktop transparency on Windows/Linux is unverified.

description.zh: Cyber Sand 用深海军蓝半透明面板承载固定的赛博城市背景，以全息立方体青色作为强调色，并覆盖约 30 个 `--dsw-alias-*` 令牌（背景、文字、边框、按钮、滚动条、Markdown 和侧栏）。它会强制 DSH 使用 Dark 外观，属于 Web client 主题；移除插件即可恢复默认深色配色并移除背景层。
description.en: Cyber Sand places a fixed cyber-city background behind translucent deep-navy panels, uses a holographic-cube cyan as its accent, and overrides roughly 30 `--dsw-alias-*` tokens across backgrounds, labels, borders, buttons, scrollbars, Markdown, and the sidebar. It forces DSH onto the Dark appearance and is a Web client theme; removing it restores the default dark palette and removes the background layer.

description.zh: 在一个悬浮面板中切换四套预设：樱风（藏青/制服红/奶油粉）、褐东风（青铜/焦褐/仪表金）、潮汐（深青/靛蓝/浪白）和月壤（月岩灰/星蓝/银紫）；每套都有浅色/深色色板，支持 2×2 卡片、数字键 1–4、`Alt + Shift + S` 和恢复原生外观。它只叠加 `--dsw-*` 令牌与装饰 CSS，不改宿主源码；README 的截图来自宿主替身，不是真实 DSH 界面，且与其他令牌皮肤同时启用可能混色。
description.en: Switches among four presets from one floating panel: Sakura Wind (navy, uniform red, cream pink), Bronze East Wind (bronze, burnt brown, instrument gold), Tide (deep teal, indigo, wave white), and Lunar Soil (moon-rock gray, star blue, silver violet). Each has Light and Dark palettes, with 2×2 cards, number keys 1–4, `Alt + Shift + S`, and a restore-native action. It adds `--dsw-*` tokens and decorative CSS without changing host source; the README screenshots use a host substitute rather than real DSH, and concurrent token skins may blend.

description.zh: 悬浮鲸鱼卡会跟随当前会话的供应商切换面板：OpenCode Go 显示 5 小时/每周/每月额度百分比与重置倒计时，DeepSeek 账户显示累计消费与余额，官方 API 显示可用状态和余额；支持拖动、详情展开和每 60 秒刷新。凭据只留在 Host，未支持的供应商会隐藏卡片；OpenCode Go 返回的是按模型权重折算的百分比而非美元金额，DeepSeek 官方 API 也不提供历史消费明细。
description.en: A floating whale card follows the current session’s provider: OpenCode Go shows 5-hour, weekly, and monthly quota percentages with reset countdowns; DeepSeek Account shows cumulative spend and balances; and the official API shows availability and balance. It supports dragging, an expanded detail view, and 60-second refreshes. Credentials stay in the Host and unsupported providers hide the card; OpenCode Go supplies weighted percentages rather than dollar amounts, while the official DeepSeek API provides no historical spend detail.

description.zh: 右下角悬浮 Q 版明日香支持点击台词、拖拽定位和持久化位置；用户提交输入到 Agent 完成输出期间会显示旋转 AT Field 光圈，气泡按空闲/非空闲状态轮换。纯客户端插件，不发网络请求，兼容 0.1.x 与 0.2.0 起的运行时；项目仅从本地目录安装，许可为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，禁止商业使用。
description.en: A floating chibi Asuka supports click-to-speak lines, dragging, and persistent positioning. A rotating AT Field appears from submission until the agent finishes, while bubbles cycle between idle and active states. It is a client-only plugin with no network requests and supports 0.1.x and 0.2.0+ runtimes; installation is from a local checkout, and the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license prohibits commercial use.

description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮电子木鱼，点击会播放木鱼晃动、木槌动作、声波环和 `+1` 飘字，并按 `YYYY-MM-DD` 记录每日敲击；设置页提供今日/累计/连续天数和近 3、6、12 个月的木色日历热力图。数据写入 `$DSH_HOME/wooden-fish-data.json`，纯本地零网络，位置与显隐状态会保留；当前没有敲击音效，反馈只有视觉动画。
description.en: A draggable floating wooden fish that responds to clicks with a shake, mallet swing, ripple ring, and floating `+1`, while counting knocks in `YYYY-MM-DD` buckets. Settings provides today/total/streak cards and a wood-toned calendar heatmap for 3, 6, or 12 months. Data stays local in `$DSH_HOME/wooden-fish-data.json`, with no network calls; position and visibility persist, but knock sound is not implemented and feedback is visual only.

description.zh: 按 `pendingInteraction`、`running` 和最近活动自动把会话分为“等你回答 / 工作中 / 闲置 / 结束”，点击即可跳转；折叠的工作组还会露出最近活动的成员。状态来自 DSH 的 `useSessions` / `useSessionStatus`，不读会话文件、不解 zstd、也不联网；内置“鲸蓝娘”桌宠和 4 套可热切换皮肤，并支持带上限的工作组共享记忆。内嵌 pet 子目录沿用 Apache-2.0 许可。
description.en: Automatically groups sessions as Waiting for you, Working, Idle, or Finished from `pendingInteraction`, `running`, and recent activity, with one-click navigation; collapsed workgroups can preview recently active members. It reads DSH’s `useSessions` / `useSessionStatus` state rather than session files, does not decode zstd or use the network, and includes a Whale Girl pet, four hot-swappable skins, and capped shared memory for workgroups. The embedded pet subtree remains Apache-2.0 licensed.

description.zh: 右下角的动画桌宠以气泡显示 3 个实时计数：正在运行、完成但未读、等待你选择（确认 / 计划审查 / 提问）；点击数字可跳转，会话同组多项可连续轮换。它通过 DSH `uiSession.sessionStatus` 事件驱动更新，不轮询、无 host 端行为；只把直接子代理的运行/待交互聚合进统计，子代理完成不会计入“完成未读”。
description.en: An animated bottom-right pet shows three live counts in a bubble: running, completed but unread, and waiting for your choice (approval, plan review, or question). Click a count to open a session; repeated clicks cycle through that group. Updates are event-driven from DSH `uiSession.sessionStatus`, with no polling or host-side behavior; direct child running and pending states are aggregated, but child-agent completion is not counted as unread.

description.zh: 在液态玻璃与苏联构成主义两套设计语言之间即时切换，并提供个性化面板、可投放的 CSS 皮肤包和“鲸鱼娘”桌宠（7 种表情）。配色以 OKLCH 定义并按 WCAG 校验，卸载可恢复原生界面；桌宠立绘为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，禁止商用。
description.en: Switch instantly between Liquid Glass and Soviet Constructivism, with a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a Whale Girl pet with seven expressions. Palettes are defined in OKLCH and checked against WCAG; uninstall restores the native UI. The pet artwork is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and non-commercial.

description.zh: 把会话输入框做成模拟仪表质感的液态玻璃：磨砂层、顶部镜面高光、内缘白线、边缘泛光，以及模型思考时上升的三颗气泡；浅深主题过渡为 1.7 秒。仅作用于 Web 客户端，面向 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 及以上的 Chromium/Electron；开启 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时停用动画。
description.en: Turns the composer into analog-instrument-inspired liquid glass with a frosted layer, specular top highlight, inner white line, edge bloom, and three bubbles that rise only while the model is thinking; light/dark transitions take 1.7 seconds. It targets the web client on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2+` in Chromium/Electron, and disables motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

description.zh: 参考《明日方舟：终末地》官网视觉的工业编辑主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄与武陵青强调色，支持直角/圆角、磨砂表面、等高线背景与中央散景、鼠标轨迹、启动动画和音频通知。它是仅作用于客户端的非官方同人改版，不修改 DSH 源码；改版代码和参数由 AI 生成，可能存在未知问题。
description.en: An industrial-editorial theme inspired by the Arknights: Endfield website: cream paper, ink text, signal yellow and Wuling cyan accents, with square/rounded forms, frosted surfaces, contour backgrounds with center defocus, pointer trails, a launch animation, and audio notifications. It is an unofficial client-only fan fork that does not modify DSH source; the revision’s code and parameter changes were generated by AI and may contain unknown issues.

name.zh: 皮肤与 Token 用量面板

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop/Web 提供“深海夜航”和“暖纸日光”两套皮肤、5 套内置摄影背景，以及可递归扫描本地文件夹的图片轮播（可选子目录、间隔、暂停和下一张）。设置页还按会话显示官方 `tokenUsage` 投影中的计费输入、输出、缓存命中率和总量；不复制提示词、回复或工具内容，也不发起外部网络请求。安装/构建要求 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。
description.en: Provides two skins—Deep-Sea Night Flight and Warm Paper Daylight—five bundled photo backgrounds, and a local image rotator that can recurse through folders with subfolder selection, interval control, pause, and next-image actions. Its settings page also shows per-session billed input, output, cache-hit rate, and total tokens from the official `tokenUsage` projection; it does not copy prompts, responses, or tool content, and makes no external network requests. Installation/building requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

description.zh: DSH Web 右下角的像素风悬浮桌宠：根据会话状态在空闲、工作、等待授权、提问、完成、失败和断开之间切换，使用 8×8 状态图集与逐帧时长。支持拖拽奔跑、空闲双击挥手、状态气泡、光晕和 60–200px 尺寸设置；许可证为 BSD-3-Clause。
description.en: A pixel-art floating pet for the DSH Web GUI. It switches among idle, working, authorization, question, done, failed, and disconnected moods from session activity, using an 8×8 sprite sheet with per-frame timing. It supports drag-to-run, a double-click wave, status bubbles, glow, and 60–200px sizing; BSD-3-Clause licensed.

description.zh: 深海近黑底的玻璃拟态皮肤，以单一生物荧光光源和发丝线分层构成；可组合 4 种底色、5 种强调色、3 档圆角密度、3 档极光强度和颗粒开关，共 360 种组合。需要 `@dsh-eac/ui-skin-loader >=1.2.0` 提供皮肤发现、切换和持久化；README 也记录了无控制台时的独立模式。适配 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` 和 Node `>=24`。
description.en: A near-black deep-sea glassmorphism skin built around one bioluminescent light source and hairline layering. Combine four base colors, five accents, three corner densities, three aurora levels, and film grain for 360 combinations. It requires `@dsh-eac/ui-skin-loader >=1.2.0` for skin discovery, switching, and persistence; the README also documents a standalone mode without the console. It targets DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` and requires Node `>=24`.

description.zh: 工业终端风格的 DSH 皮肤：直角切角、黑色发丝线、黄黑警示条、四角登记标记和 DIN 技术字；提供跟随应用的纸面/终端亮暗底、3 种强调色、3 档圆角与纹理/硬投影开关，共 216 种组合。需要 `@dsh-eac/ui-skin-loader >=1.2.0` 提供皮肤发现、切换和持久化；适配 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`、Node `>=24`。
description.en: An industrial-terminal DSH skin with square cuts, black hairlines, yellow-and-black warning bars, corner registration marks, and DIN technical type. It offers app-following Paper and Terminal light/dark bases, three accents, three corner-radius options, and texture/hard-shadow controls for 216 combinations. It requires `@dsh-eac/ui-skin-loader >=1.2.0` for skin discovery, switching, and persistence; it targets DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` and Node `>=24`.

description.zh: 独立的纯 CSS 主题，只提供金紫液态玻璃、金色输入文字、代码配色、助手几何标记、工作台卡片和阅读排版；不含游戏背景、角色、视频、音频或外部媒体。支持主题配色、专注模式和减少动态效果；推理滑块样式只适配已安装的兼容选择器，已在 Windows / Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证，运行要求 Node `>=22.19`。
description.en: An independent CSS-only theme providing gold-violet liquid glass, gold input text, code colors, geometric assistant marks, workbench cards, and reading typography. It includes no game backgrounds, characters, video, audio, or external media. It supports palette controls, focus mode, and reduced motion; reasoning-slider styling only applies when a compatible selector plugin is already installed. Verified on Windows / Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`; the package requires Node `>=22.19`.

description.zh: 仅针对 DSH Web 深色主题的轻量文字调校：降低过亮的正文与加粗文字颜色，把 `<strong>` 字重从 600 放宽到 500，并减轻 h1–h4 标题字重。纯客户端、无运行时依赖；新增配置层后需重启一次，之后保存后刷新即可，浅色主题不受影响。
description.en: A lightweight text-tuning layer for the DSH Web dark theme: it dims overly bright body and bold text, changes `<strong>` from weight 600 to 500, and relaxes h1–h4 heading weights. It is client-only with no runtime dependencies; installing a new config layer needs one restart, after which edits apply on refresh. The light theme is unaffected.

description.zh: EchoCat Prettier 只重组浏览器里的回复展示，不改提示词、模型参数、原文、顺序或复制内容。提供 15 套视觉风格、9 套排版、独立配色、每条回复 2–8 个 emoji 和 1–4 张主题表情包；长回复会自动暂停持续动画、复杂毛玻璃和跨栏排版以减少卡顿与裁切。表情包网络请求仅发送表情包、短主题和情绪，无 API Key、遥测或账号系统。
description.en: EchoCat Prettier only reorganizes how replies are displayed in the browser; it does not change prompts, model parameters, source text, order, or copied content. It offers 15 visual styles, nine layouts, independent palettes, 2–8 emoji and 1–4 themed stickers per reply, and pauses persistent motion, complex glass, and cross-column layouts for long replies to reduce jank and clipping. Sticker requests send only the sticker, a short topic, and an emotion; no API key, telemetry, or account system is required.

description.zh: Nord 配色覆盖 132 个设计 token，提供独立设置页、可选界面/代码字体和输入框下方的 DeepSeek 余额读数及明细面板，并修复宽 Markdown 表格的悬停抖动。字体设置仅在 DSH `<0.2.1` 由插件接管；支持的宿主为 `0.1.7`、`0.2.0`、`0.2.1` 系列，`<=0.1.5` 不支持，余额读数需要在 Host 端配置相应凭据。
description.en: Nord theme for DSH with 132 design-token overrides, its own settings page, optional interface/code fonts, a DeepSeek balance readout with detail panel below the composer, and a fix for jittering wide Markdown tables. The plugin owns font settings only on DSH `<0.2.1`; supported hosts are the `0.1.7`, `0.2.0`, and `0.2.1` lines, while `<=0.1.5` is unsupported. The balance readout requires a Host-side balance credential.

description.zh: 把对话区变成透明的字符雨画布，支持黑客帝国英文数字、道法修仙篆体和甲骨卜辞三种模式，七种配色与独立金边发光；可让 agent 流式 token 原文混入雨柱，按活跃度调节雨速，并调透明度、速度、密度、字号、范围和注音。修仙模式内嵌 LXGW 霞鹜篆书（OFL-1.1），甲骨字形来自 CC BY 4.0 数据集；支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，双击可清屏，固定 README 记录的验证宿主为 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`。
description.en: A transparent canvas of digital rain over the conversation, with Matrix-style letters and numbers, Taoist seal-script, or oracle-bone modes; seven color schemes and an independent gold-edge glow. Agent streaming tokens can enter the rain, intensity can follow activity, and opacity, speed, density, font size, region, and zhuyin labels are adjustable. The seal-script mode embeds LXGW Seal Script under OFL-1.1; oracle glyphs come from a CC BY 4.0 dataset. It honors `prefers-reduced-motion`, double-click clears the canvas, and the fixed README records DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` as the verified host.

name.zh: 率土之滨 · 铁血水墨

description.zh: 纯客户端皮肤，把 DSH Web 做成暗色“铁血战场”和亮色“水墨古风”两套场景：约 115 个 `--dsw-*` token、宋体系衬线字体、宣纸/墨染纹理、青铜滚动条、回纹角饰和印玺装饰，自动跟随系统浅色/深色偏好。装饰与纹理由 SVG/CSS 代码生成，不含第三方图片或游戏资源。
description.en: A client-only DSH Web skin with two scenes: dark Ironblood Battlefield and light Ink-Wash Ancient style. It covers about 115 `--dsw-*` tokens and adds Song-style serif text, xuan-paper/ink textures, bronze scrollbars, key-fret corner ornaments, and a seal, following the system light/dark preference. All decorations and textures are generated as SVG/CSS; no third-party images or game assets are shipped.

description.zh: 从本地 `images/` 目录读取 JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/AVIF，默认每 5 分钟轮播一张全屏背景，并叠加默认 35% 黑色蒙版；复制新图后下一轮即可出现。可用 `DSH_SKIN_IMAGES_DIR`、`DSH_SKIN_ROTATE_MS` 和 `DSH_SKIN_OVERLAY_OPACITY` 配置目录、间隔和蒙版；仓库不内置背景图，且需要 Web profile 的 host 半提供本地文件路由。
description.en: Rotates local JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/AVIF files from `images/` into a full-screen background, every five minutes by default, with a 35% black overlay for readability; new files appear on the next cycle. Configure the folder, interval, and overlay with `DSH_SKIN_IMAGES_DIR`, `DSH_SKIN_ROTATE_MS`, and `DSH_SKIN_OVERLAY_OPACITY`. No wallpapers are bundled, and the Web-profile host half must expose the local-file route.

description.zh: 页面角落漂着一只蓝紫绿渐变的半透明鲸鱼，点击打开可拖动、最小化的临时聊天窗；默认跟随 Harness 会话模型，也可配置任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持逐 token 流式输出、复制和清空。聊天不会写入 DSH 会话历史，插件内可清空；自定义模式的 API Key 只保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，只发送到你配置的端点。
description.en: A translucent blue–purple–green whale drifts at the edge of the page; click it to open a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window. It follows the Harness session model by default, or can use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with streamed output, copy, and clear controls. Chats never enter DSH session history and can be cleared in the plugin; in custom mode the API key stays in browser `localStorage` and is sent only to the endpoint you configure.

description.zh: 设置里的样式工作台提供实时 CSS 编辑器、点选元素生成样式、163 个 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌的明暗值编辑、字号/密度/圆角/内容宽度/气泡圆角滑杆，以及 7 套预设和 JSON 导入导出。配置权威副本写入 `$DSH_HOME/custom-style.json`，不收集数据、不发起外部网络请求；它不注册主题，可与其他主题共存，但覆盖同一 token 时后加载者优先。
description.en: A settings-based style workbench with a live CSS editor, click-to-style element picker, light/dark editing for 163 `--dsw-*` design tokens, sliders for type scale, density, corner radius, content width, and bubble radius, plus seven presets with JSON import/export. The authoritative copy is stored in `$DSH_HOME/custom-style.json`; it collects nothing and makes no external network requests. It registers no theme and can coexist with other themes, but the later override wins when both change the same token.

description.zh: 纯黑背景与高对比 `#00ff41` 绿色强调的 DSH Web 黑客终端皮肤：全站直角、等宽字体、对话与输入区全宽，并为 Gecko/Blink/WebKit 提供统一的 8px 绿黑滚动条。无扫描线覆盖，面向 OLED；插件仅在客户端覆盖主题 token 并注入 CSS，卸载时移除。
description.en: A hacker-terminal skin for DSH Web with a pure-black background and high-contrast `#00ff41` accents, square corners, a monospace stack, full-width conversation/composer areas, and uniform 8px green-on-black scrollbars across Gecko, Blink, and WebKit. It uses no scanline overlay and is OLED-friendly; the plugin only overrides client-side theme tokens and CSS, which are removed on teardown.

description.zh: 暗色专用的资产型皮肤，以循环视频为背景：蓝发少女、青色数据雨和悬浮全息仪表盘，面板使用薄玻璃与 1px 冷蓝细线；支持 `skin.json` v2、完整 token 重映射和补丁样式。视频背景约 25.46 秒循环，皮肤不使用 `backdrop-filter` 以保持画面清晰；许可证 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0（需署名、非商业、相同方式共享），且最亮画面下输入占位符对比度可能低于 4.5:1。
description.en: A dark-only asset skin built around a looping video: a blue-haired girl, cyan data rain, and a floating holographic instrument panel with thin glass surfaces and 1px cold-blue lines. It ships a v2 `skin.json`, a full token remap, and selector patches; the video loops at about 25.46 seconds. It avoids `backdrop-filter` to preserve sharp footage. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0—attribution, non-commercial use, and share-alike required—and the composer placeholder can fall below 4.5:1 over the brightest footage.

name.zh: 千夏 · 绝区零外观主题

description.zh: 《绝区零》千夏（Sunna）同人外观主题，提供“立绘”和“影画”两套主题，均有浅色/深色形态；右下角画板可调 5 个图层、内容底色透明度、背景主视觉和启动动画时长，并可拖动 Q 版挂件、选择 7 种表情。已在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证；素材按 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 发布，非官方且非商业。
description.en: A fan-made ZZZ Sunna appearance theme with Portrait and Overlay variants, each in light and dark forms. The bottom-right palette board controls five layers, content-surface opacity, background artwork, and intro-animation duration; the draggable chibi companion includes seven expressions. Verified on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, unofficial and non-commercial.

description.zh: 纯客户端液态玻璃样式，给助手消息、会话/插件/任务侧栏行和桌面标题栏菜单添加半透明底板、圆角和阴影；用户自己的消息气泡明确排除。可通过 `--aris-glass-alpha` 与 `--aris-glass-blur` 调整透明度和模糊；不支持 `backdrop-filter` 或启用减少透明度时退回不透明主题底色，并在检测到壁纸插件的侧栏玻璃时主动让位。面向 DSH `0.2.0-rc` Web 结构。
description.en: A client-only liquid-glass layer for assistant messages, session/plugin/task rows in the sidebar, and desktop title-bar menus, adding translucent surfaces, rounded corners, and shadows while explicitly leaving user bubbles untouched. Tune it with `--aris-glass-alpha` and `--aris-glass-blur`; browsers without `backdrop-filter` or with reduced transparency fall back to opaque theme surfaces, and the sidebar layer yields to the wallpaper plugin’s glass mode. Targets the DSH `0.2.0-rc` Web structure.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop/Web 的主题定制器：可分别调节背景、侧栏、聊天卡片、输入框、品牌强调色、代码块和文字/边框颜色；亚克力玻璃支持 0–40px 模糊、10%–100% 不透明度和 100%–220% 饱和度，并可单独控制侧栏、聊天卡片和输入框。还支持循环 MP4/WebM 与静态图片壁纸、内置动态壁纸和命名预设，右下角浮动调色按钮会在闲置后隐藏。
description.en: A DSH Desktop/Web theme customizer with separate controls for the base, sidebar, chat cards, composer, brand accent, code blocks, text, and borders. Its acrylic glass layer supports 0–40px blur, 10%–100% opacity, and 100%–220% saturation, with independent sidebar, chat-card, and composer toggles. It also supports looping MP4/WebM or static-image wallpapers, built-in live wallpapers, named presets, and a bottom-right palette button that hides after inactivity.

description.zh: 用本地图片、视频或 12 套随浅深主题变化的渐变预设替换 DSH Web 背景，并调节清晰度、背景/界面/对话栏透明度、亮度、对比度、饱和度、缩放、位置、遮罩、铺放方式和动效；玻璃模式还能让侧栏、卡片和浮层半透明。媒体只存浏览器 IndexedDB，设置写入 localStorage，不联网、不读取聊天内容；支持减少动态效果和关闭视频自动播放。
description.en: Customize the DSH Web background with a local image, video, or one of 12 gradients that each adapt to light and dark themes. Adjust clarity, background/UI/composer opacity, brightness, contrast, saturation, zoom, position, veil, fit mode, and motion; glass mode makes the sidebar, cards, and popovers translucent. Media stays in browser IndexedDB and settings in localStorage; the plugin makes no network requests, never reads chat content, honors reduced motion, and can disable video autoplay.

description.zh: 为输入框、弹窗、菜单、卡片、代码块、任务面板和右侧栏统一使用按浅色/深色分别调校的半透明玻璃材质，带顶部高光、边缘反光和背景模糊。设置 → 通用 → 外观提供总开关，关闭后精确恢复原生外观；适用于 DSH Desktop/Electron 与 `dsh web` 的 0.2.x，不联网、不读取会话或凭据，只写插件自己的 localStorage。
description.en: Applies one translucent glass material—tuned separately for light and dark—to the composer, dialogs, menus, cards, code blocks, task panels, and right sidebar, with top highlights, edge reflections, and background blur. A switch under Settings → General → Appearance restores the stock UI exactly when off. Works on the DSH Desktop/Electron app and `dsh web` for DSH 0.2.x; it makes no network requests, reads no sessions or credentials, and writes only its own localStorage.

description.zh: 以星云壁纸为底、根据壁纸种子色实时取色的深色 DSH 主题，叠加液态玻璃，并覆盖启动屏、关于页、插件页和背景设置；可用本地图片/视频替换壁纸，文件只写入 `~/.dsh/star-wallpaper/`。支持 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0` 的完整适配，旧版本退回基础模式；随包的《崩坏：星穹铁道》/DeepSeek 资源有各自版权限制，商业或再分发前需替换为已获授权素材。
description.en: A dark DSH theme built around a nebula wallpaper whose seed color drives the palette, with liquid-glass surfaces and skins for the boot screen, About, Plugins, and background settings. You can replace the wallpaper with a local image or video; files stay under `~/.dsh/star-wallpaper/`. Full support targets DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`; older versions fall back to a basic mode. Bundled Honkai: Star Rail and DeepSeek assets carry separate rights restrictions, so replace them with licensed material before commercial use or redistribution.
