description.zh: 可选的赛博编辑风格深色主题包，提供 Acid Noir、Acid Noir Signal 和 Default appearance 三个选项；通过官方设置集成管理主题，安装不会强制切换，停用/卸载会移除主题、样式和监听器。只使用稳定的 `--dsw-*`/语义钩子，不修改 Harness 文件、不加载网络字体、图片、音频或游戏素材；适配 DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`。
description.en: A selectable cyber-editorial dark theme bundle with Acid Noir, Acid Noir Signal, and Default appearance. It integrates with official Settings, does not switch themes on installation, and removes its themes, stylesheet, and listeners when disabled or uninstalled. It relies on stable `--dsw-*` and semantic hooks, never patches Harness files, and ships no network fonts, images, audio, game assets, or external runtime resources; its package targets DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`.

description.zh: 可选的新粗野主义/波普艺术主题包，强调“外部大胆、中心安静”：侧栏、选中态、Composer、Goal 和转场使用强几何与高对比色，会话正文、Markdown、终端、diff 和流式内容保持克制。提供 Cutout Clash、Night Cutout、Pop Signal 与 Default appearance，动效可选完整转场、跟随系统或关闭；不含外部字体、图片、音频、网络素材、游戏标志或角色素材，适配 DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`。
description.en: A selectable neo-brutalist/pop-art theme built around loud edge, calm center: the sidebar, selection, Composer, Goal surfaces, and transitions carry expressive geometry, while conversation text, Markdown, terminals, diffs, and streaming content stay quiet. It provides Cutout Clash, Night Cutout, Pop Signal, and Default appearance, with Full motion, Follow system, or Motion off. No external fonts, images, audio, network assets, game marks, or character assets are included; the package targets DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`.

description.zh: 提供暖纸 Warm Paper、柔褐书页 Old Book、茶褐 Tea Brown、橄榄静绿 Quiet Olive 和雾蓝 Mist Blue 五套低蓝光配色，覆盖 DSH 语义 token，并热切生效、零布局改动、卸载可还原。支持 macOS/Windows 的浅深主题；只改颜色与材质，不改原生布局，持久化使用 localStorage，需 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`。
description.en: Five low-blue-light palettes—Warm Paper, Old Book, Tea Brown, Quiet Olive, and Mist Blue—override DSH semantic tokens with hot switching, no layout changes, and clean restoration on uninstall. It supports light/dark themes on macOS and Windows; only colors and material tokens change, while native layout stays intact. Preferences use localStorage rather than the Host Settings API, and the package requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Web/桌面端的动画鲸鱼桌宠，按会话与连接状态切换待机、休眠、思考、工作、查找、执行命令、验证、等待、成功和错误等动作，并支持拖动、摸头、戳一戳和碰尾巴。可在设置中调大小、气泡和动效，右下角鲸鱼按钮可即时启停；固定支持 Windows 10/11 x64，插件不读取密钥、不截图、不发遥测，也不新增监听端口。
description.en: An animated whale companion for the DSH Web/desktop UI that switches among idle, sleeping, thinking, working, searching, commanding, testing, waiting, success, and error states from session and connection activity. It supports dragging, head pats, pokes, and tail touches; size, bubbles, and motion are configurable, and the bottom-right whale button toggles it. The packaged helper targets Windows 10/11 x64; it reads no keys, captures no screenshots, sends no telemetry, and opens no extra listening port.

description.zh: 可在原版蓝鲸与“鲸鱼娘 · 抱饭碗”之间切换的余额桌宠：点击后从官方 `/user/balance` 读取可用、充值和赠送余额，按币种展示并默认每 15 秒刷新；支持拖动、键盘操作、减少动态效果和失败保留上次结果。v1.4 增加按 API Key 分开的 7 日观测、余额增减、低余额与完成提醒、主题预设和最近历史，但不估算可核验的逐轮费用，也不能把余额下降归因到当前会话；余额查询在 Host 端读取已配置凭据并仅请求官方余额接口，凭据不保存在插件文件。
description.en: A balance pet that switches between the original DeepSeek whale and Whale Girl · Holding a Rice Bowl. Clicking it reads available, topped-up, and bonus balances from the official `/user/balance` endpoint, separates currencies, and refreshes every 15 seconds by default; it supports dragging, keyboard controls, reduced motion, and retaining the last result after a failed refresh. v1.4 adds per-API-key seven-day observations, balance increases/decreases, low-balance and completion reminders, and theme presets, but it does not estimate verifiable per-turn cost or attribute a balance drop to the current session. The balance check reads a configured Host-side credential and requests only the official balance service; the credential is not stored in the plugin files.

description.zh: 柔和的樱色午后视觉小说风格皮肤，为 DSH Web 的浅色与深色模式分别叠加粉彩配色，并加入 18 片半透明飘落花瓣与边缘柔光晕。会话头部提供花瓣开关，设置 → General 提供整套皮肤总开关；两项状态保存在 `localStorage`，停用或卸载会清理皮肤层并恢复默认外观。
description.en: A soft visual-novel skin with pastel palettes for both DSH Web light and dark modes, plus an overlay of 18 translucent falling petals and a faint edge vignette. The session header includes a petal toggle, while Settings → General adds a master switch; both persist in `localStorage`, and disabling or uninstalling removes the skin layers and restores the default appearance.

description.zh: 页面角落的 Q 版战地医护桌宠，按每轮页面观察到的输入/输出 token 播报用量，并按实际使用天数从新兵成长到医护队长。它还提供本机统计、7/30 天趋势、每日任务、13 枚勋章、久坐/喝水提醒、四套换装和可拖拽吸边；数据只存浏览器 `localStorage`，不联网、不读凭据、不查余额或显示金额。统计仅覆盖页面打开期间观察到的用量，提醒依赖前台标签页。
description.en: A chibi field-medic pet that sits in the page corner, reports input/output token usage observed after each turn, and grows from recruit to medic captain by actual days of use. It also provides local totals, 7/30-day trends, daily goals, 13 badges, sit/water reminders, four outfit themes, and drag-to-edge positioning. Data stays in browser `localStorage`: it makes no network requests, reads no credentials, checks no balance, and shows no money; statistics cover only usage observed while the page is open, and reminders depend on a foreground tab.

description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面的透明置顶奶龙桌宠，随 DeepSeek Harness 启动并提供 13 组动作、定时自动表演和点击展开的动作面板。动作来自 74 帧精灵图集，不重绘或凭空生成；Windows 安装器在必要时会准备 Electron，安装后需要重启 Harness。
description.en: A transparent, always-on-top Nailong desktop pet for Windows that starts with DeepSeek Harness, offers 13 action groups, scheduled performances, and a click-open action panel. Its animations use a 74-frame sprite sheet rather than newly drawn or invented frames; the Windows installer may prepare Electron when needed, and installation requires restarting Harness.

name.zh: 光污染 RGB 流光皮肤

description.zh: 独立的 RGB 光效层，可单独使用，也可作为 `dsh-angelsanddemon-fatesumphony-skin` 的伴生层；为输入框、侧栏、会话头部、Hero 标题和新会话按钮添加 CSS/WebGL 辉光。待机和聚焦为蓝色，智能体运行时环绕变色，会话自然完成时变绿（主动点击停止不会触发）；WebGL2 不可用时回退到 WebGL1/CSS，并遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: An independent RGB glow layer that can run alone or accompany `dsh-angelsanddemon-fatesumphony-skin`, adding CSS/WebGL light around the composer, sidebar, session header, hero title, and new-session button. Idle and focused states glow blue, agent activity cycles through RGB, and a naturally completed session turns green; clicking Stop does not trigger the green state. WebGL2 falls back to WebGL1/CSS, and `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.

description.zh: 泡泡猫蓝白玻璃拟态主题，提供「淡雅」与「蓝色」两种风格，并可在云母卡片模式与兼容模式之间切换。可选 WebGL2 流体背景或图片/视频壁纸，调节模糊、磨砂、亮度、装饰与中英文字体；猫爪、小鱼、泡泡和星光装饰均可控制。当前 `0.3.4` 已移除背景音乐播放器、上传入口及内置曲目，目标 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。
description.en: A blue-and-white glassmorphism theme with PaoPao Cat styling, two looks—Elegant and Blue—and a choice between Mica-card and compatibility modes. Choose a WebGL2 fluid background or an image/video wallpaper, then tune blur, frosting, brightness, decorations, and Chinese/English fonts. Cat paws, fish, bubbles, and starlight are configurable. Version `0.3.4` removed the background-music player, upload flow, and bundled tracks; it targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`.

description.zh: 「海盐晨雾」与「潮汐夜航」两套海岸线配色主题：浅色使用暖象牙沙、海玻璃青与浮木墨色，深色使用深蓝绿、月光海玻璃与暖铜状态点。主题只通过官方 `ThemeRuntime` 的 107 个 `--dsw-alias-*` token 覆盖，跟随 DSH 的浅色/深色/跟随系统设置，不注入壁纸、不改布局、不写设置；禁用或热重载会撤回覆盖层。需要 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 及以上。
description.en: A coastal palette with two scenes: Salt & Timber for light mode, using warm ivory sand, sea-glass teal, and driftwood ink; and Twilight Cove for dark mode, using deep blue-green, moonlit sea glass, and warm copper status points. It only overrides the official `ThemeRuntime` layer across 107 `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, follows DSH Light/Dark/Follow System appearance, and adds no wallpaper, layout changes, or settings writes. Disabling or hot-reloading retracts the layer; DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer is required.

description.zh: 以爱心开关解锁的七夕互动彩蛋合集：粉/玫瑰主题、祝福横幅、Canvas 爱心与星光背景，输入 `520` 触发 10 条告白弹幕，输入 `情书` 或 `loveletter` 从 100 句文案库生成可改写、收藏和换句的情书。还能把情书绘制成 1080×1440 分享卡片，提供 5 套配色并支持下载/复制；必须先开启氛围换肤，暗号才会生效。
description.en: A Qixi interaction bundle unlocked by a heart toggle: pink/rose styling, a blessing banner, and a Canvas background of floating hearts and starlight. Enter `520` for 10 confession lines, or `情书`/`loveletter` for a rewriteable, savable love letter drawn from a 100-line library. Love letters can become 1080×1440 share cards in five color sets for download or copying; the theme must be enabled before either code works.

description.zh: 简洁的 DSH 背景插件，支持在设置中选择本地或网络图片/视频并调节透明度。它以独立 bundle 提供背景设置行，安装后在下一次进程启动时生效；与已包含 `ui-background` 行的宿主构建同时安装会因重复 loader id 冲突。
description.en: A focused DSH background plugin for choosing a local or online image/video and adjusting its opacity from settings. It installs as a standalone bundle with a background settings row and takes effect on the next process boot; installing it on a host build that already contains a `ui-background` row causes a duplicate-loader-id conflict.

description.zh: 把自有照片变成 DSH Web GUI 皮肤：支持文件选择、拖放或粘贴导入 PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF（单张 ≤25MB），自动提取主色作为强调色，并提供 `cover/contain`、0–100px 模糊、0–100% 压暗和分区渲染控制。照片保存在 `<DSH_HOME>/photo-skins/`，不上传或分享；同一插件还内置 Web-Reach 工具 `web_search`、`web_fetch` 与 `rss_fetch`，启用后查询和网址会发往选定的第三方服务。
description.en: Turn your own photos into DSH Web GUI skins by importing PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF files through a picker, drag-and-drop, or paste, with a 25 MB limit per image. The plugin extracts a dominant accent color and provides `cover/contain`, 0–100px blur, 0–100% dimming, and split rendering controls. Photos stay under `<DSH_HOME>/photo-skins/` and are not uploaded or shared; the same plugin also bundles Web-Reach tools—`web_search`, `web_fetch`, and `rss_fetch`—which send queries or URLs to selected third-party services when enabled.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面改成 Minecraft 像素风：21 种方块纹理可切换并可导入/管理自定义纹理，支持纹理尺寸、像素字体、灰色浮雕按钮、漂浮方块粒子和点击音效。还内置 16 首 Minecraft 原声与本地音乐文件夹播放器；本地音乐和纹理不上传，插件为非官方作品且与 Mojang 无关。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web interface into a Minecraft-inspired pixel workspace with 21 switchable block textures, custom texture import/management, adjustable texture size, pixel fonts, embossed gray buttons, floating block particles, and click sounds. It also includes 16 Minecraft tracks and a local-folder music player; local textures and music are not uploaded, and the plugin is unofficial and unaffiliated with Mojang.

description.zh: 以奥黛塔 / 至冬为主题的 DSH Web 深色皮肤，包含冬季背景、雪花/芭蕾舞鞋鼠标样式、Agent 思考时的奥黛塔 Q 版芭蕾舞者旋转动画、冰蓝配色与标签页图标。安装后自动启用 `odette` 深色主题，无需手动切换；需要重启 `dsh web` 才能加载。
description.en: An Odette/Snezhnaya dark skin for DSH Web with winter backgrounds, a snowflake-and-ballet-shoe cursor, an Odette chibi ballerina spinner while the agent is thinking, an ice-blue palette, and a custom tab icon. Installing it automatically enables the `odette` dark theme; no manual switch is needed, but `dsh web` must be restarted to load it.

description.zh: 绿色黑底的 DSH 黑客终端外观，包含仅由 `A-Z`、`0-9` 和终端符号组成的字符雨、玻璃输入框、HUD 状态栏、扫描效果，以及 Share Tech Mono / JetBrains Mono 字体（中文回退苹方）。支持系统减少动态效果；不发送统计或网络请求，卸载会清理样式、DOM、监听器、观察器和定时器。面向当前 DSH Web UI 布局，开发者预览版升级后可能需要适配。
description.en: A green-on-black hacker-terminal treatment for DSH with matrix rain made only from `A-Z`, `0-9`, and terminal symbols, plus a glass composer, HUD bars, scan effects, and Share Tech Mono/JetBrains Mono fonts with PingFang SC fallback for Chinese. It supports system reduced-motion preferences, sends no analytics or network requests, and removes its styles, DOM, listeners, observers, and timers on unload. It targets the current DSH Web UI layout, so developer-preview upgrades may require compatibility updates.

description.zh: 弗糯糯（nuonuo）客户端皮肤，为侧栏、中区、输入卡、主页标题与聊天区套用透明玻璃风格，并在中区循环播放静音视频壁纸。公开仓库是无素材骨架：不包含作者的私人壁纸和图标，安装后需要提供自己的素材；缺失时回退为空视频或透明占位，目标 Harness `0.1.0-rc.5`。
description.en: A nuonuo/Luvian client skin that applies a transparent-glass treatment to the sidebar, center column, composer card, home title, and chat area, with a looping muted video wallpaper in the center. The public repository is intentionally a no-asset skeleton: the author's private wallpapers and icons are not included, so you must provide your own; missing media falls back to an empty video or transparent placeholder. It targets Harness `0.1.0-rc.5`.

description.zh: 可在 DSH Web 中上传本地 JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF 或粘贴 `http(s)` 图片 URL，实时调节图片不透明度、主题自适应遮罩、面板透明度、毛玻璃模糊、壁纸模糊和 `cover/contain` 填充。还提供可开关的会话时间线轨道，支持按会话书签与点击跳转；设置持久化到 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`，清除或卸载可恢复默认外观。
description.en: Upload a local JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF or paste an `http(s)` image URL into DSH Web, then tune image opacity, a theme-aware readability scrim, panel opacity, glass blur, wallpaper blur, and `cover/contain` fit. It also adds an optional conversation timeline rail with per-session bookmarks and click-to-jump navigation. Settings persist in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, and clearing or uninstalling restores the default appearance.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 使用历史整理成日、7 天、月、年四种视图：年度热力图、工作区/会话时间线、按任务合并的日视图 Gantt 轴，以及可拖拽的主界面统计卡片。支持点击时间段直达实际会话，并展示活跃时长、会话数、轮次、工具调用和 token；provider 上报时 token 精确，否则为启发式估算。
description.en: Organizes DeepSeek usage history into Day, 7-day, Month, and Year views: a yearly heatmap, workspace/session timelines, a task-merged daily Gantt axis, and draggable main-interface statistic cards. Click a time segment to open the actual conversation, and inspect active time, sessions, turns, tool calls, and tokens; token accounting is exact when the provider reports usage and heuristic otherwise.

name.zh: DSH 毛玻璃 UI 皮肤

description.zh: 在 DSH UI 下方放置图片或视频背景，并让包含侧栏在内的界面表面透出可调毛玻璃；支持拖动裁剪、缩放、历史皮肤记录和可拖动悬浮快捷面板。自定义素材可来自网络 URL 或本地文件，图片压缩后存 `localStorage`、视频存 IndexedDB；插件本身不发外部网络请求，视频在 `prefers-reduced-motion` 下暂停。聊天框还可调用 `skin_list` 查看皮肤清单。
description.en: Places an image or video behind the DSH UI and makes surfaces—including the sidebar—translucent so the adjustable frosted-glass treatment shows through. It supports drag-to-crop and zoom, skin history, and a draggable floating shortcut panel; custom media can come from a URL or local file, with compressed images in `localStorage` and videos in IndexedDB. The plugin itself makes no external network requests, pauses video under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and exposes a read-only `skin_list` tool for the catalog.

description.zh: SIDOR 星野控制台皮肤，包含开屏粒子动画（含 1/50 红色太阳风暴彩蛋）、可跟随鼠标或固定方向的常驻星野、SIDOR 品牌徽记、侧栏余额徽章、设置页星光效果、低余额四重红色警告和输入框拉伸手柄。还向设置 → 插件列表加入关闭/启用/卸载与红色流光二次确认；输入框按钮区保持官方原版，仅保留拉伸手柄。
description.en: The SIDOR Starfield Console Skin adds an intro particle animation with a 1-in-50 red solar-storm easter egg, a persistent starfield that can follow the pointer or use a fixed direction, SIDOR branding, a sidebar balance badge, star effects and a dark base in Settings, four red low-balance warnings, and a composer resize handle. It also adds close/enable/uninstall actions with a red flowing-light confirmation to the Settings → Plugins list; the composer button area stays official, with only the resize handle added.

description.zh: Doro 粉丝向展示皮肤：全屏背景、自动避让侧栏与聊天文字的左右下角立绘、粉橙主题色和自定义 favicon；Agent 回合完成时播放 Doro 提示音，也可换成本地 `chime.mp3`。插件不注册服务、不触达模型请求，支持热切换；仓库是个人/非商用作品，公开包的素材说明要求使用或替换自己的 Doro 美术资源。
description.en: A presentation-only Doro fan skin with a full-screen background, pink-and-orange accents, a custom favicon, and lower-corner character art that adapts around the sidebar and chat text. It plays a Doro completion chime after an agent turn and can use a local `chime.mp3`; it registers no service and does not touch model requests. The repository is a personal, non-commercial fan work, and its asset notes require using or replacing the Doro artwork yourself.

description.zh: Material Design 3 毛玻璃主题，为侧栏、顶栏、输入卡、聊天、设置面板和菜单提供半透明表面与 10px `backdrop-filter` 模糊，并支持本地图片或 HTTP/HTTPS 壁纸、裁切方式、位置和可读性遮罩。壁纸默认关闭，图片存浏览器 IndexedDB、偏好存 `localStorage`，不会上传到 DSH 服务；主题跟随 DSH 的浅色/深色外观。
description.en: A Material Design 3 glassmorphism layer for DSH, applying translucent surfaces and 10px `backdrop-filter` blur to the sidebar, top bar, composer, chat, settings, and menus. It supports local images or HTTP/HTTPS wallpapers with fill mode, position, and readability-overlay controls. Wallpapers are off by default, images stay in browser IndexedDB, preferences use `localStorage`, and nothing is uploaded to DSH services; the palette follows DSH light/dark appearance.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 装扮成 macOS 桌面：毛玻璃菜单栏、实时钟、红黄绿窗口按钮、底部 Dock 与悬停放大，并自动跟随系统明暗主题。按 `⌘L` 或 Dock 日志图标可查看浏览器错误、Cordis 客户端加载失败以及 `~/.dsh/logs/web.log` / `install.log`，支持级别过滤、自动滚动、清空和导出 `.log`；服务端日志需要由启动命令用 `tee` 写入对应文件。
description.en: Turns DSH Web into a macOS-style desktop with a frosted menu bar and live clock, red/yellow/green window controls, a bottom Dock with hover magnification, and automatic system light/dark following. Press `⌘L` or the Dock log icon to inspect browser errors, Cordis client-load failures, and `~/.dsh/logs/web.log`/`install.log`, with level filtering, auto-scroll, clearing, and `.log` export; server-side entries appear only when the launch command writes those files with `tee`.

description.zh: 在设置 → Wallpaper 中上传本地图片、裁切并设为 DSH Web 工作台背景；支持拖动/八向手柄裁切、可选导出模糊、`cover/contain/center/stretch` 填充，以及面板不透明度和遮罩调节，修改即时生效并跨刷新恢复。浏览器端裁切压缩为 WebP（最长边 ≤2560px），写入仅信任 localhost/loopback，配置存 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`。
description.en: Upload a local image from Settings → Wallpaper, crop it, and apply it as the DSH Web workspace background. It supports drag and eight-handle cropping, optional export blur, `cover/contain/center/stretch` fit modes, panel opacity, and overlay dimming, with immediate application and refresh persistence. The browser crops and compresses to WebP with a longest edge of ≤2560px; writes trust only localhost/loopback, and configuration lives in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 变成纸笔风格的 Cornell 笔记工作区：保留原生对话和轨迹视图，在会话旁加入可折叠 Cornell Brief，用于记录重点、关键词、状态和下一步，并为每个会话提供支持多行编辑的 `MY NOTE` 任务清单。笔记只存浏览器 `localStorage`，不会上传或改写对话；仅显示在对话页，视口小于约 1100px 时自动隐藏。
description.en: Turns DSH Web into a paper-notebook workspace while keeping native conversation and trajectory views. A collapsible Cornell Brief records focus, keywords, state, and next action beside the conversation, and each conversation gets a multiline `MY NOTE` task list with collapsible completed items. Notes stay in browser `localStorage`, are not uploaded or written into DSH messages, appear on conversation pages only, and hide below an approximately 1100px viewport.

description.zh: Zaimokuza 动态壁纸主题库内置「黑烟」「游侠客」「上官婉儿」「水墨侠客」「正是修行时」五套主题：图片场景以轻量 Three.js 动画重建，水墨侠客使用 1080p 循环视频，其余主题带开屏与淡入背景。可在「通用设置 → Zaimokuza主题」切换并实时调节背景透明度，支持明暗玻璃 token、页面隐藏暂停与 `prefers-reduced-motion`；素材来自 Wallpaper Engine。
description.en: Zaimokuza is an animated-wallpaper theme library with five built-ins: Black Smoke, Wandering Swordswoman, Shangguan Wan'er, Ink Swordsman, and Cultivation Time. Image-based Wallpaper Engine scenes are rebuilt as lightweight Three.js animations; Ink Swordsman uses a 1080p looping video, while the others include an intro and fade into the background. Switch themes and tune background opacity in General Settings → Zaimokuza Theme; light/dark glass tokens, hidden-page pausing, and `prefers-reduced-motion` are supported.

description.zh: 以 WebGL 实时光线追踪的史瓦西黑洞为背景，渲染引力透镜、吸积盘与光子环，并以深空玻璃面板和吸积盘琥珀强调色覆盖 DSH Web。插件加载即启用，没有设置开关；半分辨率、30fps、`prefers-reduced-motion` 和 WebGL 不可用时的纯黑深空回退用于控制性能，禁用或卸载会恢复原主题。仅适用于含 webServer 的 profile，要求 dsh ≥ `0.1.0-rc.7`。
description.en: A WebGL real-time ray-traced Schwarzschild black hole forms the background, with gravitational lensing, an accretion disk, and a photon ring beneath deep-space glass panels and accretion-disk amber accents. The theme is enabled on load with no settings toggle. Half-resolution rendering, a 30fps cap, `prefers-reduced-motion`, and a pure-black fallback when WebGL is unavailable keep it graceful; disabling or uninstalling restores the original theme. It requires a webServer profile and dsh ≥ `0.1.0-rc.7`.

description.zh: 可切换图片背景的 DSH 皮肤插件，内置 `aurora-dawn`、`dusk-drift`、`ocean-mist` 与 `midnight-bloom` 四张渐变壁纸，也支持从 `~/.dsh/skin-center/wallpapers` 读取自有图片或输入任意 `http(s)` 图片链接。设置 → 皮肤提供启用、压暗（0–90%）和模糊（0–24px）控件，面板会随明暗模式变为半透明毛玻璃；设置写入 `skin-background` 命名空间并拒绝 `javascript:` 等非法图片引用。
description.en: A DSH skin plugin with four built-in gradient wallpapers—`aurora-dawn`, `dusk-drift`, `ocean-mist`, and `midnight-bloom`—plus user images from `~/.dsh/skin-center/wallpapers` or any `http(s)` image URL. Settings → Skin provides enable, dimming (0–90%), and blur (0–24px) controls; surfaces become translucent glass in light and dark modes. Preferences persist in the `skin-background` namespace, with validation that rejects `javascript:` and other invalid image references.

description.zh: 《犹格索托斯的庭院》特莉波卡（Tlipoca）GAL 视觉小说皮肤，以深紫与鎏金哥特界面、琉璃金饰对话框和 Cinzel / ZCOOL XiaoWei / Noto Serif SC 字体打造沉浸式阅读场景。内置 7 套表情差分，会随情感标签、文件/终端/`web_search` 工具状态切换；还提供任务横条详情、3 个场景、可持久化自定义背景和对话历史抽屉。
description.en: A Tlipoca GAL visual-novel skin inspired by Yog-Sothoth's Yard, with a dark-purple and gold gothic interface, jeweled glass dialogue boxes, and Cinzel, ZCOOL XiaoWei, and Noto Serif SC typography. Seven character-expression variants react to emotion labels and file, terminal, or `web_search` tool states. It also adds detailed task bars, three scenes, a locally persistent custom background, and a conversation-history drawer.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 和 Web UI 的非官方马里奥风像素皮肤，替换背景、标题栏、侧栏、输入区、设置页和常用控件，并覆盖任务看板、SSH、文件树、Trajectory 与 Todo 的视觉层。支持字体缩放、0–16px 背景模糊和亮暗主题，同时保持会话、模型、权限与工具行为不变；当前适配 DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`，Node.js 要求 `>=22.19.0`。
description.en: An unofficial Mario-inspired pixel skin for DSH Desktop and Web UI, restyling the background, title bar, sidebar, composer, settings, and common controls, including the task board, SSH, file tree, Trajectory, and Todo surfaces. It supports font scaling, 0–16px background blur, and light/dark themes while leaving sessions, models, permissions, and tool behavior unchanged. The documented target is DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` with Node.js `>=22.19.0`.

description.zh: 独立于宿主源码的 DSH 皮肤中心，提供 35 套内置皮肤（21 套 ACG/角色主题与 14 套开发者经典配色）、一张图自动取色的自定义皮肤，以及 JSON 皮肤包导入/导出。选择持久化在 `~/.dsh/skins/selection.json`，支持多标签实时同步、首屏无闪屏和保留 DSH 原生浅色/深色/跟随系统外观；项目是社区插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方插件。
description.en: An out-of-tree DSH skin center with 35 built-in skins—21 ACG/character themes plus 14 developer classics—alongside one-image auto-colored custom skins and JSON skin-package import/export. Selection persists in `~/.dsh/skins/selection.json`, with cross-tab synchronization, no first-paint flash, and the native DSH Light/Dark/Follow System appearance left intact. It is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek plugin.

description.zh: 《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂主题皮肤，以深红导航、婚纱白工作区和柔金骑士细节重绘侧栏、会话顶栏、聊天、输入区、轨迹、设置与终端等区域，并提供亮/暗场景、角色舞台缩放和减少动态效果适配。纯呈现层，不注册服务、不读写模型请求、不上传数据；已在 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` Web profile 测试，完整皮肤建议一次只启用一套。
description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi skin with deep-crimson navigation, a bridal-white workspace, and soft-gold knight details across the sidebar, conversation header, chat, composer, trace view, settings, and terminal surfaces. It provides separate light/dark scenes, a character stage that scales with conversation state, and narrow-window/reduced-motion handling. Presentation-only: it registers no service, reads or modifies no model requests, and uploads no data. It is documented against DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` Web and recommends enabling only one full skin at a time.

description.zh: 可调毛玻璃 UI 主题，保持 DSH 布局不变，提供 10%–95% 透明度与 4–40px 模糊滑块、自定义字体、图片/视频背景、多图轮播、遮罩、柔和动画和自定义 CSS。还集成网易云音乐播放器（扫码或 Cookie 登录、歌单/搜索/歌词、HTTP/SOCKS 代理或远程 API），配置可导入导出并保存到 `$DSH_HOME/data/glass-ui/config.json`；歌曲直链受版权/VIP 限制，导出配置只包含 URL，不含媒体文件。
description.en: An adjustable frosted-glass UI theme that keeps the DSH layout intact, with 10%–95% opacity and 4–40px blur sliders, custom fonts, image/video backgrounds, multi-image rotation, scrims, soft animation, and custom CSS. It also integrates a NetEase Cloud Music player with QR/Cookie login, playlists, search, lyrics, and HTTP/SOCKS or remote-API routing. Configuration can be imported/exported and is stored in `$DSH_HOME/data/glass-ui/config.json`; song URLs remain subject to copyright/VIP limits, and exports contain URL references rather than media files.

description.zh: 已废弃的 DSH Web 皮肤编辑器，仅支持 Web UI，不支持 `0.2.0` 及之后的桌面端。它可创建、预览、管理和分享 `.dshskin` v5 皮肤，编辑浅/深色配色、背景与组件媒体、品牌素材、双语固定文案、自由文本规则和字体，并通过 IndexedDB/localStorage/BroadcastChannel 持久化与同步；导入时会校验资源路径、MIME、大小和 SHA-256。
description.en: A deprecated DSH Web skin editor for Web UI only; it does not support Desktop from `0.2.0` onward. It can create, preview, manage, and share `.dshskin` v5 packages containing light/dark colors, backgrounds and component media, brand assets, bilingual fixed copy, free-text rules, and fonts. Skins persist through IndexedDB/localStorage and BroadcastChannel synchronization, while imports validate resource paths, MIME types, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.

description.zh: macOS 风格的明暗双主题，配套水中鲸鱼动态背景与点阵鲸鱼发送按钮；包含毛玻璃菜单、水母发光输入框、轨迹徽章和 Desktop 窗口适配。背景在失焦或隐藏时自动暂停，动画约 24fps，并响应 `prefers-reduced-motion` 与 `forced-colors`；支持 DSH Web 和 Desktop，但作者注明鲸鱼图形为 DeepSeek 官方资产，仅供个人主题美化、请勿商用。
description.en: A macOS-style light/dark skin with an underwater whale background and a dot-matrix whale send button. It also styles frosted menus, the glowing input field, trajectory badges, and the Desktop window shell; the background pauses when hidden or unfocused and the effects honor `prefers-reduced-motion` and `forced-colors` at about 24 fps. It supports DSH Web and Desktop; the author says the DeepSeek whale graphic is an official asset for personal theming only and not for commercial use.

description.zh: 提供内置配色与背景、图片导入和视频背景三种互斥模式；视频可按鼠标横向位置做 360° 环绕跟随，或循环播放。主题面板可调透明度并持久化设置，默认图片和视频不可删除；跟随 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时停帧，插件仅支持 DSH Web，安装后需重启生效。
description.en: Offers three mutually exclusive modes: built-in color and backdrop themes, imported images, and video backgrounds. Video can follow the mouse around a 360° orbit or loop as a background. The theme panel persists adjustable opacity settings, while the default image and video cannot be deleted; follow-mouse playback stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. The plugin targets DSH Web and requires a restart after installation.

description.zh: `Prompt Vault` 在输入框工具行加入 📚 按钮和提示词面板：可搜索、展开、创建、编辑、删除条目，并将整条提示词填入或追加到草稿。数据默认保存在 `~/.dsh/prompt-library.json`，可用 `DSH_PROMPT_VAULT_FILE` 覆盖；它是 DSH Web 插件，安装后需硬刷新，删除插件不会删除数据文件。
description.en: `Prompt Vault` adds a 📚 button and prompt library above the composer. Users can search, expand, create, edit, and delete entries, then insert a full prompt into the draft or append it to existing text. Data is stored at `~/.dsh/prompt-library.json` by default and can be redirected with `DSH_PROMPT_VAULT_FILE`; it is a DSH Web plugin, needs a hard refresh after installation, and leaves the data file in place when removed.

description.zh: 魈主题以青玉/翠青配色、吉祥物徽章和磨砂背景为默认，支持自定义主色、头像、背景、透明度、GIF/MP4/WebM/MOV/M4V 视频、背景轮播和主题导入导出；还可为工作会话注入仅改变语气的魈式提示，并提供独立的娱乐角色预设。角色预设默认不挂文件、命令或任务工具；自定义工作提示会原样加入每个会话，作者建议只写语气。当前版本建议 DSH `v0.1.5-alpha.1`+，更早版本应使用 `0.11.x`；可选的 `better-sidebar` 仅按 `0.19.x` 路线适配，旧版 `<=0.18` 不保证。魈/《原神》素材不随 MIT 代码许可，作者禁止未经授权的商用或再分发。
description.en: Xiao Theme starts with a jade/emerald palette, mascot badge, and frosted background, then lets users customize the accent, avatar, backgrounds, opacity, GIF/MP4/WebM/MOV/M4V video, background rotation, and theme import/export. It can add a tone-only Xiao-style prompt to work sessions and provides a separate entertainment roleplay preset. The roleplay preset mounts no file, command, or task tools by default; custom work prompts are inserted verbatim into every session, so the author recommends using tone instructions only. The current release targets DSH `v0.1.5-alpha.1` and newer, with `0.11.x` for older DSH; optional `better-sidebar` support follows the `0.19.x` path, while `<=0.18` is not adapted. Xiao/Genshin assets are not covered by the MIT code license and are not for unauthorized commercial use or redistribution.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的「设置 → 通用 → 背景图」中设置整页壁纸，可使用 URL、`data:image/...` 或本地图片，并调节面板不透明度（50–100%）和毛玻璃模糊（0–40px）。设置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，明暗主题自适应；固定版本只验证 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` web profile，且样式依赖构建期哈希类名，升级大版本可能需要更新选择器。
description.en: Adds a full-page wallpaper to DSH Web under Settings → General → Background Image. You can use a URL, a `data:image/...` value, or a local image, then tune panel opacity from 50–100% and blur from 0–40px. Settings persist in browser `localStorage` and adapt to light or dark themes; the pinned release was verified only with the DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` web profile, and its CSS targets build-time hashed classes that may need updates after a major DSH upgrade.

description.zh: Prism（棱镜）为 DSH Web 提供可调毛玻璃外观：清透、磨砂或毛绒材质，全局与六个区域的透明度，主题色/背景色，字体和字号，以及流光背景与按明暗模式轮播的图片/GIF 壁纸。设置保存在 `localStorage` 并支持跨标签同步，总开关可恢复原生界面；固定版本要求 DSH `0.1.2-alpha.1` 或更高的 Web profile。
description.en: Prism adds an adjustable glassmorphism layer to the DSH Web GUI: clear, frosted, or velvet materials; global and six-zone opacity controls; theme and backdrop colors; font and size controls; plus an aurora backdrop and light/dark wallpaper rotation for images or GIFs. Settings persist in `localStorage` and sync across tabs, while the master toggle restores the stock UI. The pinned release requires a DSH Web profile at `0.1.2-alpha.1` or later.

description.zh: GirlsBangCry 主题将 DSH Web 换成深海宫殿与黑粉蕾丝风格：右下角轮播 14 名成员立绘和群像底幕，左侧也可显示/切换立绘，并支持导入自定义背景与立绘。设置可调轮播间隔、背景压暗、模糊和主色，内置 Subaru GIF；浅色/深色背景随主题切换。仓库标注 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，角色立绘由使用者提供，公开再发布前需自行确认授权。
description.en: GirlsBangCry gives DSH Web an underwater-palace backdrop and pink-and-black lace styling. A lower-right stage rotates 14 character illustrations over a group backdrop; a second portrait can appear beside the composer, and custom portraits or backdrops can be imported. Settings cover rotation, dimming, blur, and accent color, with a bundled Subaru GIF and separate light/dark assets. The repository is marked CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, while the user-supplied character art requires an authorization check before redistribution.

description.zh: 真希波·UNIT-08 是面向 DSH Web 的非官方同人皮肤，以烟紫黑、玫红、荧光黄绿和暖象牙为主色，欢迎页展示角色与光学准星；进入对话后立绘会退让并降低透明度与饱和度。它覆盖明暗模式、设置、菜单、终端和消息等表面，支持窄屏与 `prefers-reduced-motion`，素材内嵌且运行时不依赖远程图片；作品与《新世纪福音战士》权利方无关联。
description.en: Mari Makinami · UNIT-08 is an unofficial DSH Web fan skin built around smoked plum, vivid magenta, acid green, and warm ivory. Full-height artwork and optical reticles appear on the welcome screen, then move aside and fade/desaturate during conversations. It covers light and dark treatments for settings, menus, terminal and message surfaces, supports narrow layouts and `prefers-reduced-motion`, and embeds its artwork without a remote runtime dependency. It is not affiliated with the Evangelion rights holders.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中提供可拖拽、可折叠、可隐藏的网易云音乐浮窗，支持单曲/歌单/专辑浏览、搜索、同步歌词与翻译、播放队列、扫码或 Cookie 登录，以及侧栏迷你模式。播放队列、进度、音量和播放模式保存在浏览器 `localStorage`；需要访问 `music.163.com`，部分歌曲受版权或会员限制，收藏功能也可能受网易云风控影响。登录 Cookie 只用于请求 `music.163.com`，不会发送给其他第三方。
description.en: Adds a draggable, collapsible, and hideable NetEase Cloud Music window to DSH Web, with song, playlist, and album browsing, search, synchronized lyrics and translations, a playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, and a sidebar mini-player. The queue, progress, volume, and playback mode are stored in browser `localStorage`. It needs access to `music.163.com`; some tracks are limited by copyright or membership, and favorites may be affected by NetEase risk controls. Login Cookies are used only for requests to `music.163.com`, not sent to other third parties.

description.zh: 护眼模式在 DSH Web「设置 → 常规 → 外观」下加入开关，以豆沙绿 `#CCE8CF` 为浅色基准，并为深色模式提供暖绿黑底；会重映射包括输入框、按钮、气泡、菜单和代码块在内的 89 个颜色 token。开关状态保存在 `localStorage`，覆盖浅色、深色和跟随系统；固定版本依赖 DSH 的主题/slot 接口，升级大版本后可能需要停用或更新插件。
description.en: Adds an Eye Care switch under DSH Web Settings → General → Appearance. The light palette is anchored to the bean-paste green `#CCE8CF`, while dark mode uses a warm green-black surface; 89 color tokens cover the composer, buttons, bubbles, menus, code blocks, and other UI layers. The switch persists in `localStorage` and works over light, dark, or system appearance. The pinned release depends on DSH theme/slot interfaces, so a major DSH upgrade may require disabling or updating the plugin.

description.zh: DSH Pixel UI 提供九套像素 RPG 风格主题：木屋、羊皮纸、暖阳、终端绿、全息、南瓜灯、便签本、云石和秘银；覆盖宿主 token、控件、滚动条和 SVG 光标，后五套素材主题使用内联 9-slice PNG。主题选择可在宿主文件与 `localStorage` 间持久化，支持 DSH Desktop，设为「现代默认」即可退出；目标兼容 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 至 `0.2.x`，并在 `prefers-reduced-motion` 下关闭动效。
description.en: DSH Pixel UI provides nine pixel-RPG themes: Wood Cabin, Parchment, Warm Sun, Terminal Green, Hologram, Pumpkin, Paper Note, Marble, and Mithril. It restyles host tokens, controls, scrollbars, and the SVG cursor; the latter five material themes use inlined 9-slice PNG assets. Theme selection persists in the host file with a `localStorage` mirror, supports DSH Desktop, and can be exited by choosing Modern Default. The target range is DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` through `0.2.x`, with motion disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

description.zh: 灯光剧场只改 DSH Web 的输入框：三层纯 CSS 动效让青/紫光束在内部扩散，青→蓝→紫的线段沿圆角边框巡游并呼吸；动画参数包括 24s 大周期、16s 绕行和 4s 变色循环。可在「设置 → 通用 → 输入框皮肤」开关，设置写入浏览器 `localStorage`；依赖支持 `@property` 的 Chromium（Chrome/Edge 105+），不影响 TUI 或其他前端。
description.en: Light Theater changes only the DSH Web composer. Three CSS-only layers spread cyan and purple beams inside the field while cyan-to-blue-to-purple segments travel and breathe around its rounded border; the documented timings include a 24s color cycle, a 16s lap, and a 4s segment-color loop. It can be toggled under Settings → General → Composer Skin and stores its settings in browser `localStorage`. It requires a Chromium engine with `@property` support, such as Chrome or Edge 105+, and does not affect TUI or other frontends.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的浏览器端 `codeRenderer` 服务：将 `ctx.syntaxHighlighter` 的结构化 token 转为经过转义、响应主题的 HTML 代码块，颜色跟随 DSH 的 `--shiki-*` CSS 变量，并保留 LF、CRLF 和 CR 换行。源码文本与 HTML 属性都会转义；它提供可复用服务，不自带页面、面板或 ChatView 前端。
description.en: A browser-side `codeRenderer` service for DSH Web plugins. It converts `ctx.syntaxHighlighter` tokens into escaped, theme-aware HTML code blocks, follows DSH `--shiki-*` CSS variables for color, and preserves LF, CRLF, and CR line endings. Source text and HTML attributes are escaped; the package provides a reusable service rather than a page, panel, or ChatView frontend.

description.zh: 顺顺壁纸为 DSH Web 提供全屏 GIF 壁纸与侧栏迷你播放器：壁纸支持主题融合遮罩和 0–100% 突出度，播放器支持从 B 站链接添加歌曲、歌单管理、音量/进度控制、单曲/列表/随机循环，并持久化设置与播放列表。仅支持 DSH Web；B 站音乐需联网，作者提醒分发时自行确认音乐版权。
description.en: Shunshun Wallpaper adds a full-screen GIF wallpaper and a sidebar mini-player to DSH Web. It provides a theme-aware veil and a 0–100% prominence slider, Bilibili-link music import, playlist management, volume and seek controls, single/list/shuffle repeat, and persisted settings and playlists. It requires DSH Web and network access for Bilibili audio; the author asks users to verify music rights before redistribution.

description.zh: 公社（Atom Commune）是静态的原子朋克/苏式宏伟建筑主题：对话区使用金色穹顶、红色星标、石柱与雕像的蓝天背景，界面采用玫瑰红主色，并以黄色锤镰与原子核点缀 favicon 和侧栏品牌位。背景图以 base64 内置于 `lib/client.js`，不依赖外部文件或网络；没有标语或音效动画。
description.en: Atom Commune is a static atompunk theme built around a Soviet monumental-building backdrop: blue sky, golden domes, red stars, columns, and statues. The UI uses rose red, with yellow hammer-and-sickle and atom accents in the favicon and sidebar brand area. The background is embedded as base64 in `lib/client.js`, so it needs no external file or network; there are no slogans, sound effects, or continuous animation.

description.zh: 粒子鲸鱼主题在 DSH Web 中以 WebGL2 重建 DeepSeek 官网 hero 鲸鱼：从 `hero-whale.svg` 采样点云，支持鼠标扭曲、光线跟随和入场组装，WebGL2 不可用时回退 2D canvas。它跟随 DSH 明/暗/系统外观，不改官方主题、没有设置按钮，默认开启；固定包声明仅面向 Web profile。
description.en: Particle Whale Theme recreates the DeepSeek website hero whale in DSH Web with WebGL2: it samples a point cloud from `hero-whale.svg` and adds pointer distortion, light following, and an eased assembly entrance, with a 2D canvas fallback when WebGL2 is unavailable. It follows DSH light, dark, or system appearance without changing the official theme, has no settings button, and is enabled by default. The fixed package targets the Web profile.

description.zh: Harness Whale Wallpaper 将约 1,750 个 WebGL2 粒子组成的点阵鲸鱼放在 DSH Web 应用框架下方，支持呼吸、缓慢转身、指针液态涡流和浅/深色主题。配置项含质量、亮度、比例、交互强度和运行时调暗；页面隐藏或 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时暂停，缺少 WebGL2 时回退静态 Canvas2D。固定版本目标为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2`，`shell.overlay` 或主题协议变化后需重新核验。
description.en: Harness Whale Wallpaper places an approximately 1,750-particle WebGL2 whale beneath the DSH Web app frame, with breathing, slow turning, a pointer-driven liquid vortex, and light/dark themes. Configuration covers quality, brightness, scale, interaction strength, and activity dimming; it pauses when the page is hidden or under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and falls back to a static Canvas2D whale without WebGL2. The pinned release targets `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2`, so changes to `shell.overlay` or the theme protocol require a compatibility review.

description.zh: DSH Enhanced 是一套综合插件：提供带自动回退的多引擎 `web_search`、`web_fetch`、技能与 MCP 管理、按 profile 的插件开关、受保护的会话移入系统废纸篓、自动压缩调节、重启/关机控制，以及 Matrix/Cyberpunk 主题。它把界面操作与 `manage_skills_mcps` 模型工具接到同一套处理器；无遥测，凭据按权限保存且不会回显，搜索和用户主动的 URL 抓取才会访问外部服务。
description.en: DSH Enhanced is a multi-purpose plugin with fallback-based multi-engine `web_search`, `web_fetch`, skill and MCP management, per-profile plugin toggles, guarded moves of sessions to the system trash, auto-compact tuning, restart/shutdown controls, and Matrix/Cyberpunk themes. Its UI and the `manage_skills_mcps` model tool share the same action handlers. It has no telemetry; credentials are permission-protected and never echoed, while external access is limited to searches and user-requested URL fetching.

description.zh: 墨韵（MoYun）提供五套原创水墨主题：远山孤松、烟雨江南、竹影清风、梅傲霜雪和山水留白；可叠加 PNG/JPG 自定义壁纸，调节模糊、透明度与墨点、雨珠、微光粒子密度。主题基于 DSH `--dsw-*` token，设置和壁纸存入 IndexedDB，支持 8 种语言并可一键还原为 DSH 内置外观。
description.en: MoYun provides five original ink-wash themes: Lonely Pine in the Far Mountains, Misty Jiangnan, Bamboo and Clear Wind, Plum Against Frost and Snow, and Blank Landscape. Users can add PNG/JPG wallpapers and tune blur, opacity, and the density of ink-dot, raindrop, and glint particles. The themes use DSH `--dsw-*` tokens, store settings and wallpapers in IndexedDB, support eight languages, and can be reset to the built-in DSH appearance.

description.zh: Codex Theme 将 `codex-theme-v1` 的 80 套预设（浅色 26、深色 54）映射到 DSH `--dsw-*` token，可在插件面板切换浅色、深色或跟随系统，并分别记忆两种配色的选择。还可独立设置 UI 与代码字体/字号，字体下拉只列本机已安装字体；设置保存到 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`，支持 macOS 与 Windows 的 DSH Web。
description.en: Codex Theme maps 80 `codex-theme-v1` presets—26 light and 54 dark—onto DSH `--dsw-*` tokens. Its panel switches between Light, Dark, and Follow system and remembers selections per scheme. It also sets UI and code fonts and sizes independently, listing only fonts installed on the machine; settings are stored in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, and the DSH Web client is supported on macOS and Windows.

description.zh: Theme Tuner 把强调色、背景、前景、对比度和渐变度调节放到 DSH Web「通用设置 → 外观」下方，复用原生浅色、深色和跟随系统切换。改动通过 `theme.overrideTokens` 实时写入 `--dsw-alias-*`，浅色和深色分别保存，可一键恢复当前主题默认；同一产物兼容 DSH `0.2.x` 的 Config 表单与 `<=0.1.x` 的 settingsScope。
description.en: Theme Tuner places accent, background, foreground, contrast, and gradient controls below DSH Web Settings → General → Appearance, reusing the native Light, Dark, and Follow system switch. Changes are applied live through `theme.overrideTokens` to `--dsw-alias-*`; light and dark settings are stored separately, with a one-click reset to the active theme default. The same build supports the DSH `0.2.x` Config form and the `<=0.1.x` `settingsScope` model.

description.zh: Veneer 是可视化换肤编辑器：从侧栏「编辑」面板调整 12 个背景面、图片裁切与透明度、字体、文字颜色、圆角/边框/阴影，并提供 8 套模板、JSON 导入/导出和基于 Harness 模型的 AI 主题生成。主题优先保存到 DSH Host Settings，并以浏览器 `localStorage` 作兼容快照；跨机器导入时图片引用可能失效，AI 生成功能仍取决于模型、凭据和网络可用性。
description.en: Veneer is a visual reskin editor. Its sidebar editor adjusts 12 background surfaces, image cropping and opacity, fonts, text colors, corner radii, borders, and shadows; it also includes eight templates, JSON import/export, and AI theme generation through the Harness model runtime. Themes are stored primarily in DSH Host Settings with a browser `localStorage` compatibility snapshot. Imported image references may fail across machines, and AI generation depends on model, credential, and network availability.

description.zh: Claude Style 以 Anthropic 暖调编辑风为灵感，提供暖象牙 `#FAF9F5` / 暖黑 `#141413` 双画布、陶烬橙 `#D97757` 强调色、衬线标题、无衬线界面、等宽标签、发丝线边框与胶囊 CTA，并为 Markdown 提供编辑部式排版。跟随 DSH 原生明暗主题；同一时间只能启用一个皮肤。
description.en: Claude Style takes inspiration from Anthropic’s warm editorial look, with an ivory `#FAF9F5` / warm-black `#141413` canvas, a clay-ember `#D97757` accent, serif headlines, sans-serif UI, monospaced labels, hairline borders, pill CTAs, and editorial Markdown styling. It follows the native DSH light/dark theme, and only one skin can be active at a time.

description.zh: Hiyuki Frost Sakura（绯雪霜樱）为 DSH Web 提供常态/战斗态两套本地背景与霜樱玻璃材质：当前可见会话首次调用工具时切入战斗态，任务结束、停止或失败后恢复常态，也可手动锁定形态。设置可调视觉强度、输入框透明度（0–90%）和动态效果，支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，不代理会话操作或调用删除/归档等会话管理 API；固定版本列出 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`、`0.1.0-rc.7` 和 `0.1.1-rc.2` 兼容/验证范围，后续客户端钩子变化仍需重新适配。
description.en: Hiyuki Frost Sakura gives DSH Web two local backgrounds and a frost-sakura glass treatment: the visible session enters Combat when its agent makes the first tool call, then returns to Calm after completion, stop, or failure; either form can also be locked manually. Settings cover visual intensity, composer opacity from 0–90%, and motion effects, with `prefers-reduced-motion` support. It does not proxy session operations or call session-management APIs. The pinned documentation lists DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`, `0.1.0-rc.7`, and `0.1.1-rc.2` in its compatibility/verification range; later client-hook changes may require adaptation.

description.zh: Gandalf 主题为 DSH Web 加入中土风视觉：甘道夫背景图、霞鹭文楷等宽字体、羊皮纸色调和定制控件；浅色使用半透明面板，深色保留 DSH 深色实色表面并透出背景，消息流和发送按钮也有专属样式。字体需要先在本机安装，未安装时回退系统字体；霞鹭文楷按 OFL 1.1 分发，插件主要覆盖视觉层，卸载可恢复默认外观。
description.en: Gandalf Theme brings a Middle-earth look to DSH Web with a Gandalf backdrop, Lxgw WenKai monospaced type, parchment tones, and customized controls. Light mode uses translucent panels; dark mode keeps solid DSH dark surfaces while letting the backdrop show through, with additional styling for the message stream and send button. The font must be installed locally and falls back to the system font otherwise; Lxgw WenKai is distributed under OFL 1.1, and the plugin restores the default appearance when removed.

description.zh: Gemini 风格主题只通过一张叠加在 `--dsw-*` token 上的样式表改变 DSH Web 外观，覆盖对话区/侧栏、胶囊行、按钮、新建会话、欢迎页、输入框和滚动渐隐，并同时适配明暗主题。它不新增 DOM、插槽或服务，卸载可恢复原生界面；会话头部、欢迎语轮换、侧栏启动状态和生成中的顶部进度条保持 DSH 原样。
description.en: Gemini-Style Theme changes the DSH Web client through one stylesheet layered over its `--dsw-*` tokens. It restyles the conversation ground and sidebar, capsule rows, buttons, new-chat pill, hero greeting, composer, and scroll fades in both light and dark modes. It adds no DOM, slot occupant, or service and restores the stock appearance when removed; the session header, rotating greeting, sidebar boot posture, and top progress bar during turns remain unchanged.

description.zh: E-Ink Retro 以纸面、近黑文字、硬边偏移阴影和黑白选中态重塑 DSH 客户端，提供 Balanced、Immersive 和 Off 三种模式；Immersive 只将已适配的表面与 token 映射为灰阶，图片、视频、Canvas 和 iframe 内容保持原样。主题跟随页面中英界面语言，遇到其他第三方主题会暂停；固定版本兼容 DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` 与 `0.2.0-rc.2`，不声明完整 WCAG 认证，硬编码颜色或 Shadow DOM 组件只能部分继承。
description.en: E-Ink Retro reshapes the DSH client with paper surfaces, near-black type, hard offset shadows, and black-and-white selection states. It offers Balanced, Immersive, and Off modes; Immersive maps only supported surfaces and tokens to grayscale, while images, video, Canvas output, and iframe content remain unchanged. The theme follows English or Simplified Chinese page language and pauses when another third-party theme is selected. The pinned release lists DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` and `0.2.0-rc.2` as compatible, does not claim full WCAG certification, and can only partially theme hard-coded-color or Shadow DOM components.

description.zh: Argentina · Messi 皮肤使用 celeste/navy/gold 色板，按明暗模式分别覆盖主题 token，并在侧栏与主区放置金色和 Messi 照片背景；页面还会显示不拦截点击的漫游 #10 徽章和缓慢旋转金环。它是纯前端、无配置插件，依赖当前 GUI 的左右栏结构；结构变化时会退化为仅保留配色主题。
description.en: Argentina · Messi uses a celeste/navy/gold palette with separate light and dark token overrides, gold and Messi photo backdrops for the sidebar and main area, a roaming non-interactive #10 badge, and a slowly rotating gold ring. It is a front-end-only, configuration-free plugin that relies on the current GUI’s left/right column structure; if that structure changes, it degrades to the color theme alone.

description.zh: 稻妻雷电工房是 DSH Web 的非官方雷电将军同人主题：浅色切换樱花花房，深色切换雷暴舞台，配套紫金亚克力对话框、Q 版侧栏图标与可选工作区动图。设置可调透明度、立绘透明度和动效，支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，还可单独启用「Raiden 雷电将军」Agent 预设；主题默认关闭，仅支持 Web，固定文档要求 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`+，角色素材仅供主题 UI 展示，请勿单独提取或商用。
description.en: Raiden Inazuma Atelier is an unofficial Raiden Shogun fan theme for DSH Web. Light mode becomes a cherry-blossom conservatory and dark mode an electro stage, with violet-gold acrylic conversation surfaces, chibi sidebar icons, and an optional animated workspace mascot. Settings control opacity, artwork opacity, and motion, with `prefers-reduced-motion` support; a separate “Raiden” agent preset is also available. The theme is off by default, Web-only, documented for DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` and newer, and its character assets are for this UI only—not for separate extraction or commercial use.

description.zh: 可拖拽的鲸鱼娘悬浮桌宠：监视 DeepSeek 账户余额、官方“今日已消费”、当前会话 token 用量与预估花费，并用面板展示近 7 天趋势和逐条提问花费。余额通过官方接口每 30 秒轮询；“今日已消费”需要在 Host 端配置平台凭据，余额查询需要在 Host 端配置余额凭据，会话费用则依据本机 `sessionProjections` 与官方价格计算。
description.en: A draggable whale-maid overlay pet that monitors your DeepSeek balance, official “spent today,” current-session token usage and estimated cost, with a panel for seven-day trends and per-question costs. Balance polling uses the official API every 30 seconds; “spent today” requires a Host-side platform credential, and balance lookup requires a Host-side balance credential, and session costs are calculated locally from `sessionProjections` and official pricing.

name.zh: Gemini 风格 Material 3 Expressive 主题

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 界面改造成 Google Gemini 风格的 Material 3 Expressive 视觉：71 组明暗主题令牌、Google Sans/Roboto 字体栈、圆角组件、luminous 光晕、动效、点击波纹和渐隐滚动条。它以持久化 client bundle 通过官方扩展点工作，不改宿主源码；但依赖产品 CSS-module 类名片段，上游重构后可能需要更新选择器。
description.en: Restyles the DSH Web UI in a Google Gemini–style Material 3 Expressive look with 71 light/dark token pairs, Google Sans/Roboto font stacks, rounded components, luminous glow, motion, pointer ripples and fading scrollbars. It runs as a persistent client bundle through official extension points without changing host source; its product CSS-module class-hash selectors may need updating after an upstream rebuild.

name.en: The Wandering Earth II Cinematic Theme

description.zh: 以《流浪地球2》为灵感的 DSH Web 主题：深空舱体配色、行星发动机沉底插图、星场 HUD 与 MOSS 眼发送按钮。会话运行时发动机显示蓝色等离子点火，停止后熄火，并提供深色/浅色对应素材；主题令牌叠加层常驻，切换外观或刷新后仍生效。
description.en: A The Wandering Earth II–inspired DSH Web theme with deep-space cabin colors, sunken planet-engine artwork, a starfield HUD and an MOSS-eye send button. The engine shows blue plasma ignition while a session runs and cools to idle when it stops, with dedicated dark/light artwork; its token overlay remains active across appearance changes and page reloads.

description.zh: 运行在 DSH 浮层里的虚拟抽烟互动小组件：点燃、轻吸或长按猛吸、弹烟灰、吐烟圈，并通过燃烧进度和“换烟”完成一轮互动。提供六种氛围主题、可静音的程序化合成音效、可拖动/收起的浮层，并支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`；这是纯虚拟体验，不是吸烟应用。
description.en: A virtual-smoking fidget widget in the DSH overlay: light a cigarette, take a drag or hold to inhale, flick ash, and blow smoke rings as the burn progresses toward a required “switch cigarette” step. It includes six ambient themes, muteable procedurally synthesized sounds, a draggable/collapsible overlay, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support; it is a virtual experience, not a smoking app.

description.zh: 冷调蓝紫暮色主题皮肤：亮/暗模式自动切换背景，侧栏与面板使用轻透纹理和暮靛蓝、雾蓝灰、樱粉等 UI token。它只改展示层，不改布局几何、不注入服务或触达模型请求；素材内嵌在 client bundle，卸载可还原。许可为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，禁止商业使用。
description.en: A cool blue-violet twilight skin with light/dark background variants, translucent textured sidebar and panels, and UI tokens in dusk indigo, mist blue-gray and sakura pink. It stays in the presentation layer—no layout geometry changes, service injection or model requests—and embeds its assets in the client bundle for reversible unload. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for non-commercial use.

description.zh: 面向皮肤作者的非官方主题集合与起步工具：提供 Event Horizon、Cyber Sakura、Obsidian Gold、Digital Rain 四套主题，原生 Settings 选择器、持久化选择、明暗 token，以及仅作用于首条消息前 Hero 区的响应式 WebP 艺术图，并支持可逆清理。固定版本目标为 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`，预览版插件 API 可能变化。
description.en: An unofficial theme collection and starter kit for skin authors with Event Horizon, Cyber Sakura, Obsidian Gold and Digital Rain, a native Settings selector, persistent choices, light/dark tokens, responsive WebP artwork scoped to the pre-conversation Hero area, and reversible cleanup. The fixed release targets DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`; preview-version plugin APIs may change.

description.zh: 为 DSHD 提供 7 套内置皮肤：深蓝默认、午夜、冷杉、暖纸、紫罗兰、卡通和可爱，并保留一个置灰的 `custom` 预留槽位。可在设置中即时预览、应用或取消，放大预览使用真实 `--dsw-alias-*` token，选择持久化到 `skin-pack.skin`；皮肤只覆盖 UI token，不改代码块高亮。没有特权设置 API 的远程浏览器中，换肤仅在当前进程生效。
description.en: A DSHD skin pack with seven built-in looks—DeepSeek default, Midnight, Nord, Sepia, Violet, Cartoon and Cute—plus a disabled `custom` placeholder. Preview, apply or cancel skins from Settings, inspect an enlarged preview rendered with real `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, and persist the choice in `skin-pack.skin`; the skins change UI tokens, not code-block highlighting. In remote browsers without the privileged settings API, changes remain process-local.

description.zh: 把外部 `δ-me13` 技能套件接入 DSH 的 13 席黄金裔工作流：每席拥有独立会话、配色/壁纸与角色贴纸，并可在总览工作台派发任务、全席征询和人工确认移交。技能正文从 `skillRoots` 只读加载，插件包不内置 `SKILL.md` 等技能内容；视觉素材可来自带图发布包或本地 `assetsRoot`。固定包支持 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`/`0.2.1-rc.3`。
description.en: Connects the external `δ-me13` skill suite to a 13-seat Chrysos Heirs workflow in DSH: each seat gets its own sessions, palette/wallpaper and character stickers, while the workbench supports dispatch, all-seat consultation and user-confirmed handoffs. Skill text is read read-only from `skillRoots`—the package does not include `SKILL.md` or the rest of the skill suite—while artwork can come from the with-assets release package or a local `assetsRoot`. The fixed package targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.3`.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的“设置 → 通用设置”加入 One Dark Pro 开关，将整个界面切换为 VS Code One Dark Pro 暗色配色。通过官方 `ctx.theme` 注册并叠加 token 覆盖，启用状态保存到浏览器 `localStorage`，关闭时恢复此前的浅色/深色/跟随系统偏好，并支持多标签页同步。
description.en: Adds a One Dark Pro toggle under DSH Web Settings → General, switching the interface to the classic VS Code One Dark Pro dark palette. It registers through the official `ctx.theme` service and applies a token override; the enabled state is stored in browser `localStorage`, previous light/dark/system preference is restored when disabled, and changes sync across tabs.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可组合的字体系统：内置 JetBrains Mono + Inter、Fira Code + IBM Plex Sans、Cascadia Code 三套 OFL 字体预设，离线随包分发；可在设置中导入自定义 `woff2` 字体，并通过 `ctx.fonts` 注册表供其他插件扩展。内置字体为 Latin 子集，中文会回退到系统字体；自定义导入仅接受可跨域访问的 HTTP(S) `woff2` 直链。
description.en: A composable font system for DSH Web with three offline OFL presets—JetBrains Mono + Inter, Fira Code + IBM Plex Sans, and Cascadia Code. Import custom `woff2` fonts from Settings, and let other plugins extend the `ctx.fonts` registry. Bundled fonts are Latin subsets, so CJK falls back to system fonts; custom imports accept only CORS-accessible HTTP(S) `woff2` URLs.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供蜘蛛侠红蓝主题皮肤：覆盖官方设计 token，加入蛛网纹理、蜘蛛标识和场景化工作区，并用 WebGL2 流体效果在蜘蛛战衣与真人 Peter Parker 图层之间随鼠标显现。皮肤可与同仓库的漫威桌宠运行时独立组合；当前英雄内容为蜘蛛侠，素材随包提供且不依赖外部服务。
description.en: A Spider-Man skin for the DSH Web UI with red-and-blue design-token overrides, web textures, Spider-Man branding and scene-styled workspace surfaces. A WebGL2 fluid background reveals Peter Parker through the suit as the pointer moves. It can be combined independently with the repository’s Marvel pet runtime; Spider-Man is the current hero, and bundled assets run without an external service.

description.zh: 一只住在 DSH Web 界面的可定制猫咪桌宠：支持 `idle.png` 静态图或 `idle-N.png` 序列帧、拖拽定位、番茄专注/休息计时、按专注分钟累计 XP，以及逐级解锁“托托的 30 个事实”。设置可调大小、动画速度和像素渲染，文案随中英文界面切换并遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`；外观仅识别带透明通道的 PNG，未提供图片时不会显示。仅在 DSH web profile 生效，已在 Chromium（Chrome/Edge）验证。
description.en: A customizable cat pet for the DSH Web UI: use `idle.png` for a still or `idle-N.png` frames for animation, drag it around, run Pomodoro focus/break sessions, earn XP by focus minutes, and unlock 30 facts about Toto by level. Settings cover size, animation speed and pixel rendering; labels follow zh/en and the pet honors `prefers-reduced-motion`. Appearance detection accepts transparent PNG files only, and Toto stays hidden when no image is supplied. It runs in the DSH web profile and has been verified on Chromium (Chrome/Edge).

description.zh: 完整且可逆的 DSH Web 樱花视觉系统，提供浅色“晴樱”和深色“夜樱”，跟随 Light / Dark / System 自动切换。它统一调整品牌、色彩、字体、图标、卡片和交互状态，内置霞鹜文楷屏幕阅读版 GB，并保留提交、导航和模型交互行为；目标兼容 DSH Web `0.1.1-rc.2` 系列，需 Node.js 20+。
description.en: A complete, reversible cherry-blossom visual system for DSH Web with airy Day Sakura and immersive Night Sakura themes that follow Light, Dark or System. It coordinates branding, colors, typography, icons, surfaces and interaction states, bundles LXGW WenKai GB Screen, and leaves submission, navigation and model behavior unchanged. It targets the DSH Web `0.1.1-rc.2` series and requires Node.js 20+.

name.zh: 面板底色控制 · Panel Tint

description.zh: 为侧边栏、正文框和输入框提供 0–100% 独立底色不透明度滑块，实时生效并持久化；会读取当前皮肤的真实颜色、渐变和面板格式，普通皮肤与 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸模式都能用，关闭后恢复原样。复杂的多层背景在正文框上可能退化为单层纯色缩放。
description.en: Adds independent 0–100% background-opacity sliders for the sidebar, message panels and composer, with live application and persistent settings. It reads the active skin’s colors, gradients and panel styling, and also works over Wallpaper Engine backgrounds; disabling it restores the original UI. Complex multi-layer backgrounds may be reduced to a single scaled-color layer in message panels.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的会话列表改造成像素办公室：6×4 共 24 个工位对应工作区，便利贴计划板对应会话，CRT 显示器承载真实对话与工具调用；支持拖拽换位、归档/恢复、分叉、活跃度排序和 `CALM`/`OVERDRIVE` 动效档位。插件界面强制深色，布局偏好保存在当前浏览器；仅支持 DSH `>=0.1.2-alpha.1` 的最新基座，升级宿主后需要重新挂载插件，超过 24 个工作区仍需从原生界面访问。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web session list into a pixel office: a 6×4 grid of 24 desks for workspaces, sticky-note planning boards for sessions, and a CRT monitor containing the real conversation and tool calls. It supports drag-to-rearrange, archive/restore, forking, activity sorting and `CALM`/`OVERDRIVE` motion modes. The plugin surface is forced dark and layout preferences stay in the current browser; it supports only the latest DSH base (`>=0.1.2-alpha.1`), must be remounted after a host upgrade, and leaves workspaces beyond 24 accessible from the native UI.

description.zh: “深夜农场”星露谷物语风格深色主题：暖棕土壤背景、麦金主色、奶油文字和草绿状态色。通过 `stardew` 主题 token 即时切换且可逆，选择跨页面重启保留，卸载后恢复原生外观。
description.en: A Stardew Valley–style “late-night farmhouse” dark theme with warm soil browns, harvest gold, cream text and grass-green status colors. It registers the `stardew` token theme for instant, reversible switching, persists the active choice across restarts, and restores the native appearance on uninstall.

description.zh: 以锦鲤池塘为意象的 DSH Web 皮肤：墨青池水、波纹纹理、锦鲤橙红点缀，包含“池塘夜色”深色与“宣纸日色”浅色模式。原生 Canvas 2D 鱼群会聚群、随鼠标逃逸并响应点击水波；系统减少动态效果时降为静态，页面隐藏时暂停。它是纯展示层，只覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 等设计 token 与部件样式，不注入服务或触达模型请求。
description.en: A koi-pond-inspired DSH Web skin with ink-teal water, ripple textures and koi orange-red accents, offering dark “Pond Night” and light “Rice-Paper Day” modes. Its vanilla Canvas 2D fish school uses flocking, mouse-flee behavior and click ripples; reduced motion falls back to a static render and hidden tabs pause it. It is presentation-only, overriding `--dsw-alias-*` tokens and component styles without injecting services or touching model requests.

name.zh: ds-hentai · ExHentai 风格画廊主题

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 包装为深炭色画廊索引界面：Front Page 支持分类筛选、会话搜索、表格/缩略图模式、重命名/分叉/归档与收藏；会话页可选皮肤输入框、搜索坞和原生右侧栏面板。对话内容仍由 DSH 原生渲染，皮肤只替换界面外壳；偏好保存在本机浏览器，支持 DSH `0.0.1-rc.5` 起的版本并已验证到 `0.2.1-rc.2`。
description.en: Wraps DSH Web in a charcoal gallery-index interface: Front Page offers category filters, session search, table/thumbnail modes, rename/fork/archive actions and favorites; the session view can use a skin composer, search dock and native right-sidebar panes. Conversation content remains native to DSH—the skin changes the chrome only—and preferences stay in the local browser. It supports DSH from `0.0.1-rc.5` and has been verified through `0.2.1-rc.2`.

name.zh: 液态玻璃 UI 主题

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 与 Desktop 提供液态玻璃界面：半透明磨砂面板、可调透明度/模糊/色调、SVG 边缘折射、多图轮播或 MP4/WebM 动态壁纸、字体注入和自定义 CSS。设置持久化在 `$DSH_HOME/data/glass-ui/config.json`，可导入/导出 JSON；需要支持 `backdrop-filter` 的 Chrome/Edge 91+。
description.en: A liquid-glass UI theme for DSH Web and Desktop with translucent frosted panels, adjustable opacity/blur/tint, SVG edge refraction, image carousels or MP4/WebM wallpapers, font injection and custom CSS. Settings persist in `$DSH_HOME/data/glass-ui/config.json` with JSON import/export; it requires Chrome/Edge 91+ with `backdrop-filter` support.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话右侧打开可调宽度的文档面板，查看本地 Markdown/纯文本文件；支持拖动调整宽度、浅色暖纸/深海军蓝主题、最近文件、每 4 秒自动重读。文件仅由本机 `dsh web` 进程读取，通过同源路由传输，不访问网络或发送遥测；仅在 web profile 生效，要求 Node.js 24+。
description.en: Adds a resizable document rail beside the DSH Web conversation for local Markdown or plain-text files. It offers drag resizing, warm-paper/light and deep-navy/dark themes, recent files and four-second auto-refresh. Files are read by the local `dsh web` process and served over same-origin routes—no network service or telemetry; it runs only in the web profile and requires Node.js 24+.

description.zh: 面向 DSH 皮肤作者的浏览器内开发工具：浏览 169 项官方 `--dsw-*` token，实时编辑 light/dark 值并预览，保存为持久化 override 或注册为可选主题，导出 JSON；另有 7 套光谱预设和 ≤5MB 的本地背景上传。目标兼容 DSH `0.1.7-alpha.2`–`0.1.7-rc.2`，不是普通用户换肤器。
description.en: An in-browser development tool for DSH skin authors: browse 169 official `--dsw-*` tokens, edit light/dark values with live previews, save overrides or register a selectable theme, and export JSON. It also provides seven spectrum presets and local background uploads up to 5 MB. It targets DSH `0.1.7-alpha.2` through `0.1.7-rc.2`; it is an authoring tool, not a general-purpose skin switcher.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 9 套外观（含鲸吟·蓝幻、雾蓝·极简、素白·明亮、樱绯·粉、青岚·碧、琥珀·金、紫罗兰、翡翠·绿和原生界面），支持每套独立壁纸与面板/对话区/工作区/文件区/阅读区五组透明度滑块。右下角 ◆ 胶囊可即时关闭并恢复原生 UI；固定证据显示目标基座为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6`，Node 24/Windows，macOS/Linux 未测。
description.en: A DSH Web beauty layer with nine looks—Whale Song Blue Fantasy, Mist Blue Minimal, Plain White Light, Sakura Pink, Cyan Mist, Amber Gold, Violet, Emerald Green and Native UI—plus per-skin wallpapers and five independent transparency sliders for the panel, conversation, workspace, files and reading regions. A bottom-right ◆ pill toggles it off and restores the stock UI; the fixed repo targets `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` on Node 24/Windows, with macOS/Linux untested.

description.zh: 为 `read`、`bash` 和 `pwsh` 工具输出提供 VS Code Dark+ 风格的分层语法高亮：按文件扩展名或内容识别 JSON/代码，无法识别的表格和日志保持原样，并显示退出码状态条。工具卡片可在设置中默认折叠，运行中或出错时自动展开；纯前端处理，不改写会话、不调用模型、零 token 开销。
description.en: Adds VS Code Dark+ layered syntax highlighting to `read`, `bash` and `pwsh` tool output. It detects JSON or code from file extensions/content, leaves unrecognized tables and logs plain, and shows an exit-code chip. Tool cards can collapse by default in Settings but auto-expand while running or on errors; rendering is frontend-only, so it does not rewrite sessions or call the model and adds zero token overhead.

name.zh: DSH Black Hole 黑洞主题

description.zh: 在 DSH 原生外观选择器中加入可切换的 Black Hole 主题：保留 DSH Dark 调色板，只在新会话 Hero 区渲染 WebGPU 黑洞背景，Light/Dark/System 仍由宿主管理。动态层目标 60 FPS，仅在桌面宽屏、WebGPU 可用且未启用减少动态效果时运行；其他环境保留纯深色背景，离开新会话页会释放 GPU 资源。
description.en: Adds a switchable Black Hole option to DSH’s native appearance selector. It keeps the DSH Dark palette and renders a WebGPU black-hole background only in the New Session Hero, while Light/Dark/System remain host-managed. The animated layer targets 60 FPS and runs only on a wide desktop with WebGPU available and reduced motion off; other environments keep a plain dark background, and leaving New Session releases GPU resources.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 左下角原生 Cordis Plugin 面板替换为纯 CSS 乐高砖视图，展示当前会话运行的动态插件（`dyn/*`）。每块砖保留运行、停止、删除、批准/拒绝等生命周期操作，支持按插件 ID 搜索、运行计数、四套主题、中英和明暗适配；静态 `cordis.yml` Loader 插件不在列表中，且项目与 LEGO Group 无关联。
description.en: Replaces the DSH Web Cordis Plugin panel with a pure-CSS Lego-brick view of dynamic plugins running in the current session (`dyn/*`). Each brick keeps lifecycle actions such as run, stop, remove and approve/decline, with plugin-ID search, a running count, four themes, i18n and light/dark token support. Static Loader plugins from `cordis.yml` are not listed, and the project is not affiliated with the LEGO Group.

description.zh: 《孤独摇滚！》风格的 DSH Web 极简深色主题：后藤独粉强调色、暖紫背景与内嵌壁纸，覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*`/`--dsw-specific-*` token，并在设置中提供“原始主题 ↔ 孤独摇滚主题”开关。选择持久化在 `localStorage`，壁纸自包含可离线使用；需要 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 或更新版本，纯客户端插件。
description.en: A minimalist dark DSH Web theme inspired by Bocchi the Rock!, with Gotoh Hitori pink accents, warm-purple backgrounds and an embedded wallpaper. It overrides `--dsw-alias-*`/`--dsw-specific-*` tokens and adds a Settings toggle between the original and Bocchi themes. The choice persists in `localStorage`, the wallpaper is embedded for offline use, and the pure client plugin requires DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` or newer.

description.zh: 追踪 DSH 会话中的 `write`/`edit` 工具调用，在“审查”标签页展示带语法高亮的 side-by-side diff；支持按会话或最新轮次查看、子代理变更聚合、SSE 实时更新，以及撤回单个修改或整份文件。只读审查配一键撤回，不需要外部编辑器，原生产物预览不受影响。
description.en: Tracks `write`/`edit` tool calls in DSH sessions and shows syntax-highlighted side-by-side diffs in a Review tab. View a session or the latest turn, aggregate subagent changes into the parent session, receive SSE updates, and revert one change or an entire file. It is read-only review plus one-click revert, needs no external editor, and leaves native produced-file previews untouched.

name.zh: Theme Asuka // 02 明日香学园主题

description.zh: 非官方的 DSH Web 明暗外观主题：学校蓝、缎带红、暖纸色与第三东京市夜色，配合三张按本地时间段切换的壁纸和液态玻璃表面。设置中可切换 Off、On the Way to School、Noon Classroom、Tokyo-3 Night，并调节壁纸透明度/模糊和动效；目标兼容 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，WebGPU 不可用时回退到 SVG/磨砂效果，当前固定版本的 Ubuntu/WSL 与真实模型流未复测。
description.en: An unofficial light/dark DSH Web appearance theme built from school blue, ribbon red, warm paper and Tokyo-3 night tones, with three wallpapers that switch by local time and liquid-glass surfaces. Settings offer Off, On the Way to School, Noon Classroom and Tokyo-3 Night plus wallpaper opacity/blur and motion controls; it targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, falls back to SVG/frosted effects when WebGPU is unavailable, and the fixed release was not rechecked on Ubuntu/WSL or with real model streaming.

description.zh: 在 DSH 新会话 Hero 背后以 ASCII 字符渲染会动的鲨鱼与鱼群海洋，作为纯浏览器端背景装饰；宿主侧没有额外逻辑。
description.en: A living ASCII backdrop for the DSH New Session Hero, rendering sharks and schools of fish behind the interface as a browser-only decoration with no host-side logic.

name.zh: Deep diving 鲸鱼娘动作皮肤

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 的“Deep diving…”状态行提供蓝色鲸鱼娘动画：默认 `whale-maid` 含 8 种透明动作，每段 100 帧、10fps，可在同一轮求索中按 10–60 秒轮换，也可固定单个动作；另保留 `whale`、`dafeiyu`、`catgirl` 和 `mermaid` 皮肤。设置支持 14–96px 尺寸、起始动作和中英文状态文案，减少动态效果时会停用动画；素材随包分发，但鲸鱼娘图片禁止商业使用。
description.en: Animated blue whale-maid skins for the DSH Web “Deep diving…” status row. The default `whale-maid` provides eight transparent 100-frame animations at 10 fps, rotating every 10–60 seconds within one turn or looping a single action; `whale`, `dafeiyu`, `catgirl` and `mermaid` skins remain available. Settings cover 14–96px size, starting action and localized status text, and reduced motion disables animation; the bundled whale-maid artwork is open-source-use only and prohibited for commercial use.

name.zh: Frutiger Aero 玻璃水感皮肤

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换上 Frutiger Aero 风格：天空与水面动态壁纸、磨砂玻璃面板、水感高光，以及可跟随宿主的明暗方案。桌面端保留三栏、弹窗、菜单和键盘交互；窄屏则提供覆盖式抽屉、拇指可达的浮动 dock、边缘手势、感知键盘的输入框和 44px 触控目标。浏览器端零依赖、无需构建，运行时不发网络请求；MIT 许可。
description.en: Reskins the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in Frutiger Aero with sky-and-water wallpaper, frosted panes, aqua highlights, and light/dark palettes. Desktop keeps the three-column layout, dialogs, menus, and keyboard interaction; narrow screens get an overlay drawer, thumb-reachable glass dock, edge gestures, a keyboard-aware composer, and 44px touch targets. The browser half has no dependencies or build requirement and makes no runtime network requests. MIT licensed.

description.zh: Studio 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 18 套主题、按工作区分配主题，以及从心情、颜色、文字或图片生成主题的编辑器；还包括液态玻璃、壁纸、字体、外观定时切换、布局与专注模式、AI 模式、任务提醒、用量与成本面板、聊天导出、无障碍、保存提示词、Ctrl+K 快速切换和 19 种语言。默认设置留在本机；只有主动开启同步时才会上传所选设置，上传图片默认不离开本机。固定版本要求 DSH 0.2 Web profile 和 Node 22.5+；MIT 许可。
description.en: Studio adds 18 themes, per-workspace themes, and an editor that can generate themes from a mood, colour, word, or image to DeepSeek Harness. It also includes liquid glass, wallpapers, fonts, scheduled looks, layout and focus mode, AI modes, task alerts, usage and cost views, chat export, accessibility options, saved prompts, a Ctrl+K quick switcher, and 19 languages. Settings stay on the machine by default; only selected settings are uploaded when sync is enabled, and uploaded images remain local unless explicitly included. The fixed version requires DSH 0.2 on the Web profile and Node 22.5+. MIT licensed.

description.zh: Claude Code 风格的 DSH Web 皮肤，以暖炭黑/暖米白表面、陶土橙强调色、等宽终端字体和暖色代码块重塑浏览器界面；令牌覆盖层随亮色、暗色和系统偏好适配，不改变原有交互。它是可自动注册到 profile 的 bundle，卸载后会移除自己的样式层；MIT 许可。
description.en: A Claude Code–inspired DSH Web skin with warm charcoal and cream surfaces, a terracotta accent, monospace terminal typography, and warm-tinted code blocks. Its token layer follows light, dark, and system preferences without changing the original interactions. It is a bundle that auto-registers with the profile and removes its own style layer when uninstalled. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 侧边栏改为“会话 / 联系人”双模式：联系人按智能体预设展示名称和状态，可直接打开或新建绑定预设的会话；同时提供 DIY 外观面板、主题色/按钮/聊天文字颜色、按智能体保存的本地图片或图片 URL 壁纸集、渐变预设，以及对话区壁纸轮播。会话行的智能体标签需要额外的 ui-workspace 补丁，其余功能无需该补丁；目标环境为 DSH 0.1.0-rc.5、Node 22+ 和 pnpm 10+，MIT 许可。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web sidebar into Sessions and Contacts modes. Contacts list agent presets with names and status, and can open or create sessions bound to a preset; a DIY panel controls accent, button, and chat-text colours, per-agent wallpaper sets using local images, image URLs, or gradients, and a conversation carousel. The optional ui-workspace patch is only needed for the session-row agent tag; other features work without it. It targets DSH 0.1.0-rc.5 with Node 22+ and pnpm 10+. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 梁文谷按北京时间的 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段提醒：峰前倒计时、到点弹窗，右上角可拖动 HUD 展示阶段、血条和下一事件；白天/月夜主题、九境修仙成长、错过补播、系统通知和合成提示音也可用。每天弹窗最多 6 次，首次使用系统通知需要授权；固定版本已在 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 上验证，MIT 许可。
description.en: Liangwengu reminds you about DeepSeek’s Beijing-time peak and off-peak periods with pre-peak countdowns and timed pop-ups. A draggable HUD shows the current phase, a health bar, and the next event; it also includes day/moon-night themes, nine cultivation levels, catch-up announcements, system notifications, and synthesized sound cues. Pop-ups are limited to six per day, and system notifications require permission. The fixed version was verified with DSH 0.1.2-rc.1. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 页面上方添加可切换、可拖拽、可缩小的 Codex 风格桌宠，内置 7 个角色，每个含 12 帧动作，并根据会话的运行、等待确认、完成和空闲摘要切换姿势。选择、位置与启用状态会保存；插件只展示浏览器侧状态，不增加提示词、工具或会话事件，也不打开原生置顶窗口。内置角色素材来自用户提供的参考图，公开再分发前需确认二创和分发授权；源代码 MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds switchable, draggable, and minimizable Codex-style pets above the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Seven characters are bundled with 12-frame animations, and poses follow the session summary for running, waiting for confirmation, completed, or idle states. The selection, position, and enabled state are persisted; the plugin only presents browser-side status, adds no prompts, tools, or session events, and does not open a native always-on-top window. The bundled character art was generated from user-provided references, so derivative-work and redistribution rights should be confirmed before public redistribution. The source is MIT licensed.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 的运行中状态行提供轻量个性化：轮换中英文俏皮话、16 种加载图标（小/中/大三档）、颜色预设与主题色匹配、扫光/波浪文字效果、可选用时显示，以及“只显示图标”模式。设置集中在独立页面；零依赖、无需构建和配置文件、不发网络请求，偏好保存在浏览器本地且不修改 DSH 自带包。以 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上为目标，同时识别旧版状态行；MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds lightweight personalisation to the DSH Web running-status line: rotating bilingual quips, 16 loading icons in three sizes, colour presets and theme-colour matching, shimmer or wave text effects, optional elapsed time, and an indicator-only mode. Everything is in its own settings page; there are no dependencies, build or config-file steps, or network requests, and preferences stay in browser storage without modifying stock DSH packages. It targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer while recognizing the older status-line shape. MIT licensed.

name.zh: What Was That 术语章鱼

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角放置一只小章鱼：当 AI 回复出现词库中的技术术语时显示红色角标，点击即可查看大白话和生活比喻，还能继续请求多轮解释；支持在对话区选词、四种状态形象和解释模型选择。词库优先在本地解释，深入解释只发送选中的词及有限上下文，不发送完整回复。固定版本适配 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2，MIT 许可。
description.en: Puts a small octopus in the bottom-right of DSH Web. When an AI reply contains a technical term from its lexicon, the pet shows a red badge; click it for a plain-language explanation and everyday analogy, then ask for more explanation in several rounds. It also supports selecting a word in the conversation, four pet states, and choosing the explanation model. The local lexicon handles first-pass explanations; deeper explanations send only the selected term and limited context, not the full reply. The fixed version targets DSH 0.1.7-rc.2. MIT licensed.

description.zh: V CYBER 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供七套可切换赛博风格：NEON、日落公路、梦核、紫夜极光、银翼千禧、蓝调夜曲和 TACTICAL 红蓝作战面板。主题含 CRT/扫光/渐变描边、会话状态框体与主题色胶囊，支持实时热替换、减少动效和持久化；关闭时不替换或禁用官方插件。需要 DSH ≥0.1.2-rc.1，MIT 许可。
description.en: V CYBER gives DeepSeek Harness Web seven switchable cyber styles: NEON, Sunset Drive, Dream Core, Neon Violet, Y2K Chrome, Blue Nocturne, and the red/blue TACTICAL operations panel. The themes add CRT and streaming effects, gradient borders, session-status frames, and theme-colour pills, with hot swapping, reduced-motion support, and persistence. The plugin does not replace or disable official plugins, and its layers can be turned off. It requires DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 or newer. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 把 DSH 的推理强度下拉框换成可吸附的呼吸滑块，在 Off / Low / Medium / High / Max 间切换；面板提供液态玻璃、9 种主题色、Canvas 动效、流速/亮度/音量三轴调校、吸附音效、游标图标和 JSON 配置分享。可随时关闭并恢复原生下拉框；插件零网络请求、不读写用户文件，配置保存在浏览器本地。MIT 许可。
description.en: Replaces DSH’s reasoning-effort dropdown with a magnetic, breathing slider for Off / Low / Medium / High / Max. The panel adds liquid glass, nine theme colours, Canvas effects, speed/brightness/volume tuning, snap sounds, cursor icons, and JSON configuration sharing. You can turn it off and restore the native dropdown at any time; the plugin makes no network requests and does not read or write user files, while its configuration stays in browser storage. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供四套配色预设（默认、深海蓝、暖沙、松石绿）和整页背景图：图片在浏览器内压缩后用于侧栏与主区，文字上方自动加可读遮罩。设置保存在浏览器本地，可在“设置 → UI设置”中一键重置；4.0.0 起只保留配色与背景功能，不再提供卡片布局引擎。已在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.0-rc.1 验证，MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds four colour presets—Default, Deep Sea Blue, Warm Sand, and Turquoise—to DSH Web, plus a full-page background image. Imported images are compressed in the browser, shown behind both the sidebar and main area, and covered with a readability veil. Settings stay in browser storage and can be reset from Settings → UI Settings; since 4.0.0 the plugin only handles colours and backgrounds and no longer provides the card-layout engine. It was verified with DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.1. MIT licensed.

name.zh: Codefall 数字雨与绿色主题

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加黑客帝国风格的绿色数字雨开屏和向两侧展开的矩形光门，并提供可调色相的绿色界面主题。可设置雨密度、速度、画质、明暗模式和重播时机；动画用 Canvas2D 绘制，不加载视频或在线动画素材，支持减少动态效果。目标为 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上；桌面恢复重播和 macOS/Linux 实机兼容性仍需按环境验证。MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds a Matrix-inspired green digital-rain startup screen, a rectangular light portal that opens in both directions, and a hue-adjustable green UI theme to DeepSeek Harness. Rain density, speed, quality, light/dark appearance, and replay timing are configurable; the animation uses Canvas2D without video or online animation assets and respects reduced-motion preferences. It targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer; desktop-restore replay and real-device compatibility on macOS/Linux still depend on the environment. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 透明玻璃皮肤以极光或自选图片为背景，在侧栏、弹层、输入框、消息气泡等控件上加入半透明磨砂片，同时保留清晰壁纸；支持整站浓度、左右侧栏强度、明暗主题和减少动效/减少透明度偏好。纯客户端、零依赖、无需构建，背景图与设置保存在浏览器本地，卸载可还原外观。目标 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，MIT 许可。
description.en: Clear Glass Skin uses an aurora or chosen image as the canvas and adds translucent frosted panes to sidebars, overlays, the composer, message bubbles, and other controls while keeping the wallpaper clear. It provides whole-site opacity, separate sidebar strength, light/dark themes, and reduced-motion/reduced-transparency handling. It is client-only, dependency-free, and build-free; wallpaper and settings stay in browser storage, and unloading restores the appearance. It targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2. MIT licensed.

name.zh: Bliss Glass 怀旧玻璃主题

description.zh: Bliss Glass 将 Windows XP 时代的阳光风景壁纸与现代磨砂玻璃结合，覆盖聊天框、菜单、对话框、气泡和侧栏，并随宿主明暗主题切换。内置 4 张风景，也可从本地导入图片或选择纯玻璃模式；桌面与移动 Web 均支持，零依赖、无需构建、不修改宿主文件，图片在浏览器内处理且不离开本机。部分精细样式按 DSH 0.2.0-rc.x 的面板类名匹配，其他构建上壁纸和主题令牌仍可工作，但细节可能需要更新；MIT 许可。
description.en: Bliss Glass pairs sunny Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with modern frosted glass across the composer, menus, dialogs, bubbles, and sidebars, following the host’s light/dark appearance. It includes four sceneries, accepts local image imports, and offers a glass-only mode; desktop and mobile Web are supported with no dependencies, no build step, and no host-file changes. Images are processed in the browser and stay on the machine. Fine-grained panel styling targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.x class names; the wallpaper and theme-token layer still work on other builds, but details may need selector updates. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 把 JPG/PNG 图片在页面内抠图，生成带白色贴纸描边、呼吸/摇摆待机动画的浮动桌宠；可调背景容差，复杂照片背景也可关闭去背而保留整图。桌宠上方可显示当前账户余额（未登录时给出提示），位置会随窗口尺寸保持；图片只在浏览器本地处理，处理后的图像才保存到本地 DSH 数据中。每个 profile 只支持一只桌宠；MIT 许可。
description.en: Turns a JPG or PNG into a floating pet by removing the background in the page, adding a white sticker outline, and giving it breathing and swaying idle motion. Background tolerance is adjustable, and background removal can be disabled for complex photos so the whole image is kept. A bubble can show the current account balance and explains when no account is signed in; the pet position follows window resizing. Images are processed in the browser and only the finished artwork is saved in local DSH data. One pet is supported per profile. MIT licensed.
